**Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or another related quantitative field.
**Experience: 3 – 6**
years of relevant experience in data analytics, business analytics, product analytics, or a closely related field.  
**Key Skills:**


* Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to translate analytical requirements from Product Managers into clearly defined analytical problems, frameworks, and deliverables.
* Strong logical and analytical reasoning, with the ability to break down complex and ambiguous problems methodically and think structurally.
* Ability to think strategically, handle ambiguity, and work effectively in a fast-paced, limited-structure, multicultural environment.
* Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and set and achieve targets with limited guidance.
* Creative problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities beyond assigned tasks.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Curiosity and adaptability to quickly learn and adopt new data, analytics, AI, and automation tools as the technology stack evolves.
* Proactive mindset toward identifying and implementing AI-driven automation opportunities.

**Technical Skills:**


* **SQL / Query Languages**
  — Must Have: Strong SQL skills, including the ability to query large-scale and distributed data platforms such as Trino/Presto and Spark SQL, in addition to traditional relational databases.

  — Must Have: Strong Python skills for data analysis and automation, including pandas and NumPy, with the ability to write clean, reusable, and maintainable scripts.

* **BI & Visualisation:**

  Strong Excel skills, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data modelling, and analytical reporting.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Business teams have reliable, decision-ready dashboards and metrics.
* Analytical requirements are converted into clear KPIs, models, and actionable insights.

* Data-driven recommendations contribute to measurable improvements in business performance, operational efficiency, and healthcare quality.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Retail Media Data Operations Analyst: The Retail Media Data Operations Analyst is responsible for transforming fragmented reporting from retail media networks, third-party media partners, retailers, and measurement providers into standardized, validated, analysis-ready datasets.
  
  
This role serves as the operational bridge between media activation, partner reporting, Business Intelligence, and client analytics. The analyst will manage the data preparation lifecycle from reporting intake and completeness checks through normalization, quality assurance, documentation, and delivery so the media teams can dedicate more time to performance analysis, strategic recommendations, and executive storytelling. Key Responsibilities
  
  
Reporting Intake and Operational Management
  
  

* Maintain a centralized inventory of required campaign, retailer, media partner, and measurement reporting.
* Track expected reporting dates, delivery status, missing inputs, and data-processing progress.
* Download or collect reporting from partner portals, shared locations, email deliveries, APIs, and other approved sources.
* Organize source files using established folder structures, file-naming standards, version controls, and retention requirements.
* Maintain reporting calendars and communicate potential delays before they affect recap and wrap-report timelines. Data Preparation and Standardization
* Consolidate partner reports delivered through spreadsheets, flat files, PDFs, presentations, and self-service reporting platforms.
* Transform source data into standardized reporting templates and analysis-ready datasets.
* Normalize campaign, retailer, brand, product, audience, placement, creative, tactic, and business-unit naming conventions.
* Map partner-specific metrics to approved enterprise metric definitions.
* Reconcile retailer, product, UPC, campaign, placement, and organizational hierarchies.
* Document transformations, assumptions, exclusions, and calculations so outputs can be consistently reproduced. Data Quality and Validation
* Perform completeness, accuracy, reasonableness, duplication, and reconciliation checks before datasets are released for analysis.
* Validate reported spend, impressions, clicks, sales, units, ROAS, audience results, and other applicable metrics against source totals and campaign plans.
* Identify anomalies, missing reporting dimensions, inconsistent metric definitions, and unsupported comparisons.
* Maintain a data-quality and exception log that documents issues, owners, status, resolution, and downstream impact.
* Escalate material data-quality risks to BI and Retail Media leadership.
* Ensure that corrected or restated partner data is versioned and reflected in downstream datasets. Automation Readiness
* Develop reusable templates, mapping tables, validation routines, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
* Identify recurring manual activities that are candidates for automation.
* Translate operational processes into documented requirements for BI, data engineering, and Catalyst development.
* Partner with BI to test automated ingestion, transformation, validation, and exceptionmanagement workflows.
* Help establish standardized data contracts and reporting specifications for priority partners.
* Support the transition from manually prepared files to scalable, governed data pipelines without disrupting current client deliverables. Stakeholder Collaboration
* Partner with Business Intelligence on data structures, architecture, governance, and quality standards.
* Partner with Retail Media and Shopper Marketing teams on campaign objectives, tactics, partner requirements, and reporting interpretation.
* Work with Retail Media teams to ensure datasets meet downstream analysis and storytelling requirements.
* Participate in partner onboarding and reporting-requirement discussions when needed. Communicate status, risks, missing inputs, and dependencies clearly to stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in analytics, business, marketing, information systems, data management, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Two or more years of experience in reporting operations, marketing analytics, retail media, shopper marketing, digital media, or data operations.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivots, lookups, data cleansing, reconciliation, and structured data preparation.
* Experience consolidating data from multiple sources with inconsistent formats and definitions.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information.
* Ability to document processes, mappings, business rules, and data-quality issues clearly.
* Strong written communication and the ability to coordinate work across multiple stakeholders and time zones.
* Ability to manage recurring deliverables, changing priorities, and firm client deadlines.
* Experience with retail media networks, shopper marketing programs, or CPG campaign measurement.
* Familiarity with reporting from retailers, RMNs, and partners such as ADUSA, Inmar, Neptune, or Chicory.
* Understanding of media and commerce metrics such as impressions, clicks, engagement, spend, attributed sales, ROAS, incrementality, household penetration, and product-level performance.
* Experience with Power Query, SQL, Power BI, data-preparation tools, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with campaign taxonomies, product hierarchies, UPC mapping, retailer hierarchies, and metric governance.
* Experience documenting requirements for automated ingestion or data-platform development. The Business Intelligence Analyst will be based in India and support the West Unit in North America on pursuits and projects. The role will consolidate client, market, competitor, and internal intelligence into practical insights for account plans, capture plans and proposals.

* Build detailed client profiles covering leadership, board priorities, capital improvement programs, budgets, and procurement history.

* Research competitors, including recent wins, key staff, and incumbent positions.

* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering the opportunity pipeline and win/loss performance.
* Maintain accurate and current CRM data and support continuous improvement in data quality.
* Respond to research requests from business development leads and pursuit teams, presenting findings clearly and concisely.
* Communicate confidently with North America teams through Microsoft Teams and written updates in US English.
* Demonstrate an understanding of US business culture, including direct communication, ownership, responsiveness and meeting deadlines.

The role supports business growth and sales activities through data-driven analysis, performance reporting and actionable insights, helping teams make informed decisions based on data. The Specialist is also responsible for the continuous development of the Global Delivery Dashboard, working closely with countries and business teams to ensure data quality, reporting consistency and effective stakeholder support. The role enables country and business teams to collect, manage and present data effectively, with a strong focus on automating recurring and manual processes. The Specialist manages assigned areas across end-to-end data management, reporting and analytics, translating business requirements into reliable data products, automated workflows and AI-enabled solutions.

title: Senior Security Analyst
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**About Netradyne And The Global SOC**
Netradyne builds AI-powered video telematics and fleet safety solutions, led by its Driver-i platform, used by commercial fleets worldwide. Our environment spans cloud-native SaaS, edge IoT devices in vehicles, large volumes of video and telemetry data, and AI/ML platforms.
  
  
The Global SOC protects this footprint around the clock. It runs a multi-cloud SOC integrating SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, endpoint, identity, email, SaaS and cloud telemetry, and is moving to an AI-driven operating model with agentic triage, correlation and response under human approval controls. The SOC also supports ISO 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001 governance and the AI Security Posture Management (AISPM) program.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will lead investigations that L1 cannot close, drive incidents to containment, and continuously raise the quality of our detections. You will be a hands-on technical leader on shift: mentoring L1 analysts, tuning the AI-assisted triage pipeline, and turning every incident into better playbooks, detections and controls across AWS, Azure, SaaS, endpoints and our IoT fleet platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring, triage and investigation**

* Act as the L2/L3 escalation point for alerts across SIEM, EDR, identity, email, SaaS and cloud security tools.
* Perform deep-dive investigations correlating logs, endpoint telemetry, network data, cloud audit trails and threat intelligence.
* Validate, enrich and prioritize alerts using a risk-based approach, and reduce false positives at source.
* Review and quality-check L1 triage decisions and AI-generated triage recommendations before closure.

**Incident response**

* Lead security incidents through detection, containment, eradication, recovery and post-incident review.
* Coordinate with Engineering, SRE, IT, Legal and Privacy during incidents, and communicate status clearly to SOC leadership.
* Perform host and cloud forensics triage, malware analysis at a functional level, and evidence preservation.
* Write incident reports and root-cause analyses with concrete, tracked remediation actions.

**Detection engineering and threat hunting**

* Build, test and tune detection rules and correlation logic, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Run hypothesis-driven threat hunts across cloud, endpoint, identity and SaaS telemetry.
* Track coverage gaps and propose new log sources, detections and use cases.
* Operationalize threat intelligence (IOCs, TTPs, advisories) relevant to SaaS, cloud and IoT environments.

**Automation and AI-driven SOC**

* Design and improve SOAR playbooks for enrichment, triage and response.
* Help define and validate AI agent workflows, confidence thresholds, guardrails and human-approval gates for security operations.
* Monitor AI security signals from the AISPM program, including shadow AI, unauthorized agents, unregistered MCP services and data-leakage alerts.

**Process, metrics and mentoring**

* Maintain runbooks, playbooks, escalation matrices and SOPs.
* Track and improve SOC metrics such as MTTD, MTTR, SLA adherence and false-positive rate.
* Mentor and coach L1 analysts, run shift handovers and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Provide evidence and support for ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 and customer security audits.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years in information security, with 3+ years in a SOC at L2 or L3.
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise SIEM (Splunk, Wazuh, QRadar or similar), including writing queries and detection rules.
* Strong experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Microsoft Defender.
* Solid understanding of AWS and Azure security logging and services (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Entra ID, Defender for Cloud).
* Working knowledge of identity attacks and controls: SSO, federation, MFA, conditional access, privileged access.
* Proven incident handling experience, including ransomware, phishing/BEC, account compromise and cloud misconfiguration incidents.
* Good grasp of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, VPN, firewalls, proxies) and Windows, Linux and macOS internals.
* Practical use of MITRE ATT&CK, the cyber kill chain and incident response frameworks such as NIST SP 800-61.
* Scripting ability in Python, PowerShell or Bash for automation and log analysis.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including incident reports for technical and leadership audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, CySA+, BTL1/BTL2, CEH, or AWS/Azure security certifications (AWS Security – Specialty, AZ-500, SC-200).
* Experience building SOAR playbooks and integrating security tools through APIs.
* Exposure to LLM-based or agentic security workflows, AI security risks (prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse) and AI governance.
* Experience securing SaaS platforms, containers and Kubernetes, or IoT and edge devices.
* Digital forensics and malware analysis skills beyond triage level.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, SOC 2 or NIST CSF audit evidence.
* Experience in a product or SaaS company with a global, 24x7 customer base.

**Technology environment**

* SIEM and log analytics - Wazuh, Splunk, ELK
* Endpoint and XDR - CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender
* Email security - Proofpoint
* Automation - SOAR, Python, REST APIs
* Threat intelligence - CTI feeds and platforms, MITRE ATT&CK
* Cloud - AWS, Azure, CSPM, IAM, WAF, KMS
* Identity - SSO and federation across AWS, Azure and SaaS
* AI and AI security - Azure OpenAI, LangGraph, AI registry, AISPM, MCP security

**Competencies and working conditions**

* Analytical rigor: follows evidence, documents reasoning, and avoids premature conclusions.
* Ownership under pressure: stays calm and decisive during live incidents.
* Communication: explains technical risk clearly to engineers and leadership alike.
* Collaboration: works across time zones with global Engineering, IT and business teams.
* Continuous learning: keeps pace with new attack techniques, cloud services and AI security risks.
* Mentoring mindset: raises the capability of the wider SOC team.

The role supports a 24x7 global SOC and involves rotational shifts and on-call escalation duty, including occasional weekends during major incidents.

**Location: Bellandur, Bengaluru**

**Salary: Competitive**

**About the role**
------------------

Voice has always been a key part of our business and the transition to IP based solutions has opened up opportunities for changing how everyone interacts with their services. Global Voice allows BT to capitalise on its global network presence to provide voice services such as SIP trunking, inbound contact centre services, and connectivity to UC platforms, serving major global corporations. Global Voice is currently going through a major revamp of the network to provide a fully end to end IP network built for the future.
  
Joining as a software engineer will give you the opportunity to be a part of a diverse team, building the services, applications and network of tomorrow. You will get to be involved in the end-to-end journey of delivering apps into the new network, from design, planning, development, testing, deployment.
  
You’ll be using your skills to provide the best solution for our customers to remain connected with each other.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Writing code for a variety of applications, from large scale applications with hundreds of features to dedicated purpose microservices, with a variety of languages, frameworks and tools.
* Writing highly reliable and performant code, to be used by services with requirements for high availability and throughput.
* Writing code with best practice and conforming to widely accepted design principles.
* Understanding high level requirements presented by network/application designers to implement new features, enhance existing features for product/customer demand, regulatory compliance, service/vendor integration, etc.
* Breaking down high level requirements into low level implementation detail, ready for development, such as defining features, signalling sequence, documenting detail, defining data model.
* Writing test cases for automated test suites, to verify that code that you’ve written/other people have written works well, and integrates with other code, applications.
* Identifying gaps in test coverage and filling the gap.
* Reviewing other people’s code to ensure that a high quality of code, best practices and knowledge is shared in the team.
* Spreading knowledge about your work, latest developments in the industry, modern technology, languages, security, best practices, etc.
* Constantly trying to understand detail, such as existing code, features, data model, application requirements, customer use cases.
* Identifying potential issues in code and how to resolve these before they cause real issues affecting customers.
* Analysing issues raised by Site Reliability Engineers, inspecting logs, signalling sequences, data configuration, identifying how to resolve issues.
* Identifying potential performance bottlenecks and how to remove these.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* In depth knowledge of Java language, principles and design patterns, including concepts from Java 8, e.g. lambdas, streams and modern Java.
* Strong understanding of paradigms: Object Oriented, Functional, Event Driven Programming
* Understanding of Java frameworks, e.g. JAIN SLEE, Spring Boot, Spring WebFlux, etc.
* Strong interest in modern programming languages/frameworks, e.g. GoLang, Rust, Kotlin, node.js etc.
* RDBMS systems e.g. MySQL, Postgres, and no-SQL systems e.g. Redis, Cassandra.
* Message brokers, e.g. Kafka
* Service discovery, e.g. Consul
* Client-Server protocols: HTTP
* API architectures: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, etc.
* Transport protocols: UDP, TCP, TLS
* Java Build frameworks, e.g. Maven, Ant.
* CI/CD frameworks, e.g. Gitlab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure Devops.
* Basic understanding of JVM, including GC implementations, e.g. CMS, ParNew, G1, and performance tuning.
* Good understanding of Linux OS environment, command line, tools, user management, networking, with hands on experience.
* Scripting, e.g. Bash, Python.
* Virtualisation, containerisation, cloud frameworks, e.g. VirtualBox, Docker, Azure, Kubernetes.
* Git for code management.
* Infrastructure as code frameworks, e.g. Ansible, Terraform.
* Jira, Agile, Scrum
* Documentation, e.g. Markdown, AsciiDoc, Antora

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Strong proficiency in writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate structured datasets for risk analysis. Solid understanding of process and control frameworks, including identifying control gaps and testing control effectiveness. Working knowledge of programming or coding to automate data analysis and streamline repetitive risk and controls workflows. Ability to apply structured analytical methods to assess process risks and convert data findings into actionable recommendations. Applied understanding of consulting methodologies for risk management and process improvement in the TMT sector.

  

**Skills and attributes**
  
  
**To qualify for the role you must have**
  
**Qualification**

* Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
* Bachelor of Computer Applications
* Master of Science in Data Science
* Master of Computer Applications

**Experience**

* Backend Development (3+ years)
* DevOps Engineering (3+ years)

**What we look for**
  
  
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What we offer**
  
  
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. title: Commercial Sales
description:
**Overview**

The **Commercial Executive** is a strategic negotiator within Microsoft's Enterprise Commercial organization, responsible for leading deal-making, negotiation, and collaboration activities to drive revenue growth and customer success.This role acts as a trusted advisor on commercial activities and contracting, leading internal and external sales through commercial construct and deal value proposition, while optimizing the right level of investment and customization. The Commercial Executive plays a key role in supporting AI transformation across accounts, maximizing business opportunities with new offerings (such as Copilot), and ensuring compliant, on-time deal execution. As a trusted advisor, the CE crafts and negotiates commercial solutions that are both compliant and profitable, aligning customer needs with Microsoft's business goals.

The role involves leading deal-making processes, optimizing customization through price and non-price concessions, defining complex negotiation strategies, and building trust-based relationships with stakeholders across customer, partner, and internal teams. The CE serves as a lead point for escalations and negotiations, develops and models commercial options, drives creative and transformative deal strategies, and continuously seeks revenue growth opportunities through up-selling and cross-selling — with a strong focus on supporting **AI Transformation** in every account (Copilot and new offerings).

Success is measured by impact on customer commercial strategy, achievement of quota and consumption targets, timely renewals, and compliant deal execution.

 **Responsibilities**

**Deal Making**

* Lead internal and external sales and management teams through commercial construct, optimizing for the right level of investment and customization.
* Optimize deal customization leveraging price and non-price concessions.
* Identify business opportunities that vary based on deal lifecycle and AI (Copilot and new offerings).
* Create and manage the commercial plan / contribute to the account plan for strategic accounts, mapping how to maximize qualified medium-to-complex commercial opportunities.
* Analyze customer commercial opportunity history, including discounts, concessions, and consumption across the territory.
* Anticipate and verify upcoming renewals; lead renewal processes with account teams to maximize on-time revenue and recapture rate.
* Construct compliant commercial solutions to maximize renewals.
* Identify renewal opportunities during account planning; inform strategy, coach sellers, accelerate adoption, and address deal blockers.
* Close eligible workloads and expiring contracts
* Adopt Deal Agent and adhere to Tranche Framework when launched.
* Take all relevant steps to ensure deal execution is successful.

**Negotiation**

* Define and negotiate complex commercial terms; lead the strategy for the negotiation approach by engaging with stakeholders.
* Partner with leaders when negotiating complex commercial terms, in collaboration with the account team and deal manager.
* Understand stakeholders and priorities; leverage formal negotiation strategies, anticipate potential vulnerabilities, understand customer measurement of value, and define walk-away positions.
* Consult with leaders on rhythm of negotiation team planning and reporting to stakeholders.
* Act as Trusted Advisor and Negotiation SME for deals negotiated by AEs or other stakeholders.
* Drive accountability for negotiation outcomes.
* Ensure adherence to commercial solutions policy for deal execution, including regulatory laws, local market principles, company policies, and guidance for consistent deal making.
* Prioritize "configuration" over "customization" in deals of all sizes; validate that a deployment plan is in place.

**Collaboration**

* Develop trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, partners, and Account Teams to help customers deliver their business goals and achieve Microsoft revenue targets.
* Demonstrate in-depth and strategic understanding of Microsoft licensing programs and contracting.
* Collaborate with Internal and Partner teams.
* Understand and apply the Sales Cycle Framework; share accountability with the account team to drive Security and Usage; structure deals to drive usage.
* Consult with leadership and account team to ensure customer and teams are aligned on the value proposition of commercial programs.

**Compliance & Other**

* Embody Microsoft's culture and values.
* Model integrity and ethical behavior daily; full adherence to company policies and processes.
* Complete 100% of required Compliance Trainings by due date.
* Cooperate with audits, investigations, and remediation actions; proactively identify and escalate role-inherent risks.

 **Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Law, Marketing, Finance, Communication, Education (or equivalent) or related field AND 6+ years of sales and negotiation experience (or related work / internship experience) OR 8+ years of sales and negotiation experience OR equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience with deal strategy, deal execution, and contractual negotiations.
* 5+ years of experience in customer-facing commercial roles and presenting to C-Level executives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Seasoned sales and negotiation professional, unafraid of conflict.
* Positive attitude and passion for working with customers and partners.
* Comfortable speaking at all organizational levels — from CxO to procurement / purchasing teams.
* Strategic, long-term thinker, able to analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Team player and collaborative — high-performing individualists will not succeed in this role.
* In-depth and strategic understanding of licensing, cloud principles and contracting.
* Ability to simplify complex legal and commercial constructs.
* Proficiency in consultative selling.

**Key Skills & Habits**

* Strong commercial acumen and judgment.
* Industry knowledge and ability to leverage competitive analysis to craft commercial solutions.
* Understanding of the MCEM Framework and sales process compliance.
* Ability to de-risk revenue in peak periods through on-time renewal rigor and early/right submission.
* Active interest in corporate governance and compliance.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Executive - Talent Acquisition
description:
**Executive - Talent Acquisition | SRM Tech | WFO**

**About SRM Tech**

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services.

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale.

As a Great Place to Work®-certified organization, we are committed to creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and thrive. We believe empowered individuals drive innovation, deliver value to customers, and play a meaningful role in shaping our collective success.

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

**Location**
: Chennai

**Work Mode**
: WFO

**Preferred Experience**
: 3 - 5 years

**Notice Period**
: Immediate to 15 Days

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Talent Acquisition Executive with strong expertise in sourcing and recruitment. The candidate should have hands-on experience in managing multiple hiring requirements, building quality candidate pipelines, and delivering results in a fast-paced, high-pressure recruitment environment.

**Primary Responsibilities – Sourcing & Recruitment**

* Independently source candidates for multiple technical and non-technical requirements.
* Strong hands-on experience in Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Proficiency in Boolean search, and advanced sourcing techniques.
* Understand job requirements and identify suitable candidates through effective talent mapping.
* Manage multiple and high-volume hiring demands simultaneously while maintaining profile quality.
* Screen candidates based on skills, experience, communication, salary expectations, and notice period.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for active requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of relevant profiles and drive recruitment closures within agreed timelines.

**Secondary Responsibilities – Recruitment Coordination & Operations**

* Maintain accurate candidate records and ensure timely updates in the ATS tool.
* Coordinate interview schedules, collect feedback, and follow up with candidates and hiring teams.
* Track candidates throughout the recruitment cycle, from sourcing to onboarding.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and share regular hiring updates.
* Support offer follow-ups, candidate engagement, and joining confirmations.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment processes and timely completion of recruitment activities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment with a primary focus on sourcing.
* Hands-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing platforms.
* Good knowledge of Boolean search and other search techniques.
* Practical experience working with ATS tools such as ZOHO Recruit, Workday, or similar platforms.
* Ability to handle multiple requirements and high-volume hiring demands under tight timelines.
* Strong candidate screening, communication, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Excellent time management, prioritization, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work under pressure.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience in IT, Engineering, and corporate hiring.
* Experience in client-based recruitment or recruitment consulting.
* Knowledge of salary negotiations, CTC calculations, and offer management.
* Experience in recruitment MIS, reporting, and pipeline management.

*SRM Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, without bias or discrimination, in line with applicable laws.*

* Extremely sharp attention to detail
* Great stakeholder management skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
* High energy levels, agility and adaptability
* Ability to comprehend new content and topics across different domains
* Open to travel for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s or associate degree with 4 - 7 years of relevant experience
* Proven experience and knowledge of SAP systems, modules, and functions, such as SAP FI, SAP HR, SAP MM, S4/HANA etc.
* Knowledge of multiple ERP systems, such as Oracle, Workday etc. is a plus
* Excellent knowledge of storyboarding, visual design principles, and branding guidelines
* Effective writing skills (grasp and command over English)

* Ability to articulate design decisions, suggestions and provide creative direction
* Proficiency with one or more course authoring and learning tools: SAP EnableNow, Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, WalkMe, Camtasia, Vyond, VideoScribe

* Ability to review learning deliverables developed by others
* Ability to develop learning estimations and proposals
* Excellent knowledge of assessment and evaluation methods and learning experience platforms

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with a data-driven approach to instructional design, using both qualitative and quantitative data to optimize content efficacy
* Proven project management experience to take digital learning from concept to delivery
* Knowledge of course development software and at least one Learning Management System

**What We Look For**

* Learning experts in the SAP/SI domain with commercial acumen, relevant experiences and high degree of enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment
* Knowledge and experience of working in a cross-cultural setup

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Digital Twin Modelling Engineer
description:

Junior Digital Twin Modelling Engineer

**Experience:**
0–1 Year (6 months to 1 year preferred)

**Freshers:**
Eligible to apply

**Location:**
Chennai

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Department:**
Product Development – Digital Twin & Industrial Automation

Job Overview
  

We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled Digital Twin Modelling Engineer to join our product development team.

The candidate will be responsible for developing interactive 3D digital representations of buildings, industrial facilities, machinery, equipment and infrastructure, integrated with real-time operational data, IoT devices, Building Management Systems (BMS) and AI applications.

The role offers an opportunity to work on next-generation Digital Twin, Industrial AI, Smart Buildings, Industry 4.0 and Intelligent Command & Control Centre solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop 2D and 3D digital twin models of buildings, factories, machinery and industrial infrastructure.
* Convert CAD drawings, floor plans, BIM models and engineering layouts into interactive 3D environments.
* Develop building-level, floor-level, room-level and equipment-level digital twins.
* Create optimized 3D models, textures, materials and animations.
* Integrate real-time IoT sensor data with digital twin environments.
* Develop interactive visualization of equipment status, alarms, energy consumption and operational parameters.
* Support integration with BMS, SCADA, CCTV, AI analytics and industrial automation platforms.
* Develop web-based interactive 3D visualization interfaces.
* Optimize 3D models for real-time rendering and application performance.
* Collaborate with software developers, AI engineers, IoT engineers and product development teams.
* Prepare technical documentation and maintain reusable 3D asset libraries.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have knowledge or hands-on experience in one or more of the following technologies:

3D Modelling and Design

* Blender
* Autodesk AutoCAD
* Autodesk Revit / BIM
* SketchUp
* FreeCAD
* Autodesk Fusion 360

Digital Twin and Visualization Technologies

* Three.js
* Babylon.js
* WebGL
* Unity 3D
* Unreal Engine
* NVIDIA Omniverse
* OpenUSD

Programming and Integration

* Python
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* HTML and CSS
* REST APIs
* JSON
* Basic database concepts

Preferred Additional Knowledge

* IoT and sensor data integration.
* MQTT, BACnet, Modbus and OPC UA protocols.
* Building Management Systems (BMS).
* SCADA and industrial automation.
* BIM and IFC file formats.
* GLTF, GLB, FBX, OBJ and USD file formats.
* Real-time data visualization.
* AI-based monitoring and predictive maintenance concepts.

Candidates are not expected to have expertise in all the above technologies.

Educational Qualification

B.E. / B.Tech. / B.Sc. / M.Sc. / MCA / Diploma in any of the following disciplines:

* Computer Science and Engineering
* Information Technology
* Mechanical Engineering
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Robotics and Automation
* Electronics and Communication Engineering
* Electrical and Electronics Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Architecture
* Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
* Other relevant engineering disciplines

Candidate Requirements

* Strong interest in Digital Twin technologies and 3D visualization.
* Good understanding of spatial modelling and engineering concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies independently.
* Creative thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Fresh graduates with relevant academic projects, internships, certifications or a strong 3D modelling portfolio are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Work On

* Smart Building Digital Twins.
* Industrial and Manufacturing Plant Digital Twins.
* Intelligent Building Management Systems (iBMS).
* Energy Monitoring and Optimization.
* Equipment and Asset Monitoring.
* AI-Enabled Command & Control Centres.
* Smart Factories and Industry 4.0.
* EV Depot Digital Twins.
* Real-Time Industrial Data Visualization.
* Predictive Maintenance Applications.

Selection Process

1. Resume and project portfolio screening.
2. Technical interview.
3. Practical 3D modelling or Digital Twin development assessment.
4. Final management interview.

Candidates are encouraged to submit their GitHub profile, 3D modelling portfolio, academic projects or demonstration videos along with their resume.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on innovative Digital Twin and Industrial AI products.
* Exposure to real-world industrial and enterprise projects.
* Hands-on experience with emerging visualization and simulation technologies.

title: Associate Reliability Engineer
description:

We are hiring an entry-level Associate Reliability Engineer (Contractor) to support the reliability and availability of Chargebee’s cloud infrastructure. This role involves working on live production systems, monitoring applications, and troubleshooting issues across both application and database layers.

This is a hands-on opportunity to gain real-world experience in cloud operations, DevOps practices, and large-scale system reliability.

**Note:**
This is a
**contract role**
that requires working in a
**24/7 rotational shift environment**
.

**About Chargebee**

Chargebee provides the revenue infrastructure for the world's leading AI, SaaS, and consumer subscription businesses. Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Recurring Billing Applications, placing furthest for Completeness of Vision.

* Basic proficiency in Python or Bash

* Basic knowledge or exposure to AWS

title: Application Test Environments Lead Tech Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
This is a seasoned technical professional responsible for providing end‑to‑end application support & testing for Citi’s strategic platforms, with a strong focus on Non‑Production environments (DEV / SIT / UAT ) and Testing / DevOps-enabled delivery models.
  
  
This role applies in‑depth disciplinary knowledge to support complex applications, contributes to continuous improvement of operational processes, and partners closely with Development, DevOps, Quality Assurance, Infrastructure, and Release Management teams.
  
  
The individual demonstrates strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, and operates with a moderate level of autonomy while influencing outcomes through expertise and judgment.
  
  
The role has a direct impact on application stability, release readiness, testing effectiveness, and time‑to‑market, ensuring that technology platforms meet business expectations and Citi’s risk and control standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 / Level 3 technical and business support for Citi applications across Non‑Production environments, ensuring availability, stability, and readiness for testing and deployments.
* Manage, maintain, and support application platforms and their operating environments post‑development lifecycle, with emphasis on environment stability, configuration consistency, and functional integrity.
* Perform Start‑of‑Day / End‑of‑Day checks, ongoing health monitoring, and regional handovers across global support teams.
* Conduct same‑day risk checks and reconciliations to ensure environment and application integrity.
* Support and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines across Non‑Production environments, including build failures, deployment issues, rollback scenarios, and promotion defects.
* Participate actively in application releases, including deployment coordination, validation, verification, and post‑release stabilization.
* Work closely with DevOps and Development teams to enable automation, reduce manual intervention, and improve deployment reliability.
* Support deployment dry runs, rehearsal activities, and environment readiness assessments ahead of major releases.

**Monitoring, Stability**

* Proactively monitor applications using tools such as ITRS Geneos, Splunk, Kibana, and similar platforms.
* Assess the risk and business impact of application and environment incidents, escalating appropriately in line with SLAs and Citi incident management standards.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and drive preventive actions to reduce recurring issues.
* Ensure logging, alerting, storage, and archiving procedures are implemented and functioning correctly.

Act as a technical liaison between business users, developers, infrastructure teams, and third‑party vendors.
  
  

* Support applications running on Linux platforms, databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB), middleware, and web/application servers (WebSphere, WebLogic).
* Provide middleware support including MQ, NDM, and SFTP configurations.
* Support batch scheduling and workload automation using Autosys.
* Develop and maintain support documentation, runbooks, and deployment procedures.
* Contribute to defining and improving operating standards, support processes, and controls.
* Identify opportunities to optimize application performance, efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
* Actively participate in post‑implementation reviews to ensure release objectives are met.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for assigned applications and environments.
* Provide coaching and guidance to junior analysts, contributing to team capability uplift.
* Exercise sound judgment and autonomy while operating under Citi’s risk, compliance, and control framework.
* Ensure decisions demonstrate consideration for Citi’s reputation, regulatory obligations, and client impact.

**Qualifications Required**

* 7+ years of experience in QA / Testing, Application Support, Production Support, or Technical Operations roles.
* Strong experience supporting Non‑Production environments in fast‑paced delivery models.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux operating systems.
* Proficiency with databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB).
* Experience supporting web and middleware platforms (WebSphere, WebLogic, MQ, NDM, SFTP).
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery practices.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools (Geneos, Splunk, Kibana or equivalent).
* Experience with Autosys or enterprise scheduling tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical issues to non‑technical stakeholders.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Exposure to Cloud technologies and container platforms (ECS / Kubernetes – support perspective).
* Experience working in Agile / DevOps operating models.
* Proven record of driving stability, efficiency, and automation initiatives.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**We are seeking experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Data Migration Consultants to support the migration of master, reference, and transactional data into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement(Optional). The consultants will work closely with functional, technical, business, and source-system teams to ensure that data is extracted, transformed, validated, loaded, reconciled, and signed off successfully**
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute end-to-end data migration activities for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement.
* Work with business and functional teams to identify source data, transformation rules, dependencies, and target-system requirements.
* Prepare and maintain data-migration strategies, object lists, mapping documents, conversion specifications, and reconciliation reports.
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, and duplicate analysis.
* Develop and validate Oracle data-load files using tools and methods such as FBDI, ADFdi, spreadsheet loaders, REST APIs, SOAP services, and scheduled processes.
* Support the migration of relevant data objects, including:

+ Chart of Accounts and other financial reference data
+ Suppliers, supplier sites, contacts, addresses, and bank details
+ Procurement business units, agents, categories, and approved supplier information
+ Purchase agreements, purchase orders, requisitions, and related open transactions
+ Customers, customer accounts, sites, contacts, and profiles
+ Payables and Receivables open transactions
+ General Ledger balances and journals
+ Fixed Assets and Cash Management data, where applicable

* Analyse and resolve load errors, rejected records, reference-data issues, and data-quality exceptions.
* Ensure that parent-child relationships and cross-file references remain consistent across migration files.
* Perform pre-load and post-load validations and reconcile migrated data against source-system totals.
* Support mock conversions, conference-room pilots, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, and production deployment.
* Maintain migration logs, issue trackers, control totals, exception reports, and sign-off documentation.
* Coordinate with Oracle functional and technical teams to address configuration and integration dependencies.
* Support production cutover and post-go-live data-migration activities.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement data migration.
* Experience in at least one full-cycle Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation involving data conversion.
* Practical knowledge of Oracle Fusion FBDI templates, interface tables, import processes, and error-resolution procedures.
* Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials and Procurement data structures and business processes.
* Experience with data extraction, mapping, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation.
* Ability to analyse large data files and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or invalid records.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing data extracts and reconciliation queries.
* Experience working with CSV files, Microsoft Excel, and data-transformation utilities.
* Strong understanding of data dependencies, reference keys, sequencing, and parent-child relationships.
* Ability to prepare technical design documents, mapping documents, load instructions, and reconciliation reports.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with business users, functional consultants, developers, and project management teams.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple migration objects, and meet project deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud certification in Financials, Procurement, or related areas.
* Experience migrating data from Oracle E-Business Suite or other legacy ERP applications.
* Knowledge of BI Publisher, OTBI, Oracle Integration Cloud, REST APIs, and SOAP web services.
* Experience with high-volume data migration and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting multiple mock conversions and production cutovers.
* Familiarity with data governance, audit, security, and handling sensitive financial and supplier information.

**Expected Deliverables**

* Approved data-migration strategy and object inventory
* Source-to-target mapping and transformation documents
* Validated data-load files
* Load execution and error-resolution reports
* Source-to-target reconciliation results
* Cutover plans and execution checklists
* Migration completion and business sign-off documentation

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Development Engineer 4
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Software Developer Engineering 4 to serve as the senior technical leader across a diverse portfolio of data engineering, platform engineering, and application development initiatives. This role provides technical direction, architectural governance, hands-on guidance, and mentorship for Engineering 1, Engineering 2, and Engineering 3 engineers. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in modern data engineering and software development with strong leadership capabilities. They will be responsible for driving architectural excellence, ensuring engineering best practices, mentoring teams, supporting production-critical systems, and accelerating modernization and AI-driven initiatives. This is a high-impact role supporting multiple business-critical platforms and applications across the organisation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**
Technical Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the technical authority and trusted advisor for engineering teams.
* Drive architecture and design decisions across multiple applications and platforms.
* Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding guidelines, and best practices.
* Lead technical design reviews and provide recommendations for scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Guide teams in solving complex technical and business challenges.

Solution Architecture & Design
  
  

* Design scalable and resilient data and application architectures.
* Review system designs and implementation approaches for critical initiatives.
* Ensure consistency in architectural patterns across the technology landscape.
* Drive modernization efforts involving cloud, big data, automation, and AI technologies.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Improve software quality, delivery velocity, and operational stability.
* Define and promote development standards, code review practices, and testing strategies.
* Identify and mitigate technical debt, system risks, and operational bottlenecks.
* Champion continuous improvement and engineering productivity initiatives.

Mentorship & People Development
  
  

* Mentor Engineering 1, Engineering 2, and Engineering 3 engineers.
* Provide guidance on system design, coding, troubleshooting, and technical career growth.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, learning, and collaboration.
* Build future technical leaders within the organisation.

Production Support & Operational Leadership
  
  

* Act as the senior escalation point for critical production incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive long-term corrective actions.
* Improve system observability, monitoring, resiliency, and reliability practices.
* Partner with support and operations teams to ensure service stability.

Innovation & Modernization
  
  

* Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and automation initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for innovation.
* Lead efforts involving data modernization, cloud transformation, and performance optimisation.

**Required Technical Skills**
The candidate must demonstrate strong hands-on expertise in:
  
  
Mandatory
  
  

* Java (Advanced)
* Python (Advanced)
* Apache Spark / PySpark (Advanced)
* Databricks (Advanced)
* SQL (Advanced)
* Data Engineering and Big Data Platforms
* Kafka or Streaming Technologies
* Distributed Data Processing Frameworks
* System Design and Architecture
* Performance Tuning and Troubleshooting

**Desired / Preferred**

* Apache Airflow
* Apache Hive
* Cloud Platforms (AWS preferred)
* CI/CD and DevOps Practices
* Data Lakes and Data Warehousing
* AI/ML Platform Integration
* Observability and Monitoring Tools

**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience.
* 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or acting as a technical architect/lead.
* Proven experience building and operating large-scale enterprise applications and data platforms.
* Strong experience in distributed systems, big data processing, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated success in driving complex engineering initiatives from design through production support.

Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.
* Ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on execution.

Impact of the Role
  
  
This position is critical to maintaining engineering excellence and delivery effectiveness across the organisation. The Technical Lead will:
  
  

* Ensure architectural consistency and technical governance.
* Improve delivery speed while maintaining quality and reliability.
* Reduce implementation defects through proactive technical oversight.
* Strengthen mentoring and career development for engineering teams.
* Reduce production support risks for business-critical systems.
* Accelerate modernization, automation, and AI-driven engineering initiatives.
* Drive long-term technology strategy and technical innovation.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  
Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.
  
  
**Relevant Work Experience**
7-10 Years

title: Security Specialist,AVP
description:
Join us as a Security Specialist
  
  

* We’re looking for someone to actively support a domain and our wider organisation as a subject matter expert in a security-related field
* Day-to-day, you’ll be making sure that the security implications of the backlog are understood in the right way to build security early into the design
* This is your chance to bring a competitive edge to your career profile by solving new problems and creating smarter solutions and enjoying professional development opportunities
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level

What you’ll do
  
  
In this role, you’ll make sure that decisions are based on robust data, return on investment and value measures that demonstrate thoughtful and intelligent cost management. You’ll also encourage the identification of ideas and drive the delivery of initiatives that will reduce cost and simplify our Group.
  
  
Additionally, you’ll work at a domain level to understand and make sure that robust security is continuously considered and incorporated at every stage, programme increment and Feature team delivery throughout the development lifecycle and through to support.
  
  
**You’ll Also Be Responsible For**

* Using your SME knowledge to support the wider organisation in building and operating secure services that protect both our colleagues and customers
* Collaborating with Feature teams and participating in store refinement, sprint planning and retrospective sessions
* Establishing a culture of innovation and strategic thinking that provides our Group with knowledge of the latest developments in your area of specialism
* Making sure any developments in your area of specialism are assessed and the impact on our wider organisation is appropriately communicated
* Building relationships with colleagues across our group and third-parties to make sure decisions are commercially-focused and create long-term value for our organisation

The skills you’ll need
  
  
To be successful in this role, you’ll have experience of, or a willingness to learn, risk management frameworks. You’ll also have experience of setting risk appetites and a background in defining risk policy controls. Knowledge of one, or more, security subject areas would also be advantageous.
  
  
**You’ll Also Need**

* hands-on expertise in HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk Conjur, Akeyless, OpenBao, or similar platforms. Proven ability to deploy, secure, operate, recover, and support large-scale production secrets management services. Strong incident response and troubleshooting expertise, including outage management, root cause analysis, disaster recovery, security incident remediation, and ensuring high availability of critical enterprise platforms
* Strong experience with cloud-native secrets management capabilities across AWS and GCP, including integration with applications, Kubernetes platforms, identity services, networking controls, and automation pipelines
* Experience in implementing security controls using Infrastructure-as-Code practices and tooling such as Terraform
* Good understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), DevSecOps, Kubernetes, application security, databases, and cloud-native architectures
* Knowledge of machine identities, certificate management, workload authentication, and Zero Trust security principles would be advantageous

title: Dot Net Developer
description:
**Overview**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled .NET Developer. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, coupled with knowledge of Markets domain in Kazakhstan. This role requires development of the following in-country applications:
  
  

* The in-country applications maintain several critical business functions for Markets Operations, including:

+ Downloading market data, FX, and repo deals from the Kazakhstan stock exchange and their further submission to downstream applications.
+ Downloading swap, spot, and forward deals from upstream applications and their further submission to the Kazakhstan central depository.
+ Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank.
+ Regulatory reporting to the National Bank.
+ Risk reporting to downstream applications.
+ Downloading broker deals from the Kazakhstan stock exchange and their further submission to downstream applications.
+ Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank.
+ Regulatory reporting to the National Bank.
+ Reconciliation report submission to downstream applications.

* The application's functionality is mandated by local regulations as described in PUBN-135221 “Requirements for software and hardware and other equipment necessary for carrying out activities on the securities market” and PUBN-169822 “NBK Resolution #110 dated December 24, 2025, ‘On approval of the Rules for the submission of reports by professional participants in the securities market and the unified accumulative pension fund.’”

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain responsive, user-friendly web interfaces using C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, and CSS, ensuring performance and usability standards are met.
* Design, develop, and maintain responsive, user-friendly classical windows applications using Delphi RAD Studio.
* Develop backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
* Experience in Core Java / J2EE development and proficiency with Spring Framework and Caching frameworks.
* Experience building web platforms with React/Web.
* Architect and develop scalable database schemas, stored procedures in PL/SQL and T-SQL, and functions across relational and SQL database platforms, including MSSQL and Oracle, to support application requirements.
* Create and maintain automated workflows that interact with multiple APIs, databases, and application UIs to drive system integration and process efficiency.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and analysts to translate requirements into user stories and provide technical sizing estimates to support prioritization and delivery planning.
* Design, build, and maintain RESTful microservices and backend services using .NET Core, adhering to microservices architecture principles and design patterns.
* Manage code promotion activities and SDLC compliance artifacts, ensuring all required documentation and governance checkpoints are met throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Maintain code repository hygiene and ensure developer metrics are consistently achieved across branches, commits, and version control practices.
* Participate in UAT testing cycles and resolve defects in a timely manner to protect release schedules and ensure quality delivery.
* Support CI/CD pipeline operations and DevOps tooling (Tekton, Teamcity, GitHub, uDeploy, SonarQube) to facilitate reliable, automated deployment and continuous integration practices.
* Contribute to Agile ceremonies including sprint grooming, backlog refinement, and delivery planning, taking ownership of assigned tasks through to completion.

**Qualifications**

* 4-8 years' experience in development with expertise in .NET Core, .NET Framework, C#, Angular, TypeScript, and CSS for front-end; and .NET Core, .NET Framework microservices for back-end.
* Strong hands-on experience with database design and development across MS SQL and Oracle, including schema design, stored procedures, and query optimization.
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture and design patterns, with the ability to design, build, and maintain distributed, loosely coupled services.
* Proficiency in RESTful API design, development, and integration, including experience consuming and exposing APIs across complex enterprise systems.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines, including Tekton, Teamcity, GitHub, uDeploy, SonarQube, with practical experience in deployment automation and version control workflows.
* Proven ability to translate business and functional requirements into technical user stories, provide effort estimates, and deliver code that meets project and compliance standards.
* Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within the FX and Securities Markets domain is preferred.
* Understanding of the role of National Bank, Stock Exchange, Central depository and underlying legislation in Kazakhstan is highly sought.
* Experience managing SDLC artifacts and code promotion processes in compliance-driven enterprise environments.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and OpenShift is a plus.
* Experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium) and a working knowledge of software quality assurance practices.
* Familiarity with AI fundamentals, including prompt engineering and interaction with AI/ML-integrated tooling, is a plus.

title: Senior Fusion Application Developer

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and deploying intelligent AI agents and enterprise applications that automate business processes, enhance employee and candidate experiences, and improve operational efficiency within the Oracle Fusion ecosystem.

The successful candidate will be able to independently translate business requirements into secure, scalable, production-ready technical solutions, leveraging Oracle AI Agent Studio and modern AI development frameworks.
  
  
**Required Qualifications and Technical Skills:**

* 5–8 years of hands-on software development experience, including experience with enterprise applications.
* Minimum 1 year of practical experience developing AI/Generative AI solutions or LLM-powered applications.
* Hands-on development or implementation experience with Oracle Fusion HCM.
* Experience with AI agent development, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and LLM-based application development.
* Experience deploying enterprise-grade AI applications with appropriate security, monitoring, and governance controls.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or JavaScript.
* Experience developing and consuming REST APIs, working with JSON, and implementing secure application integrations.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0 and role-based access control.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, version control, testing, debugging, and CI/CD processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex technical deliverables, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Relevant certifications in Oracle Cloud, AI/ML, Generative AI, or cloud application development.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-powered applications and intelligent agents integrated with Oracle Fusion HCM and Oracle Recruiting.
* Build, configure, customize, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows using Oracle AI Agent Studio.
* Develop custom applications, APIs, and integration components to extend Oracle Fusion HCM capabilities.
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions leveraging LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, and agent orchestration.
* Integrate AI agents with Oracle Fusion business objects, REST APIs, and enterprise services.
* Develop solutions that automate recruiting and HCM processes, improve user experiences, and streamline operational workflows.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, and development teams to translate functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Ensure AI applications adhere to enterprise security, data privacy, access control, and performance requirements.
* Perform testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of AI-powered applications and integrations.
* Contribute to technical architecture, code reviews, documentation, and software development best practices.
* Support the deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production AI solutions.
