title: Associate Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.

The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers.

  

***First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time.***

***Division:***

  

EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.

KLA's eBeam Division is seeking a passionate software Engineer to join us in delivering high quality solutions for our current and future generation products in our portfolio. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be working in teams that build customer critical User interface and Business logic software solutions having a direct impact on the semi-conductor manufacturing processes.

Do you consider yourself as a big picture thinker with solid fundamentals of computer science; an innovator with a curiosity about connecting the dots? Someone who loves to dive deep and is keen on delivering indispensable value to customers? If this sounds like you! We strongly believe you to be a perfect fit for this role. You will work alongside a team of impactful individuals working with outstanding talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups.

You will have the opportunity to learn, design, lead feature development, contribute and collaborate in developing end-to-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about writing high performing code and would be keen on applying and advocating clean coding practices.

  

**The role would require the following key skills:**
----------------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Expert level experience** in working with **Microsoft .Net and/or C++** programming.
* Solid **Object oriented programming** fundamentals.
* Be responsible for the analysis and addressing of complex requirements in the current software systems for usability and performance.
* Be responsible for developing **innovative architectures** , design and prototypes and working on solutions **for new concepts** that would scale for multiple products.
* Interest and Ability to uncover root causes, devise and drive innovative analyses and solve difficult problems that span whole systems or organizations is crucial.
* **Good debugging skills** in a complex software setup involving multi-process/multiple systems in Windows environment with good OS concepts
* Knowledge of **Semiconductor Factory Automation systems** and standards is an added advantage.
* Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering practices.
Strong verbal and written communication and team-work skills  

  

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

  

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

title: Senior Corporate Trainer
description:
Module 1: Cloud and AI Foundations on Google Cloud

**Goal:**
Give everyone the same technical starting point on Google Cloud (GCP) and its AI tools.

**What you learn**

* Core GCP services: compute, storage, networking, IAM
* Managed services vs. custom infrastructure
* Vertex AI, pre-built models, AutoML and custom training
* Working in Vertex AI Workbench notebooks

**Activities**

1. Set up the lab, connect to BigQuery, run a sample query and review IAM roles.
2. In pairs, map where Hartford India sits on an AI maturity scale. The results feed the capstone.

**Outcome:**
A working Vertex AI environment, a shared vocabulary and an AI maturity map.

Module 2: GenAI, Embeddings and RAG

**Goal:**
Learn how large language models connect to company data like policies, claims and underwriting guidelines.

**What you learn**

* How a GenAI app is built: model, prompt, retrieval and response
* Embeddings: "water damage", "flood loss" and "pipe burst" are grouped by meaning
* RAG with BigQuery Vector Search for grounded, auditable answers

**Activities**

1. Build a GenAI app with no retrieval and judge its answers.
2. Build a full RAG pipeline on Hartford-style documents and compare grounded vs. ungrounded answers.
3. Diagnose three faults (poor chunking, embedding mismatch, missing grounding instruction) and fix them.

**Outcome:**
A working RAG pipeline and the ability to spot why RAG fails. The Claims Intelligence Assistant is scoped as a real use case.

Module 3: Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems

**Goal:**
Build agents that decide, use tools and act, using Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK).

**What you learn**

* What makes a system agentic: tools, memory, planning, execution
* Multi-agent setups on Agent Engine
* Production concerns: speed, reliability, fallback and cost
* Four design patterns: orchestrator-specialist, pipeline, parallel fan-out, human-in-the-loop

**Activities**

1. Build a Policy Lookup Agent with two tools and test where it fails.
2. Build a Claims Triage system: an Intake Agent sorts claims as standard or complex, and a Coverage Assessment Agent gives a preliminary decision with a confidence score.
3. Choose the right design pattern for three Hartford use cases.

**Outcome:**
A deployed multi-agent system and the skill to question agentic proposals.

Module 4: Agent Evaluation and AI Economics

**Goal:**
Learn to check whether an agent works and what it costs to run.

**What you learn**

* Five evaluation checks: task completion, tool choice, output quality, speed under load, how failures happen
* Cost drivers: model usage, embeddings and retrieval, extra agent steps, infrastructure
* Build vs. Buy decisions for AI tools

**Activities**

1. Test the Claims Triage agent on 20 sample claims, score it, then break a tool on purpose to see if the tests catch it.
2. Model costs at 200, 2,000 and 20,000 claims per day and recommend the cheaper design.
3. Make Build vs. Buy calls on observability, vector search and agent frameworks.

**Outcome:**
An evaluation pipeline, a cost model and a decision framework.

Module 5: Production ML, Responsible AI and Governance

**Goal:**
Learn what leaders must oversee once AI is live.

**What you learn**

* Drift, retraining and what to check before approving a deployment
* Responsible AI: fairness, explainability, privacy (including India's DPDP Act) and safety
* Security threats such as prompt injection, and Model Armor as protection
* Safe release practices: CI/CD, versioning, canary releases, rollback
* Reading AI observability reports

**Activities**

1. Audit an underwriting model for fairness, explainability and privacy, and write a one-page Responsible AI Assessment.
2. Set up Model Armor on the Claims Triage system and test it with adversarial inputs.

**Outcome:**
A reusable assessment framework, a monitoring dashboard and a first-draft AI Governance Framework.

Module 6: Capstone

**Goal:**
Deliver a production-ready agentic AI system on Vertex AI.

**Time:**
10 hours of facilitated sessions plus 40 hours of independent work.

**You deliver**

* A working system with at least two coordinating agents
* A design pattern document
* A Responsible AI Assessment
* A production readiness checklist (logging, monitoring, Model Armor, fallback)
* A live demo and 15-minute presentation

**Sessions**

* **Kick-off (4 hrs):**
  Present your idea and get scope approved.
* **Check-in 1 (2 hrs):**
  Demo the core pipeline and review readiness.
* **Check-in 2 (2 hrs):**
  Near-final walkthrough and final adjustments.
* **Demo Day (2 hrs):**
  15-minute presentation and 10 minutes of panel questions from Hartford India leadership and HCL GUVI.

**The opportunity**
Join a Financial Crime Technology team delivering enterprise solutions for global financial services clients. The role requires strong hands-on engineering capability across NICE Actimize, Java, advanced SQL, and cloud platforms, supported by practical Financial Crime Compliance domain knowledge. The successful candidate will contribute to solution design, development, integration, deployment, optimization, and production support while guiding junior engineers and working directly with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with proven experience implementing or supporting NICE Actimize solutions and building Java-based services and integrations. The role involves working with customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud use cases. Cloud and domain experience are mandatory. AI skills are an added advantage for accelerating engineering, analytics, documentation, testing, and investigation-support use cases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, develop, enhance, and support NICE Actimize solutions and related Financial Crime applications.
* Build and maintain Java applications, microservices, REST APIs, batch components, and integration services.
* Develop complex and optimized SQL for data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, alerting, investigation, and reporting use cases.
* Integrate Actimize with upstream and downstream systems, including customer, account, transaction, case-management, screening, and reporting platforms.
* Deploy and support applications and data workloads on Azure, AWS, or GCP using appropriate cloud-native services.
* Translate compliance requirements into technical designs, rules, scenarios, data mappings, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform performance tuning, defect analysis, root-cause analysis, code reviews, unit testing, release support, and production troubleshooting.
* Ensure secure coding, auditability, data protection, logging, monitoring, version control, and CI/CD practices.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, solution architects, data engineers, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and take ownership of assigned modules and delivery outcomes.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Actimize: Strong hands-on experience with NICE Actimize implementation, configuration, customization, integration, enhancement, or production support. Experience should relate to Financial Crime solutions such as Transaction Monitoring, AML, sanctions screening, fraud, alerting, or case management.
* Java: Strong hands-on development experience with Core Java, object-oriented programming, collections, exception handling, multithreading fundamentals, Spring Boot, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, stored procedures, query optimization, reconciliation, and high-volume data analysis.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Experience must include developing, deploying, integrating, monitoring, or supporting applications and data workloads in a cloud environment.
* Financial Crime domain: Mandatory delivery experience in one or more of KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud, with working knowledge of alerts, cases, investigations, rules or scenarios, regulatory controls, and financial crime data.
* Engineering practices: Git, Maven or Gradle, unit testing, code review, debugging, secure development, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and production support.

**Actimize and Financial Crime knowledge**

* Actimize platform: Practical understanding of Actimize solution components, data flows, interfaces, alert generation, case workflows, rule or scenario changes, deployment, and operational support.
* Transaction Monitoring / AML: Scenario logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, false-positive analysis, investigations, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**AI Skills – Added Advantage**

* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent for code generation, refactoring, testing, and documentation, with appropriate human review and secure-use practices.
* Understanding of generative AI and large language model concepts, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and API-based integration.
* Exposure to Python-based AI or machine-learning workflows, model evaluation, or analytics for anomaly detection, alert prioritization, investigation support, or false-positive reduction.
* Ability to identify responsible AI use cases while considering explainability, data privacy, security, model risk, auditability, and regulatory expectations.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, or enterprise messaging and event-driven architecture.
* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and deployment tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with data platforms or processing tools such as Spark, Databricks, or cloud-native data services.
* Familiarity with observability tools, application performance monitoring, and structured production-support processes.
* Strong communication, estimation, technical documentation, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery skills.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 4+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, financial crime technology, Actimize delivery, application development, or production engineering.
* Eligibility: Candidates with less than 4 years of relevant professional experience will not be considered.
* Mandatory combination: Actimize, Java, SQL, cloud, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience are all required.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliable Actimize enhancements and integrations delivered with production-quality Java and SQL.
* Clear understanding of the compliance objective, data lineage, operational controls, and regulatory context behind each solution.
* Ownership of design, development, testing, deployment, incident resolution, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Practical use of cloud and AI capabilities without compromising security, explainability, auditability, or maintainability.

**What Working At EY Offers**

* You will work on meaningful Financial Crime Technology assignments in an interdisciplinary environment that values quality, practical learning, coaching, collaboration, technical ownership, and knowledge exchange. The role provides opportunities to deepen expertise across Actimize, modern Java engineering, cloud delivery, and responsible AI-enabled solutions.
* Apply only if you meet the 4+ years requirement and all mandatory skill and domain criteria.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.
  
  
We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.
  
  
You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
* Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
* Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

**About The Team**
The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

title: Sr. Consultant - Advanced Analytics
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte's clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success-and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today's world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
Our Regulatory Risk & Forensic professionals help organizations address complex regulatory, financial, and operational risks—from financial crime, fraud, and anti-money laundering to investigations, disputes, discovery, and regulatory compliance. We combine deep industry and forensic expertise with data, AI, GenAI, and advanced analytics to help clients identify and investigate misconduct, strengthen compliance and control environments, and respond to regulatory and business challenges. Our teams support clients through transformation, remediation, and ongoing risk management, turning complex data and emerging technologies into actionable insights that help prevent and address risk.
  
  
**Work you'll do**

* Analyze client requirements, perform gap analysis, and translate business needs into AI, GenAI, data, and analytics solutions.

**The team**
Regulatory Risk & Forensic
  
  
We help clients uncover, understand, and address complex risk and forensic challenges. Combining deep domain expertise with AI, GenAI, and advanced analytics, we turn data into insight and action—strengthening resilience in a rapidly changing world.
  
  
At Deloitte, we are creating a world-class Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) capability to enhance existing services and empower our clients. Our focus is on bringing data, AI/ML, and technology together with our deep expertise in multiple industries to drive new product development and significant automation/efficiencies.
  
  
We are seeking to grow our team with brilliant and diverse contributors with strong technical ability. We are looking for talented Machine Learning Engineers with experience in software engineering and applying machine learning to solve complex problems. Ideal candidates will have experience with a variety of machine learning methods, with demonstrated depth in at least one area. Candidates should have experience delivering stable, high-performance production code and be eager to contribute significantly as part of a team.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore**
**Shift Timings: Regular shift**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6–8 years of experience in data science, machine learning, generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), advanced analytics, data engineering, or artificial intelligence solution development, including management, processing, and analysis of transactional and historical data. Project experience in banking, financial crime/anti-money laundering (AML), fraud, forensic investigations, internal audit, regulatory compliance, risk management, cybersecurity, or accounting, including application of AI/GenAI to regulatory, risk, compliance, or investigative use cases.
* Experience using Python and at least one of R, Java, or C++; Structured Query Language (SQL) for queries, stored procedures, views, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and performance tuning; and Power BI or Tableau for dashboard development.
* Experience translating client and business requirements into artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) and analytics solutions through requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and documentation.
* Experience building machine learning models using data preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation with scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
* Experience developing generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and large language model (LLM) solutions using prompt engineering, structured prompting, grounding, response evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or model customization/fine-tuning; and integrating models into enterprise applications and business workflows through application programming interfaces (APIs) and orchestration frameworks.

Experience addressing scalability, reliability, security, observability, performance, latency, and cost optimization in production AI systems; applying Responsible AI practices, including bias detection, fairness assessments, and compliance controls; and holding a certification in AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, AI/ML, or GenAI.

Preferred:

* Experience explaining financial modeling and valuation concepts in client-facing presentations.
* Experience managing projects and delivering training or mentoring.

That covers whether buildings are safe, clean and sustainable, whether people have the right space at the right time, and how employees rate their workplace experience. You'll build interactive dashboards in Amazon QuickSight. You'll also make it easier for teams to answer their own questions without waiting on a report, and you'll prepare well-governed data for GenAI tools, apps and automated workflows.This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll take projects from the first conversation with a business partner all the way to production, often with several running at once. You'll work alongside data engineers and fellow BI engineers. If you enjoy trying new AI tools and working out where they fit into everyday work, you'll have room to do that here.Key job responsibilities Design and build large-scale analytical data models for one of Amazon's most complex real estate data ecosystems Own the semantic and metric layer that serves as the single source of truth for GREF KPIs: Customer Feedback; Safe, Clean and Sustainable Buildings; Right People, Place and Time; and Right Customer Experience Partner with Operations, Finance, Engineering and Product teams to turn business needs into analytics solutions with measurable outcomes, and improve GREF self-serve analytics Build interactive dashboards and reports in Amazon QuickSight that give GREF customers actionable insights Make GREF data AI-ready: governed, high-quality and discoverable datasets that power apps, workflows and GenAI applications Lead projects end to end, from requirements and design to production, across multiple concurrent projects Work with technology teams on data engineering, platform capabilities, tooling, data governance and data quality, and keep learning new AI tools to find where they fit in current workflowsA day in the lifeYour main focus is building trusted, well-defined data for our real estate and workplace domains, and making sure it stays reliable in production.A typical morning might start with a data issue in your domain that our on-call engineer has flagged and needs your help fixing. Once the production issue is resolved, you'll get back to learning the business and functional side of your domain so you can refine the design of a core dataset that teams will use as their single source of truth. You'll run tests in Redshift to check that your proposal holds up, then write up your findings for review with the team and leadership.In the afternoon, you might work on an operational tool that cuts the time the team spends on on-call support. Some evenings, you'll join a call with stakeholders in other regions to agree on requirements and metrics, and to plan a phased delivery of your data solution.Outside the regular work, you'll get time to try new AI tools and show the team what works, review a teammate's data model or dashboard, and help partner teams set up their own reports so they don't have to wait on us.About The TeamWe're the data and analytics team within the technology group that supports Amazon's corporate real estate and workplace organization. title: Senior Software Engineer - AI First (Agentic AI / GenAI)
description:
**About the Company**

Bonterra

**About the Role**

Bonterra is looking for an AI-first Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and ship software by orchestrating AI coding agents across the full development lifecycle. This role is intentionally language and stack agnostic: rather than being defined by expertise in a single programming language, the ideal candidate uses AI tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to work productively across whatever languages, frameworks, and systems a given team needs, from backend services and APIs to front-end applications, data pipelines, and infrastructure automation. You will take ownership of complex technical problems end to end, using AI as a force multiplier for planning, implementation, testing, and review, while retaining full engineering accountability for the quality, security, and reliability of everything you and your agents ship.

**Responsibilities**

**AI-ORCHESTRATED SOFTWARE DELIVERY (45%)**

* Designs, builds, tests, and ships production-quality features and services end to end, using AI coding agents to plan, scaffold, implement, and validate work throughout the development lifecycle.
* Breaks product and technical requirements into discrete units of work that can be delegated to, or executed in partnership with, AI agents, then reviews and refines the resulting output for correctness, security, and maintainability before it reaches production.
* Selects the language, framework, and architecture best suited to each problem, using AI assisted tooling enables productive work across many stacks (for example, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#, Go, Ruby, PHP, or SQL/PL-SQL).
* Builds and maintains REST and/or GraphQL APIs, relational database schemas and migrations, and event-driven or serverless integrations (for example, AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SQS) as required by the assigned team's platform.
* Troubleshoots and resolves production issues, balancing the speed of AI-assisted iteration with the rigor Bonterra's customer-facing systems require.

**TECHNICAL DESIGN & SYSTEM OWNERSHIP (20%)**

* Owns complex technical challenges from design through delivery, authoring technical design documents and proposing architecture that other engineers, and AI agents, can build against.
* Evaluates tradeoffs between build speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and makes sound engineering decisions under ambiguity.
* Maintains and modernizes existing systems, including legacy codebases, ensuring stability while incrementally improving code health.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION (15%)**

* Partners daily with product managers, designers, architects, and fellow engineers to translate business requirements into working software, participating in sprint planning, ticket refinement, and demos.
* Collaborates with DevOps and platform teams on CI/CD pipelines, deployment practices, and infrastructure needs.
* Communicates technical concepts, tradeoffs, and AI-assisted workflows clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**CODE QUALITY, REVIEW & MENTORSHIP (10%)**

* Reviews code, both human-written and AI-generated, from peers, providing thoughtful and constructive feedback that upholds Bonterra's engineering standards.
* Mentors other engineers on effective AI-assisted development practices, secure coding, and testing discipline through pairing, code review, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

**AI TOOLING EVALUATION & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT (10%)**

* Stays current on emerging AI coding assistants, agent-orchestration frameworks, and related tooling, proactively evaluating and recommending tools that improve team velocity and quality.
* Identifies opportunities to automate manual engineering or operational workflows using AI and agentic approaches.

**KEY BEHAVIORS -- THE "HOW"**

* Treats AI agents as force multipliers while maintaining full accountability for the quality, security, and correctness of anything shipped to production, whether written by a human or an agent.
* Demonstrates a bias to action and comfort with ambiguity, iterating quickly while still applying sound engineering judgment.
* Communicates openly and proactively, sharing context, blockers, and learnings with teammates and stakeholders.
* Approaches new languages, frameworks, and systems with curiosity rather than attachment to a particular stack.
* Gives and receives feedback constructively, contributing to an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.

**OUTCOME EXPECTATIONS -- THE "IMPACT"**

* Ships secure, reliable, production-quality software faster by effectively orchestrating AI coding agents across the development lifecycle.
* Reduces manual engineering and operational toil through automation and thoughtful tooling choices.
* Delivers on product and technical requirements regardless of the underlying programming language or technology stack.
* Elevates the quality and velocity of the broader engineering team through mentorship, code review, and shared AI-assisted best practices.
* Physical Requirements & Work Environment
* Office Environment: This is a hybrid role with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office.
* Travel Requirement: Up to 10% of the time.

**Qualifications**

**Required Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to plan, implement, test, and ship real features, not just for autocomplete.
* Professional proficiency in at least one modern programming language (for example, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go, Ruby, or PHP) and a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar languages or frameworks with the help of AI tooling.
* Experience designing and building REST and/or GraphQL APIs and working with relational databases, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent), CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based version control and code review workflows.
* Solid grounding in software design patterns, data structures, and test-driven development.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound implementation decisions with incomplete information.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Office Environment:**

This is a hybrid role with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office.

**Travel Requirement:**

Up to 10% of the time.

title: Software Engineer, Senior- .Net
description:
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Location:**

**Description**
We are looking for a Senior Software Developer in India with 8+ years of full stack experience and hands-on expertise in agentic AI. Build LLM-powered agents that plan, call tools and APIs, and complete multi-step workflows across enterprise systems. Have to mentor engineers and work with product owners, QA, and support teams.
  
  
**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**

* Build and deploy agentic AI solutions in which LLM-powered agents plan tasks, call tools and APIs, and complete multi-step workflows.
* Develop agents using Amazon Bedrock Agents, Azure OpenAI, or similar frameworks, with tool and function calling.
* Build RAG pipelines with embeddings and vector databases so agents can use accurate, current enterprise knowledge.
* Integrate agents with enterprise systems through REST APIs, with secure authentication, error handling, and logging.
* Apply guardrails, PII masking, and access controls so agents only act on data the user is entitled to, in line with compliance.
* Test and evaluate agents with automated test cases, output validation, and quality metrics, and monitor performance, cost, and drift in production.
* Develop and maintain the supporting full stack services (C#/.NET, Angular, SQL/PostgreSQL), including CI/CD pipelines and code reviews.
* Mentor developers, promote safe use of AI coding assistants, and evaluate emerging agentic AI capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of full stack development experience, with multiple enterprise applications delivered to production.
* Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications or agents, including tool and function calling, prompt engineering, and RAG.
* Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or similar generative AI platforms.
* Strong back-end skills in C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core, Web API) or an equivalent enterprise stack.
* Strong front-end skills in Angular or similar, with TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid experience with SQL Server or PostgreSQL and building secure REST APIs (OAuth, JWT).
* Experience with AWS or Azure, CI/CD, and Git.
* Understanding of AI risks such as hallucination, bias, prompt injection, and data leakage, and how to mitigate them.
* Experience mentoring developers in Agile/Scrum teams, with strong communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration (for example, Bedrock Agents, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LangGraph) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with vector databases and evaluating AI output quality.
* Python experience for AI development and automation.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and serverless or event-driven architectures.
* Awareness of data protection and responsible AI practices.

description:

*all*
.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* You will work closely with multiple teams that make up IT, Information security and Technology to drive impactful change.
* Design, engineering and implementation of application security solutions in a scalable way for a worldwide enterprise.
* Design, build, and maintain REST APIs and backend services in C# / ASP.NET Core 8
* Apply SOLID principles and clean dependency-injection patterns to keep the codebase Reusable and maintainable
* Work with Azure services directly: App Service, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Application Insights, Static Web apps and API Management
* Write and maintain unit tests, and participate in code review
* Diagnose and fix performance/reliability issues — async/await correctness, caching strategy (Redis), resiliency (retries/timeouts)
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams; contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar) in day-to-day development, with the judgment to validate, test, and refactor AI-generated code

**Qualification / Requirements**

* 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, primarily in C# / .NET
* Solid hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core (Web API) — understands middleware, DI container, configuration/options pattern
* Practical understanding of SOLID principles and object-oriented design — can explain them and, more importantly, apply them when reviewing or refactoring real code
* Experience with Azure cloud services: App Service, Key Vault (or equivalent secrets management), Blob Storage, Azure Managed Instance DB, Web Jobs & Functions and Application Insights (or comparable APM/logging)
* Comfortable with Asynchronous Implementations
* Experience consuming and building REST APIs
* Familiar with caching (Redis or similar distributed cache) and when to use it
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server — can write and reason about queries, joins, and simple schema changes; understands parameterization and basic performance/indexing concepts and Locking
* Basic working knowledge of Angular — comfortable navigating components/services, calling REST APIs, and making small UI changes in an existing Angular app
* Unit testing experience (xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest) with mocking frameworks (Moq or similar)
* Git-based version control and CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred)

**Nice to Have**




+ Exposure to API gateways (Apigee, Azure APIM)
+ Experience modernizing or interoperating with legacy .NET Framework codebases (e.g., migrating from .NET Framework 4.x to .NET 8)
+ Familiarity with IoC containers beyond built-in DI (e.g., Unity, Autofac)
+ Understanding of resiliency patterns (retry, circuit breaker — e.g., Polly)
+ Security-conscious mindset — has caught or fixed issues like disabled token validation, hardcoded secrets, or missing authorization checks in a past role
+ Prior experience in a regulated/enterprise manufacturing or facilities-domain environment
+ AZ-204 Azure developer or similar certification.

*for all*
. Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

Enterprise Technology is building the core AI-native engineering capabilities needed to improve how we design, build, test, and ship software. This role will help apply AI-assisted engineering across Enterprise Technology projects while maintaining strong quality, security, and production-readiness standards.
  
  
You will build production software, direct AI coding agents, review AI-generated work, improve delivery practices, and help turn what works into reusable patterns for future Enterprise Technology initiatives.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Build and ship production software for Enterprise Technology initiatives, including services, APIs, data models, user interfaces, integrations, tests, and operational tooling.
* Direct AI coding agents by writing clear specs, acceptance criteria, implementation plans, and verification steps.

* Design and implement integration-heavy, data-intensive, and workflow-driven systems for enterprise applications and operational platforms.
* Apply and extend AI-assisted engineering tooling, including coding-agent workflows, repo access patterns, context setup, automated verification, and reusable delivery templates.
* Track practical delivery metrics such as cycle time, quality, rework, test coverage, cost, adoption, and operational health.
* Partner with Product, Security, business stakeholders, and Enterprise Technology teams to deliver secure, maintainable software.
* Improve testing, review, observability, documentation, and operational practices for AI-assisted delivery.

* 12+ years of experience building and shipping production software as a hands-on engineer, senior IC, technical lead, or Staff-level contributor.
* Strong production experience with Python and/or TypeScript across backend, frontend, data, API, or cloud-native systems.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding agents or tools such as Claude Code, Google Antigravity, Codex, Cursor, or similar systems.
* Strong engineering judgment for reviewing AI-generated code and knowing where human oversight is required.
* Experience building or integrating services, APIs, relational data stores, event-driven systems, and user-facing workflows.

* Clear written and verbal communication with engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

* Experience with enterprise systems, business applications, workflow platforms, data platforms, or internal tools.
* Experience with media, streaming, content platforms, or complex business domains.
* Experience building developer-facing tools, templates, or internal platforms that help engineers ship software faster and more safely.
* Experience with LLM or agent observability tools such as Datadog, LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar systems.
* Experience with data migration, compliance-sensitive systems, SOX controls, audit-heavy environments, or complex enterprise integrations.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Processing
description:
**Aliases:**
Principal Engineer, Senior Principal Engineer, Technical Architect, Principal Architect, Enterprise Architect (Engineering), Senior Technical Architect, Distinguished Engineer or Chief Architect at a smaller company
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
  
  
**This opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  
The Data Platform group in India owns parts of the pipeline that ingests, processes, stores, and serves healthcare data at a scale very few organizations operate at. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same engineering rigor that has transformed other industries, and that is the work: correctness under volume, reliability under failure, and speed without cutting the corners that regulated health data does not allow anyone to cut.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define architecture across ingestion, processing, storage, serving, governance, and observability for the India-owned parts of the platform, aligned with Seattle.
* Set multi-platform technical strategy along with the sequencing that makes it achievable rather than aspirational.
* Remain hands-on where it counts: critical designs, prototypes, deep reviews, and the worst production problems.
* Resolve technical disagreements that span teams and write down the decision and it's reasoning so that it holds afterwards.
* Establish architecture governance that engineers experience as a useful framework.
* Raise the technical bar of the IDC through hiring, interview calibration, and mentoring of Senior and SDE3 engineers.

* Extensive experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of system design, architectural patterns, design principles, and modern application development practices.
* Experience designing scalable, highly available, secure, and resilient cloud-native applications.
* Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, query optimization, and transaction management.
* Experience developing concurrent or multithreaded applications and troubleshooting performance issues.
* Hands-on experience with messaging and event-streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently drive complex technical initiatives from concept through delivery.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, cross-team collaboration, and the ability to influence engineering decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders, peer teams, and customers.
* A commitment to sound software engineering practices, high-quality code, continuous learning, and meeting delivery commitments without compromising quality.
* Ability to understand customer deployment scenarios, operational requirements, and production support challenges.

**Nice-to-Have Skills – AI And Generative AI**

* Hands-on experience building applications powered by Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Experience developing AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, and tool integrations.

In Microsoft 365 Copilot, we are reimagining search with AI. Copilot Search understands what you mean, brings together email, files, chats, meetings and people, and composes a grounded answer with sources you can trust, right alongside the results you need to go deeper. We are looking for a

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of front-end or full-stack development experience, including hands-on delivery of Sitecore-based digital experiences and AI-enabled capabilities in enterprise environments.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Software Development Engineer, DSP Tech
description:
**Description**
Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?
  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems
* Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed
* Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities
* Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services
* Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability
* Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions

A day in the life
  
  
You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries.
  
  
**About The Team**
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.
  
  
We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Python, Cloud & GenAI)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
  
  
We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity.
  
  
The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact.
  
  
As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity.
  
  
API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership.
  
  
System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures.
  
  
Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards.
  
  
Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication.
  
  
Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads.
  
  
Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs.
  
  
Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles.
  
  
Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery.
  
  
Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns.
  
  
LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization.
  
  
RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality.
  
  
AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks.
  
  
Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management.
  
  
Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  
  
Mentoring & Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs and code, raise engineering quality across the team, and help engineers adopt modern Python, cloud, and AI engineering practices.
  
  
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, platform teams, security, architecture, product management, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
Technical Communication: Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and capabilities to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders with clarity and precision.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Experience: Typically 7+ years of software, platform, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including significant hands-on ownership of production systems and technical architecture. Demonstrated experience building production cloud-native applications on GCP and working with Generative AI or ML systems is required. Experience may span traditional software/platform engineering and newer AI engineering; candidates are not expected to have spent an unrealistic number of years specifically working with Generative AI.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently design complex systems, lead technical execution across multiple engineers or teams, influence architecture, and convert emerging technologies into reliable enterprise capabilities.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong production software engineering fundamentals. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asyncio, pytest, and modern Python tooling. Familiarity with Java, Go, TypeScript, or another production language is advantageous.
  
  
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, API design, distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous programming, software architecture, automated testing, debugging, Git, and engineering best practices.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Build, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns including containerization, serverless, event-driven design, service mesh, autoscaling, and infrastructure as code. Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, inference, and modern foundation-model architectures.
  
  
Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable modern ML/AI frameworks.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience designing and building production applications using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic AI patterns.
  
  
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging for production systems.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer (Terraform + Kubernetes) – JR 1505760
description:
**JOB TITLE**

Azure DevOps Engineer (Terraform + Kubernetes) – JR 1505760

**LOCATION**

Hyderabad / Noida / Gurugram

**WORKPLACE TYPE**

On-site (client location)

**EMPLOYMENT TYPE**

Contract – 12 months

**EXPERIENCE**

5–8 years

**SHIFT**

1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST

**JOINING**

Immediate joiners only (30-day notice profiles will not be considered)

------------------------------------------------------------

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Hiring Azure DevOps Engineers to own the non-production environments for a large enterprise platform. You will build and run fully automated Azure DevOps and Terraform-based pipelines for both application and infrastructure, manage Kubernetes workloads, and fix issues during development, performance testing and release preparation so that every release reaches production clean.

This is a hands-on engineering role. The interview process includes live technical exercises and scenario-based questions, such as writing Terraform modules, building Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and explaining Kubernetes networking. Candidates with only conceptual or keyword-level knowledge will not be shortlisted.

Interview process: 1 technical round followed by 2 client rounds.

------------------------------------------------------------

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Pipeline Ownership

- Build, manage and support Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for both application and infrastructure in non-production environments

- Keep all deployments fully automated through pipelines with designated approvers – no manual deployments

- Write and maintain YAML pipelines, templates, stages, environments and approval gates

Infrastructure as Code

- Create and maintain all infrastructure using Terraform – every infrastructure creation and deployment runs through Terraform

- Write reusable Terraform modules, manage state and variables, and promote changes across environments

- Apply platform and version upgrades when security or platform issues arise (for example, vulnerabilities in PHP or Node.js)

Kubernetes Platform

- Manage Kubernetes workloads (AKS) in non-production environments

- Troubleshoot pods, services, ingress, networking, resource limits and scaling

- Fix issues found during development, performance testing and release preparation – such as unavailable services, cache problems and memory exhaustion – before they reach production

Security and Release Practices

- Manage secrets securely across pipelines and environments (Azure Key Vault, variable groups, service connections)

- Follow release practices and prepare a rollback plan for every change

- Apply security patching and version upgrades on time

Environment Boundaries

- Work only in non-production environments (no access to production services, databases or infrastructure)

- Hand over cleanly to the production support / SRE team for production releases

------------------------------------------------------------

**MUST-HAVE SKILLS**

- 5+ years in DevOps / cloud engineering, with strong hands-on Azure DevOps CI/CD (YAML pipelines, releases, approvals)

- Strong hands-on Terraform: writing modules, managing state, deploying Azure infrastructure end to end

- Hands-on Kubernetes (AKS preferred): deployments, services, ingress and Kubernetes networking

- Secret management in pipelines and environments

- Release practices and rollback planning

**GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS**

- Kafka operations: topics, partitions, consumer lag and offsets

- Bash / Shell and PowerShell scripting

- SRE practices and Datadog monitoring

- Security patching and version upgrades (PHP, Node.js)

- Helm, Docker, Azure Key Vault

- Azure, Terraform or Kubernetes certifications (AZ-400, AZ-104, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CKA/CKAD)

Keywords: Azure DevOps, ADO, YAML pipelines, CI/CD, Terraform, IaC, Kubernetes, AKS, Helm, Docker, Azure, Key Vault, Kafka, Bash, PowerShell, SRE, Datadog, DevOps Engineer

------------------------------------------------------------

**WHAT WE OFFER**

- 12-month contract on a large enterprise DevOps programme

- Hands-on ownership of pipelines, IaC and Kubernetes environments

- Competitive monthly contract rate

------------------------------------------------------------

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply here on LinkedIn, or email your updated CV to saurav@spydra.app with the subject:

**"Azure DevOps Engineer (1505760) – [Your Name] – [Years of Experience]"**

**Please include:**

1. Total experience and hands-on experience in Azure DevOps, Terraform and Kubernetes (years for each)

2. Current location and preferred location (Hyderabad / Noida / Gurugram)

3. Notice period or last working day

4. Current CTC and expected rate per month

5. Have you previously worked with or applied to this client through any vendor? (Yes/No)

* Note: Immediate joiners only. Please highlight your actual hands-on work (projects, pipelines, Terraform modules, AKS clusters) in your CV, as the technical rounds will test it in detail.
