title: Senior Specialist , Data Science
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist – Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA)**
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. Our Digital Human Health (DHH) organization brings this purpose to life by transforming how we understand patients, markets, customers, and brands, and by leveraging data, analytics, and technology to enable better, faster, value-driven decisions.
  
  
The Senior Specialist – Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA), based out in India, will serve as a strategic thought partner and team leader supporting US and global business teams. Leading across products and therapeutic areas, the individual will drive a high-performing analytical team to act as a strategic thought partner and help framing critical business questions, integrate diverse healthcare and commercial analytics into actionable recommendations across the commercial lifecycle—from understanding disease and patient flows through opportunity assessment, launch excellence, and brand performance. As a key leadership figure within DHH India, the candidate will influence senior stakeholders, navigate organizational maturity, drive talent strategy and AI-enabled capability building, cross-geography alignment, and the execution of high-impact strategic initiatives that advance our commercial capabilities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Specialist will lead a team of analytical professionals, partnering with US and global brand leaders, and cross-functional partners to translate strategic priorities and ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and decision-ready recommendations. Rather than focusing on individual analyses or isolated datasets, the individual will guide their team to connect insights across multiple analytical sources and capabilities to develop an integrated perspective on patients, markets, competitors, and brand performance, answering three fundamental questions What is happening? Why is it happening? And what should we consider doing next?
  
  
This role requires deep therapeutic-area domain expertise, pharmaceutical commercial acumen, unstructured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and analytical depth. Leading initiatives end-to-end, the Senior Specialist will manage a strategic analytical roadmap, partner closely with adjacent commercial capabilities—including forecasting, market research, and competitive intelligence—to develop a unified brand perspective. Crucially, the individual will serve as a key driver of DHH and BSA enterprise capability. They will actively lead cross-functional communities of practice and institutionalize scalable analytical frameworks across therapeutic areas, mentor and shape the talent profile of junior colleagues, and champion innovative technologies (including GenAI) under appropriate governance to maximize commercial productivity and strategic impact across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To The Following**

* Commercial Strategy & Market Insights
* Lead and direct end-to-end analytical roadmaps to answer critical global and regional brand strategy questions across disease understanding, patient opportunity, market dynamics, brand performance, and pipeline brands/assets.
* Leverage expert-level knowledge of US and global commercial databases and healthcare markets to strategically identify, structure, and guide the team’s utilization of diverse data sources (including claims, EHR, syndicated market data, specialty pharmacy, hub, and SDoH data).
* Direct commercial cohort and patient-flow analyses to evaluate treatment dynamics, lines of therapy, switching patterns, compliance, and treatment funnels, converting complex data observations into quantified market opportunities and strategic growth pools.
* Align and integrate analytical findings with critical commercial milestones, driving the development of evidence-based patient-flow inputs, assumptions, and market insights for pipeline brand evaluations, business development decisions, forecasting, scenario planning, and brand strategy.
* Champion launch strategy and launch excellence by designing comprehensive performance measurement frameworks—including launch KPIs, leading indicators, and tracking thresholds—to enable proactive brand management and post-launch optimization.

**Advanced Analytics & Methodology**

* Determine the appropriate methodological depth of analytics based on the strategic decision required, guiding the team on when descriptive business synthesis is sufficient and when statistical, predictive, or advanced methodologies add incremental decision value.
* Provide functional and methodological direction on how the team extracts, integrates, and analyzes complex commercial datasets (utilizing SQL, Python/R, Databricks, and Dataiku) to ensure technical execution aligns perfectly with the brand's strategic questions.
* Establish robust analytical quality standards and validation frameworks within the team, ensuring data interpretations, commercial business rules, and cohort definitions are highly reliable, logical, and standardized.
* Guide the triangulation of quantitative analyses with qualitative insights, training the team to account for data representativeness, coverage limitations, and commercial context to produce robust strategic recommendations.
* Govern the deployment of emerging capabilities (including GenAI and prompt-based analytics) within team workflows, selectively leveraging automation to accelerate commercial data synthesis, coding efficiency, and knowledge reuse.

**Stakeholder, Project & Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a high-performing team of analytical professionals within DHH India, directly owning people management, career progression pathways, performance reviews, and professional coaching.
* Direct end-to-end program management for BSA workstreams, partnering with US and global business leaders to proactively define, prioritize, and manage the strategic analytical roadmap, deliverables, and resource allocation.
* Act as a senior strategic thought partner to executive stakeholders, translating complex data landscapes into concise, executive-ready storytelling and decision-support narratives that clarify commercial choices, trade-offs, and actions.
* Partner effectively across US, India, and global teams, therapeutic areas, and adjacent capabilities (including forecasting, market research, and competitive intelligence) to develop unified brand perspectives and dismantle organizational silos.
* Champion DHH India and BSA enterprise-wide capability development by leading cross-functional communities of practice, codifying institutional knowledge, and standardizing repeatable analytical frameworks across the company
* Drive BSA organizational maturity and talent strategy, representing DHH India in global planning, spearheading recruitment profiles, and fostering a collaborative, value-driven team culture.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8–10 years of industry experience in pharmaceutical commercial analytics, brand analytics, life sciences consulting, or healthcare decision science.
* Extensive experience working with US and global physician and patient-level data (PLD) from leading vendors (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Optum, IHME, Clarivate, etc.) and diverse healthcare sources (claims, EHR, specialty pharmacy, hub, and syndicated market datasets).
* Deep commercial pharma analytics and brand strategy expertise spanning core BSA concepts, including patient journey dynamics, lines of therapy, switching patterns, compliance, and market opportunity assessments.
* Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and managing moderate-sized teams of analytical professionals, data scientists, or commercial consultants.
* Demonstrated experience in end-to-end program management, managing multiple complex timelines, and navigating senior executive-level stakeholder communication.
* Strategic application of AI, GenAI, prompt engineering, and agentic solutions to synthesize multi-source information, accelerate insights, and transform commercial analytics through responsible, scalable, high-value use cases.
* Strong technical foundations in analytical methodologies (SQL, Python/R, statistical/predictive modeling), combined with excellent executive storytelling, visualization, and strategic communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in STEM (MS, MBA, PhD) or a related quantitative or business-focused field.
* Deep therapeutic-area knowledge and commercial analytics experience across Immunology
* Demonstrated experience partnering with and integrating insights from adjacent commercial capabilities, such as Forecasting, Market Research, and Competitive Intelligence.
* Direct experience collaborating across geographically distributed teams (US, India, and global organizations) to drive commercial alignment, lead capability-building initiatives, and champion BSA organizational maturity.
* Proven ability to lead enterprise capability building, operating-model transitions, vendor internalization, and change management.
* Demonstrated ability to develop analytical talent, foster consultative problem-solving, and raise organizational maturity across teams.
* Strong emotional intelligence and organizational agility, with demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, influence without authority, and build alignment across senior, cross-functional, and global teams.

**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
**Required Skills**
Brand Management, Brand Management, Brand Strategy, Business Agility, Business Intelligence (BI), Commercial Acumen, Competitive Intelligence (CI), Database Design, Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Science, Data Visualization, Emotional Intelligence, Immunology, Immunology Research, Launch Excellence, Machine Learning (ML), Market Data, People Management, Program Management, Quantitative Analysis, Software Development, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Storytelling {+ 5 more}

title: Senior Telecom Software Developer (5G RAN / CNF)
description: DescriptionAbout the RoleWe are seeking a hands-on Senior Developer to lead the design and implementation of high-throughput, low-latency 5G gNB (Next-Generation NodeB) software. You will bridge the gap between high-level architectural vision and low-level system execution, driving the evolution of our 5G RAN stack into resilient, cloud-native microservices.Key ResponsibilitiesArchitecture & Design: Architect end-to-end 5G gNB Distributed Unit (DU) and Centralized Unit (CU) components as scalable, cloud-native network functions (CNFs). Hands-On C++ Development: Write clean, maintainable, and ultra-low-latency modern C++ (C++17/C++20) code for Layer 2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP) and Layer 3 (RRC, NGAP, F1AP) protocol stacks. Data Plane Optimization: Design and optimize high-speed packet processing pipelines using DPDK (Data Plane Development Kit), bypassing the kernel to maximize throughput and minimize jitter. System-Level Engineering: Architect multi-threaded, lock-free applications on Linux, optimizing CPU pinning, NUMA awareness, memory management, and hardware acceleration (e.g., SmartNICs, SR-IOV). Cloud-Native Transformation: Lead the containerization and orchestration of 5G workloads on Kubernetes, ensuring seamless lifecycle management, high availability, and observability. Technical Leadership: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct rigorous architecture and code reviews, and establish best practices for performance profiling and benchmarking. Required QualificationsExperience: 5 to 8 years of proven experience in telecom software engineering, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or architectural capacity. 5G & RAN Expertise: Deep understanding of 3GPP 5G NR specifications, specifically around gNB architecture (CU/DU split), Layer 2 (MAC scheduling, RLC, PDCP, SDAP), and Layer 3 signaling protocols. Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in modern C++ and Linux system programming (IPC, shared memory, POSIX threads, socket programming, profiling tools like perf and gdb). Packet Processing & Networking: Strong hands-on experience with DPDK, SR-IOV, and core computer networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, SCTP, GTP-U, VLAN, QoS). Cloud-Native Stack: Practical experience deploying and debugging CNFs on Kubernetes/OpenShift, utilizing Helm, Docker, and cloud-native networking plugins (Multus, Calico, Cilium). Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)Experience with O-RAN (Open RAN) architectures, interfaces (Open Fronthaul, E2, A1, O1), and RIC integration. Familiarity with hardware offloading technologies (e.g., Intel FlexRAN, NVIDIA Aerial, or FPGA/ASIC-based lookaside/inline acceleration). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for telco workloads and automated performance testing frameworks. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose:**
We are seeking a talented and passionate
**Senior Full Stack Engineer**
to design, architect, and deliver next-generation, mission-critical web applications.
  
  
In this role, you will play a pivotal part in engineering scalable, high-performance distributed systems with
**Java / Spring Boot**
on the back end and modern, responsive user experiences with
**React & TypeScript**
on the front end.
  
  
As a senior technical contributor, you will drive architectural decisions, champion clean coding and DevOps best practices, and mentor engineers across the team. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges at global scale and want to see your code make a tangible impact, we would love to have you on our team.
  
  
**Job Background / Context:**

* Architect & Build: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and deployment of resilient microservices and full-stack web applications.
* Modern Front-End Engineering: Build intuitive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces using modern React, Redux, and TypeScript.
* Robust Back-End Services: Develop high-throughput RESTful APIs, event-driven pipelines, and data persistence layers with Spring Boot, Spring Data, and relational/NoSQL databases.
* Engineering Excellence: Champion code quality through automated testing, peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and architectural discussions.
* Scale & Optimize: Profile and optimize applications for maximum speed, security, resilience, and horizontal scalability.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a subject matter expert (SME), collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and platform architects, and coach junior/mid-level engineers.
* Innovation: Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, libraries, and frameworks to keep our tech stack modern and efficient.

**Our Core Tech Stack**

* Back End: Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA / Hibernate, Reactive Spring
* Front End: React, TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+), Redux / Modern State Management, HTML5, CSS3 / Modern CSS Frameworks, Webpack / Vite, MicroFrontEnd
* Databases & Data Stores: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
* DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins / GitHub Actions / Tekton), AWS / Hybrid Cloud
* Build & Version Control: Git, Maven, Gradle, npm / yarn

**Qualifications**
**Core Experience**

* 7-9 years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade full-stack web applications.
* Strong proficiency in Java and extensive, hands-on experience with the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, microservices architecture, RESTful API design).
* In-depth experience with React, state management (e.g., Redux, Context API), and modern front-end tooling/build workflows.
* Strong Experience with building Micro Front Ends in a React based environment.
* Solid understanding of relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database design, indexing, and ORM frameworks (Hibernate / JPA).
* Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, system design, and security best practices.
* Proven track record with automated testing (JUnit, Mockito, Jest, React Testing Library) and CI/CD pipelines.

**Professional & Leadership Attributes**

* Autonomy and ownership: Ability to take business requirements from concept to production with minimal supervision.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to detail, maintainability, and clean architecture (SOLID principles).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Software Engineer to drive modern engineering practices and technology transformation within our teams. Software Development & System Design
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance applications.
* Implement trunk-based development practices to enable continuous integration and rapid delivery.
* Develop clean, maintainable, and testable code following SOLID principles and software design best practices.
* Ensure high levels of unit test coverage, test-driven development (TDD), and behavior-driven development (BDD).
* Actively contribute to hands-on coding, code reviews, and refactoring to maintain high engineering standards.

Engineering Excellence & Best Practices
  
  

* Drive the adoption of modern engineering ways of working, including Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD.
* Advocate for automated testing, infrastructure as code, and continuous monitoring to enhance software reliability.
* Apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Test-Driven Development (TDD), and unit testing to ensure code quality and functionality.
* Conduct thorough code reviews, ensuring adherence to best practices in readability, performance, and security.
* Implement and enforce secure coding practices, performing vulnerability assessments and ensuring compliance with security standards.
* Collaborate effectively in agile environments, embracing DevOps principles and fostering a culture of continuous delivery and improvement.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with architects, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design scalable and distributed systems.
* Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.
* Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to optimize deployments, observability, and production resilience.
* Lead technical discussions, contribute to design documentation, and provide guidance on modern software architectures.

Must-Have Skills:
  
  

* 8+ years of strong hands-on experience in coding Java, Angular, SpringBoot, Kafka, Oracle
* Deep expertise in system design and microservices architecture.
* Proficiency in TDD, BDD, and automation-first mindset to ensure high test coverage and reliability.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Experience conducting code reviews, vulnerability assessments, and secure coding.
* Exposure to modern cloud-native technologies (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in fast-paced, agile environments.
* Knowledge of performance tuning, observability, and production monitoring.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Good-to-Have Skills:
  
  

* Experience with event-driven architecture and distributed systems.
* Familiarity with Caching Solutions & Tooling
* Experience with trunk-based development, feature flags, and progressive delivery strategies.

title: Civil Engineer Managing Consultant
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Senior Consultant - Engineering**
, you will support ERM’s global consulting delivery by leading the development of engineering solutions for civil remediation projects. You will work within the engineering team and partner with regional project managers, technical specialists, and clients to deliver complex remediation projects from planning through implementation. This role is critical to advancing technical excellence, mentoring junior engineers, driving delivery consistency, and supporting the successful execution of ERM’s global remediation portfolio.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Lead the development and review of engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, cost estimates, and technical reports for complex remediation projects.
* Provide technical leadership during design, construction, startup, and operational phases to ensure projects meet quality, safety, budget, and schedule objectives.
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior engineers, supporting their professional development and project delivery capabilities.
* Foster strong collaboration with global project teams, clients, subcontractors, and regulatory agencies to achieve successful project outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering standards, design quality, and consulting delivery efficiency across projects.

**What will you bring?**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Environmental, or Geotechnical Engineering with a minimum 3.0 GPA.
* 4-10 years of relevant experience in environmental engineering, remediation design, environmental consulting, construction support, or related engineering disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineering workstreams and coordinating multidisciplinary project teams.
* Strong knowledge of remediation technologies, environmental compliance programs, permitting requirements, and engineering design principles.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and engineering software tools.
* Experience developing and reviewing engineering drawings, technical specifications, construction documents, and technical reports.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound technical recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience interacting directly with clients, contractors, and regulatory agencies.
* Strong commitment to safety and experience implementing health and safety requirements during field and construction activities.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills & Competencies**

* Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification or progress toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license, or ability to obtain within a reasonable timeframe.
* Experience leading field programs, pilot studies, remediation system startups, and construction oversight activities.
* Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Civil 3D, ArcGIS, and environmental data management platforms.
* Experience supporting global, multi-office, or shared-service delivery models.
* Experience applying automation, AI-enabled tools, or advanced analytical methods to engineering workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead engineering design activities for civil remediation projects, including data evaluation, engineering calculations, design development, cost estimating, and preparation of technical specifications and contract documents.
* Provide technical leadership and oversight during construction, commissioning, startup, and operational phases of remediation projects.
* Review and approve engineering work products prepared by junior engineers and provide technical mentoring and quality assurance.
* Lead modeling, calculations, and design efforts related to stormwater management, soil stabilization, hydraulic systems, vapor treatment systems, groundwater treatment systems, and other environmental infrastructure.
* Plan and direct field investigations, pilot tests, remediation system evaluations, performance testing, and construction oversight activities.
* Coordinate with project managers to support project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and risk management activities.
* Interface directly with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and regulatory agencies to resolve technical issues and maintain project progress.
* Ensure project activities comply with applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations, engineering standards, and ERM quality requirements.
* Contribute to continual improvement initiatives, engineering best practices, and technical standardization efforts across the global engineering organization.
* Support proposal development, scope preparation, technical sales efforts, and business development activities where appropriate.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Description: Automation Test Engineer**
**Job Title:**
Automation Test Engineer
  
  
**Experience:**
3-5 Years
  
  
**Department:**
Quality Assurance
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled and passionate
**Automation Test Engineer**
with 3-5 years of experience in test automation, API testing, and quality engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks, improving test coverage, ensuring high-quality software releases, and driving automation initiatives across UI, API, and performance testing domains.
  
  
The candidate should possess strong expertise in
**Playwright, TypeScript, Cucumber BDD, API Automation, Jenkins, GitLab, and JMeter**
, along with a quality-first mindset and a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI automation frameworks and test scripts using Playwright, TypeScript, and Cucumber BDD to ensure reliable and maintainable test coverage.
* Design and implement CI/CD automation pipelines in Jenkins, integrating UI and API automation suites to enable continuous testing and faster feedback during releases.
* Develop, maintain, and execute API automation test suites to validate functionality, integrations, data integrity, and overall system reliability.
* Utilize GitLab for source control management, code reviews, and adherence to established branching and release management strategies.
* Leverage GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted tools/agents to improve automation development efficiency, script quality, and test coverage.
* Perform sanity, functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing to validate application quality across releases and environments.
* Create, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test data, and test documentation, ensuring complete coverage of business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
* Create and maintain test datasets required for testing activities and implement dynamic test data generation approaches within automation frameworks to reduce maintenance effort and improve script reliability.
* Monitor daily automation executions, analyse test reports, investigate failures, identify defects or script issues, and track them through resolution and closure.
* Participate in automation script reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, framework guidelines, and test automation best practices.
* Identify flaky automation scripts, perform root cause analysis, and implement improvements to enhance automation reliability and stability.
* Analyse defects and production issues and add corresponding scenarios to the regression suite to minimize defect leakage and improve overall product quality.
* Track automation coverage, execution trends, and quality metrics, and provide recommendations to improve automation effectiveness and test efficiency.
* Design, develop, and execute performance test scripts using JMeter, analyse performance reports, identify bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for system optimization.
* Write and execute SQL queries to validate backend data, verify data integrity across systems, and support functional, API, and end-to-end testing activities.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Playwright with TypeScript
* Cucumber BDD Framework
* API Testing & Automation
* Postman
* Jenkins
* GitLab
* CI/CD Pipeline Implementation
* Performance Testing using Apache JMeter
* GitHub Copilot and AI Agent Development/Usage
* Jira, TestRail or similar Test Management Tools
* Automation Framework Design and Development

title: Lead Salesforce Engineer
description:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in enabling MongoDB’s post-sales business processes, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows. By leveraging Salesforce and related business systems, the team ensures that post-sales teams have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support customer outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and drive long-term customer growth.
  
  
With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, integrations, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to support evolving post-sales business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Customer Success, Technical Services, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Billing, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Salesforce Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and evolution of critical Salesforce and CRM solutions supporting MongoDB’s post-sales business processes. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands-on solution design, cross-functional stakeholder partnership, people management, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI-powered development responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and long-term platform health.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing scalable Salesforce solutions for complex customer lifecycle processes, including customer success operations, support workflows, renewals, account management, customer health, and post-sales automation.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions supporting post-sales teams, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows
* Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions aligned with long-term platform strategy
* Partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver high-quality post-sales solutions
* Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design across the customer lifecycle
* Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, maintainability, and governance
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management
* Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and drive long-term, scalable resolutions
* Maintain technical documentation, including architecture decisions, design specifications, and implementation details
* Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, releases, and best practices, and proactively recommend improvements
* Proactively identify process and technical gaps, and help define and drive tech debt reduction initiatives, platform modernization efforts, and engineering efficiency improvements across the Salesforce ecosystem
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce/Vibes, Claude Code, and similar capabilities to improve development productivity, code quality, design effectiveness, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying strong judgment around security, privacy, accuracy, and responsible AI usage

**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce development, platform capabilities, automation, integrations, and scalable CRM solution design for post-sales business processes
* Lead technical design sessions and identify gaps between current-state and future-state solutions
* Design and support scalable solutions for customer success, support operations, renewals, customer health, account management, and related post-sales workflows
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices, and drive proof-of-concepts where appropriate
* Mentor engineers across the team and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence
* Support team growth by coaching, developing talent, and helping build a high-performing engineering organization
* Influence business and technical stakeholders through strong communication, sound judgment, and effective problem-solving
* Operate effectively in a fast-changing environment by managing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring high-quality execution

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 12+ years of experience in Salesforce engineering, application development, or technical leadership within global SaaS organizations
* Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, design patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience designing or supporting Salesforce solutions for post-sales functions such as Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, or customer lifecycle management
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and Agile/Scrum delivery models
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification required; Salesforce Certified Application Architect and Salesforce Certified System Architect certifications strongly preferred

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 months, you will
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, post-sales business processes, and technical landscape. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Customer Success, Support, Revenue Operations, and Engineering.
  
  
In 6 months, you will
  
  
Lead the technical design and successful delivery of critical Salesforce initiatives supporting post-sales workflows. Establish yourself as a trusted technical leader within the Business Systems team.
  
  
In 12 months, you will
  
  
Be the go-to technical leader for Salesforce architecture, complex solution design, and platform strategy for post-sales systems. Elevate team quality through strong technical leadership, mentoring, and scalable engineering practices

title: Risk Manager (Clinical Research)-India
description:
The Risk Manager (Clinical Research) plays a pivotal role in developing and executing risk-based monitoring strategies, ensuring data quality and integrity in clinical research projects. This position involves cross-functional collaboration to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, supporting the seamless implementation of Risk-Based Study Management (RBSM) principles in a
**CRO or pharma industry.**
**Responsibilities**
More specifically, the Risk Manager must:
  
  

* Provide subject matter expertise for developing and updating the risk-based monitoring strategy tailored to project needs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with complex indications.
* May have to coordinate with central monitor team and verify work.
* Point sur provide budget recommendations, change orders.
* Draft initial risk assessments and support the finalization of Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACT).
* Guide Project Managers (PMs) in transferring identified risks to the appropriate tracking systems and ensure ongoing reviews.
* Advise on developing functional plans to mitigate risks effectively.
* Utilize available tools to conduct remote data reviews and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
* Facilitate internal and sponsor reviews of findings, seeking cross-functional support for complex risks and mitigations.
* Deliver initial and ongoing training for study teams on risk assessment, centralized monitoring, and risk-based monitoring strategies.
* Escalate risks or deliverables at risk to the PM, including scope changes.
* Provide strategic input on risk characterization and reporting to leadership.
* Take on additional responsibilities as required, ensuring qualifications and training align with assigned tasks.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research;

**Experience**

* Must have experience in a CRO or pharma industry
* Minimum of 3 years in risk management within a clinical research setting.
* Minimum 5 years of experience across clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety.

Requirements:
  
  

* Expertise in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R3) Guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
* Proficiency in Risk-Based Monitoring strategies, processes, and tools.
* Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables).
* Advanced skills in analytical data visualization tools.
* Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and web based RACT tools.
* Strong analytical and statistical understanding.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to anticipate critical issues and develop proactive contingency plans.
* Skilled in project workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
* Training, mentoring, and organizational capabilities.
* High level of autonomy.
* Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
* Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
* Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
* Prioritization skills with the ability to plan, monitor, and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
* Excellent understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
* Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
* Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
* Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

title: Biosignal Algorithm Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Type: Contract/ Full Time

**About HLTH**

HLTH is one of the fastest growing brands of 2026, reaching the top 0.1% in hyper-growth of all stores in the Shopify ecosystem and we're just getting started (literally). At HLTH we believe understanding your health should be effortless. Our products turn health monitoring into clear insights anyone can act on.

**The Role**

We are looking for our first Biosignal Engineer to join our small but mighty team. This role will focus on building, implementing and evaluating algorithms that turn clean signals into actionable data. You will work hands-on with the founder to integrate data from diverse biosensing pathways to drive deeper physiological insights. The day to day entails deep experimentation with sensing hardware to analyze signal quality, prototype and finalize algorithms, and engineer the core data processing pipelines that power HLTH’s next-generation health monitoring technology.

**What You'll Do**

* **Algorithm Development & Evaluation:**

  Implement, refine, and benchmark signal processing and machine learning models for multimodal biosignals (such as PPG, motion, sleep, temperature, and related physiological parameters).
* **Multimodal Data Integration:**

  Apply practical techniques for noise reduction, signal filtration, feature extraction, and time-series data fusion across emerging sensing modalities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

  Partner with hardware, firmware, and software engineering to evaluate sensor performance and streamline data collection workflows.
* **Hands-On Prototyping:**

  Analyze datasets generated by prototype hardware, evaluation kits, and benchtop testing systems to determine algorithmic viability and evaluate signal integrity.
* **Physiological Research:**

  Examine complex time-series data to identify correlations between physical signal characteristics and underlying physiological metrics.
* **Technical Documentation & Reporting:**

  Document analytical findings, present experimental outcome data, and effectively communicate technical insights to project leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Must-Have**

* **Professional Experience:**

  3 to 4+ years of applied experience (inclusive of graduate-level research) in biosignal processing, time-series analysis, or sensor fusion.
* **Technical Proficiency:**

  Advanced expertise in Python and scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch or TensorFlow).
* **Domain Knowledge:**

  A strong foundational knowledge of human physiological systems and biosensing methodologies.
* **Data Engineering Skills:**

  Practical experience analyzing noisy, real-world time-series data and engineering robust preprocessing pipelines.
* **Academic Background:**

  A Master’s degree or PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Signal Processing, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* **Analytical & Communication Skills:**

  Exceptional analytical capabilities, with the ability to articulate complex data, methodologies, and technical outcomes to cross-functional stakeholders.

**Strong Preference**

* **Industry Experience:**

  Direct experience developing consumer health devices, wearable sensor technology, or digital health applications.
* **Agile Prototyping:**

  A proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, experimental environment—rapidly prototyping, evaluating, and adapting models based on empirical data.
* **Proactive Problem-Solving:**

  A self-motivated work ethic with a proactive approach to detecting data anomalies, resolving technical obstacles, and initiating data-driven research projects.

**What's in it for you**

* Competitive regional salaries
* Fully remote, flexible hours
* Access to custom AI tooling and workflows
* Flat team, direct access to founders
* Unlimited PTO (with a required recharge time)

**Disclaimer:**

Beware of fake job offers!

We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as HLTH recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:

* Our jobs are only listed on trusted job boards, our direct profile, or 99 Commerce staffing agency.
* We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment information upfront.
* All interviews take place via remote meetings, there are no local interviews.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

description:
The Credit Risk Strategy & Analytics role will support the development, implementation, and management of credit risk and/or collection strategies and policies for consumer and/or commercial lending portfolios. * Understand applicable credit policies, industry regulations and the requisite impact of those governance items to new initiatives
* Utilize Statistical Analysis System (SAS) in a UNIX environment to perform risk, financial and data analyses including profiling, sampling, forecasting and new program due diligence
* Prepare risk management presentations for senior management that include analytics on expected portfolio performance and areas of potential risk and/or opportunity
* Stay abreast of emerging industry trends in data analytics and perform proactive analytics to assess and support portfolio and origination strategies

* Liaise with key stakeholders to advance and support initiatives.
* Direct analytics team effectively to impart knowledge and rationale for tasks and ensure ownership for assigned responsibilities, lead to successful completion of goals, as an incubator for innovation

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 10+ years of experience in credit risk management in the financial services industry performing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling, implementation, and management of credit scoring models
* Degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics or Applied Mathematics.

* Statistical/econometric programming skills strongly preferred (SAS/SQL, PYTHON, STATA, etc.)
* Prior experience working in a regulatory and compliance policy environment

* Strong communications/presentation skills, capable of interacting effectively both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Java & Snowflake Engineer, Aladdin Data, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Java & Snowflake Engineer, Software Engineering – Aladdin Data
  
  
Your team
  
  
The Product Master team within Aladdin Data, BlackRock Data Office, is building a strategic enterprise platform to centrally manage BlackRock’s investment products across their lifecycle. The team is focused on establishing a trusted, governed, and scalable Product Book of Records that provides consistent investment product information across BlackRock. We partner closely with product management, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As an Associate Software Engineer, you will help build, enhance, and support Java applications and Snowflake-based data capabilities that underpin the enterprise Product Master platform. You will work across application and data engineering, contributing to product data ingestion, transformation, integration, quality, and distribution while helping modernize the platform and its engineering practices.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Product Master backend applications using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and integration components.
* Develop SQL and data-processing solutions supporting Snowflake-based ingestion, transformation, querying, distribution, and ETL/ELT workflows.
* Support product data modeling, validation, reconciliation, and data quality while integrating Java services with relational databases, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms.
* Optimize application and database performance and support monitoring, deployments, and production troubleshooting.
* Participate in design discussions and code reviews, and develop unit, integration, and automated validation tests following engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, product managers, and data engineers to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.
* Own assigned features through production-ready delivery and explore AI and Generative AI tools that improve development, testing, and operational productivity.

Your experience
  
  

* 3+ years of software engineering experience with strong Java programming and object-oriented design skills.
* Experience developing enterprise applications using Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization, with an understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
* Practical experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, including schemas, tables, warehouses, stages, and data-loading concepts.
* Experience with data ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT processing.
* Experience with Git, Maven or Gradle, automated build practices, unit testing, debugging, and application troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical and collaboration skills, with exposure to Python, data governance, data-quality frameworks, distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, cloud-native applications, AI/ML, or financial-services technology considered beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

1+ year of proven online arbitrage or product sourcing experience for Amazon US and/or Walmart US

Strong command of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS (or BuyBotPro / Tactical Arbitrage)

Knowledge of Amazon and Walmart policies: gating, ungating, IP complaints, restricted and hazmat products, invoice and authenticity requirements

Good spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel): formulas, filters, lead tracking

Good written English for working with US suppliers, prep centers and managers

Detail-oriented, honest about mistakes, and comfortable working with targets

* Ungating experience for brands and categories
* Experience with US prep centers and FBA shipment creation

Salary with a monthly incentive based on profitable leads

Paid access to sourcing tools (Keepa, SellerAmp and others)

Room to grow into a Sourcing Lead or Wholesale Manager role

Tools you use daily.

title: Commercial & FP&A Analyst
description: ABOUT CARGO PLAYERSCargo Players is a fast-growing, electric-first urban logistics and last-mile delivery partner powering India’s leading e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms. As we rapidly expand dark-store deployments and EV fleet operations across major metros, we are strengthening our Head Office finance team in Connaught Place to drive rigorous financial planning, commercial control, and unit-level profitability.THE ROLEWe are looking for a sharp, commercially minded Commercial & FP&A Analyst to sit at our Head Office and serve as the financial anchor for our ground operations.Your mandate is not to run field operations—it is to build budgets, scrutinize site-level P&Ls, validate commercial rate cards, and challenge operational leaders with hard numbers. You will bridge the gap between ground execution and corporate finance, ensuring forecasts stay realistic, client contracts remain profitable, and cost variances are caught early.WHAT YOU WILL DO· Own Operational Budgeting & Variance Analysis: Build annual and monthly hub-level budgets, track actuals vs. forecast week over week, and publish variance bridges explaining margin shifts across dark stores and cities.· Drive Commercial & Rate-Card Governance: Evaluate client contracts, Minimum Guarantee (MG) structures, supervisor gearing norms, and SLA penalties—ensuring ground deployments adhere strictly to agreed commercial terms.· Challenge Ground Performance with Data: Partner with (and constructively question) City Heads and Fleet Managers during weekly business reviews to pinpoint root causes behind cost overruns, low rider productivity, and fleet underutilization.· Ensure Billing & Reimbursement Accuracy: Reconcile third-party control tower logs and client portals against internal payouts, client invoices, and pass-through claims (assets, raincoats, bags, hub expenses) to prevent revenue leakage.· Model New Bids & Expansion: Build bottom-up commercial P&L models, working capital forecasts, and sensitivity analyses for new client RFPs, pricing negotiations, and city launches.· Deliver Executive FP&A Scorecards & Automate Workflows: Prepare crisp weekly and monthly financial packs for HO leadership highlighting unit economics, cash burn, receivables, and hub-wise ROI, while leveraging modern automation and AI tools to streamline recurring reconciliations and reporting.WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR· Education: Qualified/Inter CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), CFA (Level 2+), or a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce/Economics/Finance from a premier institution.· Experience (Industry Preference): 2–5 years in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Business Finance, or Financial Consulting / Transaction Advisory (Big 4 or high-growth startups). Candidates from the same industry—specifically 3PL logistics, quick commerce, e-commerce delivery, or EV/mobility fleets—are strongly preferred.· Financial Modeling, Data & AI Skills: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (dynamic P&L modeling, budget vs. actual bridges, sensitivity analysis) and comfort handling large operational datasets (SQL / Power BI familiarity is a plus). Candidates should also have practical awareness of AI and automation applications in the logistics and finance sector (such as automated billing reconciliations, AI-assisted forecasting, and workflow automation).· Contractual & Tax Acumen: Practical understanding of commercial rate cards, pass-through billing structures, SLA clauses, and GST compliance.· Mindset: High constructive skepticism—you are comfortable digging into operational anomalies and asking tough, data-backed questions to experienced field managers to safeguard company margins.WHY JOIN US?· Industry Exposure: Direct exposure to the commercial mechanics of India’s booming quick-commerce and EV logistics sector.· High Ownership: High-impact role where your financial models and variance insights directly guide pricing, cost control, and expansion decisions.· Prime Location & Culture: Central Head Office location in Connaught Place, New Delhi, with a fast-paced, high-ownership culture.

title: Principal Architect, Frontier AI Offense & Defense Security
description:
**Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them.

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler.

**About the Role**

You will architect LSI's agentic security system: a team of AI agents that attack, defend and harden a customer's estate continuously. Offense agents probe like an attacker, defense agents detect, investigate and respond like the best responder, and remediation agents turn findings into fixes. You own how they reason, act, hand off to each other and stay under human control.

You are fluent on both sides: you have run adversary simulations and led investigations, and you have built agents that do both. You will turn that into system architecture, training signal and evaluations, working with ML researchers, offense and defense engineers and design partners.

**What you'll do**

* Architect the multi-agent system: offense, defense and remediation agents, the orchestrator that routes work between them, and the shared context that carries a finding from attack path to detection to fix.
* Design the harness and actuators agents use across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, code and CI/CD, and SIEM/XDR/SOAR, with every action scoped, traceable and replayable.
* Build the security context graph that unifies endpoint, identity, cloud, app and agent signals with threat intel, past incidents and policy.
* Own routing between LSI's specialised cyber models and frontier models, trading accuracy, latency and cost per task.
* Define agent identity, least privilege, autonomy levels, human sign-off for high-impact actions, audit trails and rollback.
* Own one evaluation scorecard across find, exploit, detect, investigate, triage and fix, and lead staff engineers and design-partner pilots.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years with hands-on depth in both offense (red teaming, adversary simulation, pentest, AppSec, vulnerability research) and defense (detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, threat research).
* Has designed and shipped a security platform, detection and response system or SOC used at enterprise or cloud scale.
* Has built production LLM agents or multi-agent systems for security with tool use, orchestration and measured results, and knows how to catch hallucinated findings.
* Has led full-kill-chain adversary simulations and investigations into sophisticated intrusions.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**About Stantech AI**

Stantech AI builds enterprise-grade products engineered for complete customisation: adapting precisely to organisations, while remaining scalable and cost-efficient at any size. Atop this foundation, we embed agentic automation that streamlines operations and elevates overall efficiency. Our distinction lies in resolving what most systems treat as trade-offs: deep customisation without compromising scale, sophistication without excess cost.

**The Role**

The role of a backend engineer has evolved, and this position reflects that. We seek an engineer who thinks structurally — who resolves problems at the level of core design rather than patching symptoms. Increasingly, our products are powered by AI agents that operate against our backend through Claude APIs, making autonomous agents a first-class consumer of our systems alongside human users and other services. The design of our APIs and tool interfaces determines how reliably and efficiently those agents operate — well-scoped, minimal, self-describing interfaces allow an agent to use them correctly without reloading context on every call. We want an engineer who designs with this setup in mind.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand the system before changing it — establish what is actually happening and where a change belongs, rather than acting on the surface symptom.
* Evaluate every change across the dimensions that matter: scalability, multi-tenancy, and concurrency — not merely whether it works in isolation.
* Favour reuse and consistency — extend existing code and established patterns wherever possible rather than duplicating logic.
* Build for the future — design so that new features can be added without rework, keeping the codebase extensible rather than accumulating one-off fixes.
* Resolve problems at their structural root, with solutions that hold up under scale and load.
* Design internal APIs and tool surfaces as clean, minimal, well-documented contracts that AI agents can consume efficiently, reducing tool sprawl and context overhead.
* Own backend services end to end (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker, GitLab CI/CD), using AI tools including Claude across design, implementation, review, and debugging, while remaining fully accountable for what ships.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of backend engineering experience at a product-based company.
* Strong system-design ability — clear reasoning about scalability, reliability, concurrency, and the trade-offs between them.
* Fluent use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering, with a clear sense of where they accelerate work, where they fail, and how to verify their output.
* Sharp debugging instincts and the discipline to solve problems at the root.
* Solid command of Python and the FastAPI ecosystem, PostgreSQL (data modelling and query optimisation), Docker, and CI/CD.
* Working familiarity with distributed-systems fundamentals: caching, message brokers, asynchronous processing, and connection pooling.
* An ownership mindset, with end-to-end accountability for the systems you build.

**Strong Pluses**

* Experience designing or building AI agents — orchestrating workflows around a model API rather than building models from scratch. We value engineers who have built systems around an AI API.
* Exposure to product environments operating at meaningful scale.
* Hands-on infrastructure and DevOps experience: reverse proxies, SSL, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana), and server hardening.
* Experience with multi-tenancy, event streaming, or real-time systems (WebSockets, pub/sub).

**Compensation & Details**

Compensation: ₹24–36 LPA, commensurate with experience.

Location: Gurugram, India.

title: Backend Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
Backend Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
  
  
Your team
  
  
The Product Master team within Aladdin Data, BlackRock Data Office (BDO), is building a strategic enterprise platform to centrally manage BlackRock’s investment products across their lifecycle. The platform aims to establish a trusted, governed, and scalable Product Book of Records (PBOR), providing a consistent source of investment product information across BlackRock.
  
  
The team develops capabilities across product master data and hierarchies, share classes, product onboarding and approvals, product-to-portfolio relationships, integration with Aladdin and downstream consumers, data governance, auditability, and platform modernization. You will partner with product management, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Vice President within the Product Master team, you will provide hands-on technical leadership in designing, developing, modernizing, and supporting scalable, resilient, and high-performance enterprise applications. This role combines deep Java backend engineering with technical leadership and requires active involvement in architecture, implementation, code reviews, performance optimization, and production engineering.
  
  
You will help shape critical Product Master capabilities and contribute to the continued development of a trusted and scalable platform supporting investment product information across BlackRock.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical leadership for Product Master backend services, application programming interfaces (APIs), and product lifecycle workflows, contributing actively to architecture, implementation, code reviews, and complex problem-solving.
* Design and implement scalable services using Java 17+, Spring and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, and distributed components.
* Build capabilities supporting investment product onboarding, approvals, master data, hierarchies, and integrations, with a focus on scalability, resiliency, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Develop and optimize Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, data models, database interactions, transactional processing, concurrency, multithreading, caching, and application performance.
* Champion automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), observability, secure development, production readiness, and sustainable resolution of complex production issues.
* Identify practical opportunities to apply artificial intelligence (AI) and Generative AI to engineering, testing, documentation, and operations.
* Mentor engineers, lead technical discussions, and own complex technical initiatives through successful production delivery.

Your experience
  
  

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise applications, with strong hands-on programming expertise in Java 17+.
* Deep experience with Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, object-oriented design, design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.
* Experience designing distributed systems using concurrency, multithreading, and asynchronous processing.
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including database design, transaction management, indexing, and query optimization.
* Knowledge of API design, security, authentication, enterprise integration patterns, automated testing, Git, and CI/CD practices.
* Strong debugging, performance tuning, production troubleshooting, and observability skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, and independently deliver complex solutions.
* Experience with legacy modernization, cloud-native architectures, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, Snowflake and modern enterprise data platforms, AI/Generative AI, or governed investment product data is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Social Media Analyst
description:
Job Description: Digital Marketing Command Centre Lead

About the Role

This is a senior, strategic, full-time, on-site role in Ghaziabad, reporting to the Head

of Data and Analytics. The Digital Marketing Command Centre Lead is responsible

for anchoring and operating a high-tech, real-time marketing intelligence centre. You

will act as the crucial link between client teams (brand, digital, category, CMI),

agency partners, tool providers, and crisis response units, ensuring every insight is

purposeful, timely, relevant, actioned, tested, and learned from.

We are seeking a professional with 7-8 years of experience, rooted in consumer

research or market intelligence (e.g., Nielsen, Kantar, IPSOS), who has evolved into

a Social Listening and Digital Intelligence specialist. This role is critical for

maintaining brand vigilance, consumer pulse monitoring, and agile marketing

execution across a diverse FMCG portfolio, including Health Care, Personal Care,

Home Care, and Foods & Beverages. You will ensure the Command Centre

operates as a proactive intelligence engine supporting business ambitions across all

digital touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

1. Command Centre Leadership & Governance: Lead day-to-day operations,

manage request workflows and log, define SOPs, conduct performance

reviews against SLAs and KPIs. Uphold agency and client values, develop the

team, and build indispensable client relationships by consistently delivering

high-quality insights and identifying new opportunities.

2. Stakeholder Management & Solutioning: Serve as the primary interface,

translating business challenges into structured listening briefs and

measurement frameworks. Lead workshops, design tailored solutions and

proactively identify/address capability gaps.

3. Relationship Management: Build and sustain strong, strategic partnerships

with client marketing/brand teams, agency partners, platform vendors, and

data providers. Act as the central communication point and facilitate cross-

functional collaboration.

4. Crisis Detection, Triage & Escalation: Own the end-to-end crisis response

process. Implement a 3-tier severity classification (Severity 1 Critical: 15-30

min response; Severity 2 High; Severity 3 Moderate: same-day review) and

define escalation workflows. Lead post-crisis reviews and coordinate with PR,

Legal, and Brand teams.

5. Insight Storytelling & Reporting: Transform complex data (social listening,

ORM, influencer, digital analytics) into clear, compelling, and actionable

narratives. Design tiered reporting (real-time, weekly, monthly, quarterly),

apply strong data visualization, and champion "so what" thinking. Create

brand listening, category intelligence, and trend reports.

6. AI-Assisted Human-in-Loop Operations: Design and implement AI-

augmented workflows, maximizing machine intelligence while preserving

human judgment. Define human-in-loop intervention models, configure AI/ML

tools, and refine handoff protocols for speed and accuracy.

7. Social Listening, ORM & Influencer Intelligence: Act as SME for platforms

like Talkwalker, Brandwatch. Design/maintain robust listening frameworks

(Boolean, topics, SOV, sentiment), oversee ORM, and integrate influencer

intelligence tools.

8. Business Intelligence & Data Visualisation: Utilize Power BI, Tableau, or

similar to build/maintain dashboards. Integrate diverse data streams (social,

web, CRM, e-commerce) and promote self-service BI.

9. Digital Marketing Expertise: Apply deep understanding of the digital

marketing ecosystem (paid, organic social, SEO, content, influencer, e-

commerce, performance) to contextualize insights for strategy and stay ahead

of digital trends.

10. People Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of social listening

analysts, ORM executives, and data/insight managers. Define KPIs, growth

plans, and foster a collaborative, insight-driven culture.

11. Marketing Frameworks & FMCG Brand Knowledge: Apply core marketing

frameworks (content, segmentation, consumer journey, brand health) and

leverage FMCG experience to align intelligence with brand equity, NPS, and

category share of voice.

Role Requirements

 Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications, or

related field. MBA/postgraduate preferred.

 Experience: 7-10 years total; minimum 3-4 years in Social Listening / Digital

Intelligence with a foundational background in consumer research or market

intelligence.

 FMCG Experience: Good to have experience with the category (specifically

Health Care, Personal Care, F&B preferred).

 Tools Proficiency: Talkwalker, Brandwatch, or equivalent; Power BI/Tableau

or equivalent BI tool; ORM platforms like Simplify360, Konnect Insights;

Influencer analytics tools.

 Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing and developing cross-

functional teams.

 Language: Excellent written and verbal communication in English; additional

regional language proficiency advantageous.

Desired Skills & Competencies

 Technical Skills: Social listening platforms

(Talkwalker/Brandwatch/Meltwater/Sprinklr), ORM process, Influencer

intelligence tools, BI/data visualization (Power BI/Tableau), Boolean query

building, AI tool literacy, Digital analytics familiarity (Google Analytics, Meta

Business Suite).

 Strategic & Analytical Skills: Strong business analysis (data to strategy),

Crisis management, Content/audience framework knowledge, Competitive

intelligence, Campaign measurement.

 Behavioural Competencies: Exceptional stakeholder communication, High

emotional intelligence, Relationship-building, Structured problem-solving

under pressure, Comfort in ambiguity/fast-paced environments, Collaborative

leadership, Attention to detail balanced with strategic thinking.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

 Within 90 days: Full audit of existing tools/processes, established request

log, delivered stakeholder workshop, implemented crisis triage (Severity 1-3),

and set core workflows (Crisis, Insights, Response, Request, Reporting,

Alerts, Escalation).

 Within 6 months: Measurable improvement in insight turnaround time and

stakeholder satisfaction, launched AI-assisted workflow, and established

regular brand health/category intelligence reporting.

 Within 12 months: Positioned the command centre as a strategic decision-

support engine for marketing leadership, demonstrated a direct link between

intelligence and at least three measurable brand/campaign outcomes, and

built a high-performing, self-sufficient team.

Role: Social Marketing Manager - YouTube Shopping for Creators Location: Delhi, India About the role: We’re looking for a Social Marketing Manager to shape the voice of one of the world's most culturally significant brands. You will use social platforms to deepen our connection with communities, relying on data to uncover insights that drive real-world business results. You will also be the frontline defender of our brand, using your analytical expertise to set up processes that escalate potential risks and respond thoughtfully to what matters most to our users. The role is highly cross-functional and international. You will collaborate daily with local, regional (APAC), and global YouTube product marketing managers, alongside cross-functional teams in partnerships, legal, communications, and policy What you will be doing: Always-On Shopping Strategy: Lead the strategy and operations for creator-facing social channels, driving the adoption of YouTube Shopping features. Campaigns & Initiatives: Partner with marketing peers locally and across regions to develop and execute campaigns that deliver on business goals. Fuel the Creative: Engage and lead our social media, influencer, and content agencies. Data-Driven Optimization: Track the real business impact of our social efforts.
