Agency Expertise: Proven experience leading and collaborating with social media, influencer, and content production agency partners. Cultural Fluency: A comprehensive understanding of the Indian influencer ecosystem, local social media best practices, and the top agencies operating in the market. Analytical Rigor: A strong track record of creativity paired with data-driven optimization. You should be well-versed in social analytics and listening tools (experience with Sprinklr or BrandWatch is a plus). Communication & Hustle: Outstanding written and oral communication skills in English. Fluency in Hindi (and knowledge of other regional Indian languages) is an added advantage. You must be a scrappy, proactive problem-solver with a strong bias for action and a track record of making things happen in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. AI Native: You possess a strong willingness and capability to integrate AI solutions into daily operations, continuously seeking ways to improve efficiency and work quality. Passion for and inquisitive about AI and new technologies Understanding and knowledge of AI tools is beneficial, but ability to learn and digest benefits and features of AI tools is critical Req ID: 19121 Our values shape everything we do: Be Ambitious to succeed Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what’s possible Be Inspirational to do groundbreaking work Be always learning and listening to understand Be Results-focused to exceed expectations Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations Our recruitment process does not employ artificial intelligence for selection. title: Social Media and Inbound Manager
description:
₹40,000–55,000 a month

Ermazd is a media production agency in Delhi and Bombay. We make films, photographs and campaigns for brands, and we run Ermazd Studio for audio and music.

We’re hiring one person to own our front door: what people see of us, and what happens when they write in.

The job

About 60% social, 40% inbound.

Social

* Plan and run the calendar for Instagram and LinkedIn
* Publish our shoots, sessions and finished work as posts, Reels and Stories
* Write captions that sound like us
* Be on set and in the studio often enough to catch what’s worth posting
* Report each month on what worked and what didn’t

Inbound

* Answer every inquiry – Instagram, WhatsApp, email, website forms and JustDial – within the hour during working hours
* Ask what they’re making, roughly when and roughly what it has to cost
* Share our published rates when someone asks the price
* Book Ermazd Studio sessions and keep the booking diary straight
* Log every lead and follow up until it’s a yes or a no
* Hand project inquiries to Sukrit with a clean brief – he scopes and quotes, so you never have to

You

* Have 1–3 years in social media, client servicing or a studio front desk
* Write clean English and are comfortable in Hindi
* Pick up the phone without flinching
* Care about film, photography or music enough to have opinions
* A plus: experience with professional photography, videography or video editing

To apply

Skip the cover letter. Send your CV, links to accounts you’ve run and two things:

1. Your reply to this message: “Hi, how much for the studio for a day?”
2. Three post ideas for Ermazd

Send to mail@ermazd.com with the subject line “Social and Inbound”.

title: Performance Marketing Manager ( Google ads mera ads )(agency only )
description:
**Company Description**
CAREERBLOC is a growing agency focused on building impactful careers and delivering high-performance digital marketing solutions for its clients. The organization emphasizes data-driven strategies, continuous learning, and measurable results across performance marketing channels. Team members collaborate closely with clients from diverse industries, helping them achieve growth through innovative campaigns and optimized media investments. CAREERBLOC values a supportive, inclusive work environment that encourages experimentation, ownership, and professional development. Joining CAREERBLOC means contributing to an ambitious agency culture that is focused on outcomes, transparency, and long-term partnerships.
  
**Role Description**
The Performance Marketing Manager (Google Ads, Meta Ads) will oversee end-to-end paid media strategy and execution for agency clients, with a focus on driving ROI and growth. This full-time on-site role, based in Gurugram, includes planning and launching campaigns, managing budgets, and optimizing performance across Google and Meta platforms. The role involves conducting keyword and audience research, building and testing ad creatives, monitoring daily campaign performance, and implementing data-backed adjustments to improve efficiency. The manager will prepare performance reports, share insights with clients, and collaborate with internal teams to align paid media strategies with broader marketing and business objectives. Responsibilities also include staying current with platform updates, best practices, and industry trends to continuously enhance campaign results.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in performance marketing platforms, including Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube) and Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram), with a track record of managing and scaling campaigns.
* Proficiency in campaign setup and optimization: keyword and audience research, bid strategy management, A/B testing of creatives and landing pages, and conversion rate optimization.
* Analytical skills in using tools such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, and other reporting dashboards to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Experience working in an agency environment, handling multiple client accounts, managing budgets, and communicating performance insights and recommendations clearly.
* Ability to collaborate with creative, content, and account management teams to develop cohesive campaign strategies and ensure brand consistency.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, on-site environment in Gurugram.
* Relevant education in Marketing, Business, or a related field; professional certifications in Google Ads, Meta Ads, or digital marketing are highly beneficial.
* Comfort with Excel or similar tools for reporting, budget tracking, and forecasting; familiarity with remarketing, audience segmentation, and funnel-based campaign planning is a plus.

title: App Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Description – App Marketing Specialist
  
(Micro Drama App)
  
  
Job Title: App Marketing Specialist – User Acquisition
  
Department: Growth / Performance Marketing
  
Experience: 2–5 Years
  
Location: Delhi NCR
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Job Overview-
  
We are looking for a performance-driven App Marketing Specialist with experience in user
  
acquisition and mobile app growth, preferably in the entertainment, OTT, short-video, or
  
micro-drama industry.
  
The candidate will be responsible for driving user acquisition, scaling app installs, increasing
  
registrations, improving viewer engagement, and optimizing marketing campaigns for our
  
micro-drama application. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in running
  
paid campaigns, analyzing user behavior, testing creatives, and developing strategies to
  
acquire quality users at scale.
  
  
Key Responsibilities-
  
 Plan, execute, and scale user acquisition campaigns for our micro-drama mobile
  
application.
  
 Manage paid campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and other
  
relevant advertising platforms.
  
 Drive app installs, registrations, active users, episode views, and paying subscribers.
  
 Develop and implement performance marketing strategies to acquire users at
  
optimized CPI, CPA, and CAC.
  
 Optimize campaigns based on user quality, engagement, retention, watch time, and
  
monetization performance.
  
 Conduct A/B testing of video creatives, hooks, ad copies, audience segments, and
  
campaign structures.
  
 Collaborate with the creative team to develop high-performing promotional content,
  
drama clips, trailers, teasers, and ad creatives.
  
 Analyze user acquisition funnels and identify opportunities to improve install-to-
  
registration and registration-to-viewer conversions.
  
 Track campaign performance, user behavior, retention, and revenue using analytics
  
and attribution tools.
  
 Identify new traffic sources, advertising platforms, and growth opportunities for
  
scaling app users.
  
 Manage advertising budgets and ensure efficient allocation across campaigns and
  
channels.
  
 Prepare performance reports and provide actionable insights to improve growth and
  
campaign profitability.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications-
  
 2–5 years of experience in app marketing, mobile user acquisition, or performance
  
marketing.
  
 Hands-on experience running app install and user acquisition campaigns.
  
 Experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other paid acquisition platforms.
  
 Preferably experience with entertainment apps, OTT platforms, short-video apps,
  
micro-drama apps, or content-based applications.
  
 Strong understanding of CPI, CAC, CPA, CTR, CVR, ROAS, retention, LTV, and
  
monetization metrics.
  
 Experience in performance-driven video creative testing and optimization.
  
 Understanding of mobile app attribution, conversion tracking, and event-based
  
optimization.
  
 Analytical mindset with the ability to make data-driven marketing decisions.
  
 Ability to scale campaigns while maintaining acquisition costs and user quality.
  
  
Preferred Experience-
  
 Experience marketing micro-drama, short-form storytelling, OTT, streaming, or video
  
content apps.
  
 Familiarity with AppsFlyer, Adjust, Firebase, Google Analytics, or similar tracking
  
and analytics tools.
  
 Experience with subscription-based apps, in-app purchases, pay-per-episode models,
  
or other app monetization models.
  
 Experience in Android app user acquisition campaigns.
  
 Understanding of content-led marketing, audience segmentation, and performance-
  
based creative strategies.
  
  
Key Performance Metrics-
  
 Cost Per Install (CPI)
  
 Cost Per Registration
  
 Cost Per Active User
  
 Cost Per Paying User
  
 Conversion Rate
  
 Retention Rate
  
 ROAS
  
 Lifetime Value (LTV)
  
 Watch Time & Engagement
  
 Paid User Acquisition & Campaign Scaling
  
  
Candidate Profile-
  
We are looking for someone who understands that app marketing is not just about generating
  
downloads, but about acquiring users who actively consume content, return to the app, and
  
eventually contribute to revenue. Candidates with hands-on experience in user acquisition for entertainment, OTT, short-video,
  
mobile gaming, or micro-drama applications will be preferred.
  
Interested candidates can share their resumes along with details of their previous app
  
marketing campaigns, platforms managed, budgets handled, and user acquisition
  
results.

CA Inter (Both Groups Cleared) / Semi-Qualified CA / Final Appearing

0 – 3 Years (Articleship / Post-Qualification Combined)

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically sound Finance Associate to join our practice. The incumbent will work closely with the senior team on a cross-functional mandate spanning accounts preparation, statutory compliance, and direct and indirect taxation. This role is ideally suited to a CA Intermediate-qualified professional (both groups cleared) or a semi-qualified Chartered Accountant who is keen to develop a robust, practice-oriented understanding of Indian tax laws, financial reporting, and client advisory work.

The position offers direct exposure to diverse client engagements across income tax, GST, TDS, and accounts finalization — providing an excellent platform for candidates targeting their final CA examinations or seeking to consolidate their articleship experience in a structured, high-quality environment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS**

**A.  Accounts & Financial Reporting**

▸    
Preparation and maintenance of books of accounts using Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime, including ledger management, journal entries, bank reconciliation, and month-end closings.

▸    
Assistance in preparation of financial statements — Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet — in accordance with applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IGAAP as applicable).

▸    
Conducting voucher verification, expense scrutiny, and supporting statutory audit / internal audit engagements.

▸    
Preparation of MIS reports, cash flow statements, and client-specific financial summaries on a periodic basis.

▸    
Reconciliation of accounts payable / receivable, vendor statements, and inter-company ledgers.

**B.  Income Tax Compliance & Advisory**

▸    
Computation of total income and tax liability for individuals, HUFs, partnership firms, LLPs, and companies under the Income Tax Act, 1961.

▸    
Preparation and timely filing of Income Tax Returns (ITR-1 through ITR-6 as applicable) on the Income Tax portal.

▸    
Assistance in preparation and filing of Tax Audit Reports — Form 3CA/3CB and Form 3CD — under Section 44AB.

▸    
Working knowledge of advance tax computation and payment schedules; assistance in self-assessment tax calculations.

▸    
Support in handling income tax notices, preparation of written submissions and rectification applications under Sections 143(1), 143(3), 147, and 154.

▸    
Research and documentation of tax positions, exemptions, deductions (Chapter VI-A), and capital gains computations.

**C.  GST Compliance & Advisory**

▸    
Preparation and filing of monthly / quarterly GST returns — GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, and GSTR-9C — within prescribed due dates.

▸    
Reconciliation of GSTR-2B with purchase register and identification of ITC discrepancies; follow-up with vendors for rectification.

▸    
Review of Input Tax Credit (ITC) eligibility under Sections 16 to 17 of the CGST Act, 2017, including applicability of Section 17(5) restrictions.

▸    
Applicability analysis of Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) under Section 9(3) and 9(4) of the CGST Act and corresponding notifications.

▸    
Assistance in GST registration, amendments, and cancellation procedures; drafting responses to GST notices and SCNs.

▸    
Tracking of GST amendments, circulars, and notifications issued by CBIC; updating compliance checklists accordingly.

**D.  TDS / TCS Compliance**

▸    
Determination of TDS applicability, correct section, rate, and threshold for payments to residents and non-residents (including DTAA analysis for non-resident payments).

▸    
Monthly computation of TDS liability and timely challan payments; preparation and filing of quarterly TDS returns — Form 24Q, 26Q, and 27Q.

▸    
Issuance and reconciliation of TDS certificates (Form 16 / Form 16A) and resolution of 26AS / AIS mismatch queries.

▸    
Assistance in filing TDS correction statements (NSDL / TRACES portal) and responding to TDS-related default notices.

**E.  Statutory & Regulatory Compliance Support**

▸    
Support in PF, ESI, and professional tax computation and payment; maintenance of payroll registers for clients.

▸    
Assistance with ROC compliance, including maintenance of statutory registers, preparation of Board Resolutions, and filing of annual returns (Form MGT-7, AOC-4) under the Companies Act, 2013 (where applicable).

▸    
Maintaining a compliance calendar and ensuring adherence to all statutory deadlines across multiple clients.

CA Intermediate: Both groups cleared (IPCC / Intermediate as per ICAI revised scheme); or

▸    
Semi-Qualified CA: CA Final appearing / registered with articleship completed or partially completed; or

▸    
B.Com / M.Com graduates with dedicated articleship experience under a practicing CA firm (with demonstrable tax and accounts exposure).

description:

**Here**
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
  
  
**About The Project**
The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) has launched the Metropolitan Disease Surveillance Strengthening component under the Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM). This initiative, supported by the World Bank through the Transforming India’s Public Health Systems for Pandemic Preparedness Program (PHSPP), covers 20 cities across India. PATH has been selected as a key partner by the World Bank in establishing a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to provide expert guidance in the design and implementation of this initiative. The TSU will provide strategic direction and technical support for the initial two years of the program, leveraging global experience and best practices to strengthen metropolitan disease surveillance. The primary objective is to facilitate operationalization, address challenges, and promote innovations as global public goods.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Consultant – Planning and Finance Management will be instrumental in guiding the strategic implementation, monitoring, and enhancement of the metropolitan disease surveillance program. This role involves collaboration with national health authorities, stakeholders, and technical partners to ensure the program’s success and sustainability. The Consultant will lead initiatives aimed at improving planning, financial management, and sustainable financing for public health interventions across metropolitan cities.
  
  
**Duty Location:**
National Centre for Disease Control, Delhi
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**

* Strategic Planning and Budgeting: Assess cost norms from global metropolitan cities and provide recommendations for realistic planning and budgeting of activities for the metropolitan disease surveillance program.
* Funds Flow and Financial Systems: Evaluate the existing funds flow systems of the program, identifying areas to improve efficiency and transparency in financial management.
* Financial Reporting and Accountability: Analyze the accounting and financial reporting mechanisms to enhance timeliness, accuracy, and accountability in financial reporting.
* Sustainable Financing Solutions: Develop strategies for ensuring sustainable financing for metropolitan surveillance units post-PM-ABHIM, ensuring the long-term financial viability of the program.
* Capacity Building: Provide technical assistance and capacity-building support to finance and administrative teams within metropolitan surveillance units to enhance financial management practices.
* Monitoring and Evaluation: Develop and implement monitoring tools to track the financial performance of the program, ensuring alignment with planned budgets and timely disbursement of funds.
* Policy Recommendations: Collaborate with government counterparts to provide policy recommendations aimed at strengthening planning and finance management for metropolitan disease surveillance.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field. A Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CPA, CMA, CFA) is a plus.
* Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in planning, financial management, or related roles within public health, international development, or government sectors.

**Essential Skills**

* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi, with the ability to convey complex technical information.
* Project Management: Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), familiar with financial management software and digital tools for data analysis.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with government counterparts, donors, and development partners at national and state levels.
* Health Systems Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of India’s health system, particularly in the context of disease surveillance and key national programs like NHM, Ayushman Bharat, PM-ABHIM, and others.
* Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time for program-related activities.

*The candidate must have legal authorization to work in India.*

title: We're Hiring | Graphic Designer - Happa Foods
description:
**Graphic Designer – (Brand, Social & Packaging)**

1. Okhla Phase-1, New Delhi · Full-time, on-site
2. 1–2 years' experience
3. Degree or diploma in design required
4. ₹18,000–25,000 per month

**Designers, not DTP operators.**

We're hiring the first designer on Happa's founding marketing team. 🎨

**About Happa**

At Happa, we make honest food for kids: certified-organic purees, cereals, puffs, melts, fruit snacks and spreads. No added sugar. No preservatives. Nothing a parent wouldn't put in themselves.
**Bas.**

We started in 2018 with one belief: good eating habits begin early. Very, very early. Today you'll find Happa on happafoods.com, Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart, and in 10+ countries. Our brand is bright, bold and playful, and we want it to look that way everywhere a parent sees it.

**Join Happa's founding marketing team**

We're building our marketing team from scratch, and you'll be one of its first two people. You'll work with our Social Media & Community Lead and report directly to our Founder & CEO. Together, you'll shape how Happa looks and sounds: on Instagram, on the shelf, and in every country we sell in.

**We're looking for a designer, not a software operator.**

Knowing Photoshop isn't enough. We want someone who understands
*why*
a design works: hierarchy, typography, colour, grids, contrast and balance. Someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into something parents stop and look at.

This is a startup. You'll move fast, wear many hats and see your work go live within days, not months. Do great work, and you grow as the team grows.

**What you'll do**

🎨
**Social media & content**

* Design posts, carousels, stories and ad creatives for Instagram, YouTube and Facebook
* Edit reels and videos: cuts, text, motion graphics, music and subtitles
* Bring your own ideas. Don't just wait for briefs.

🖼️
**Banners, posters & catalogue**

* Design banners for happa, Amazon, Flipkart and quick-commerce apps
* Create product listing images, A+ content and catalogue pages
* Design posters, flyers, standees and in-store material

📦
**Packaging**

* Design and adapt packaging for new products and new markets
* Prepare print-ready files and work with our printers
* Keep every pack consistent with Happa's brand guidelines

🌍
**Global distribution network**

* Create brand kits, catalogues, sales decks and social media templates for our partners in other countries
* Adapt designs for different markets while keeping Happa's brand consistent

**Must-haves**

* **A degree or diploma in design**
  (B.Des, BFA / Applied Art, Communication or Graphic Design) from a recognised institute
* **A strong grasp of design principles:**
  typography, colour theory, layout and grids, visual hierarchy, contrast and balance
* 1–2 years of design experience at a brand, an agency, a D2C startup, or a strong freelance practice
* Good with Photoshop, Illustrator and Canva
* Can edit video in Premiere Pro, CapCut or similar
* Knows the basics of print: CMYK, bleed, dielines and print-ready files

**Good to have**

* After Effects or motion design skills
* Figma
* Experience with FMCG, food or kids' brands
* Comfortable using AI tools to explore ideas faster

**You're probably not a fit if you**

* Mainly do DTP or layout work on other people's designs
* Can't explain why you made a design choice
* Only work from ready-made templates
* Are looking for a remote role
* Prefer a slow, settled corporate pace

**Why join Happa**

* **Your work becomes the brand.**
  As one of our first two marketing hires, you'll set how Happa looks for years.
* **Seen in 10+ countries.**
  Your designs will be on screens, on shelves and on our partners' pages around the world.
* **Learn from the founder.**
  You'll work with him directly, every day.
* **Real growth.**
  A performance review at 6 months, and a bigger role and pay as the team grows if you deliver.

**How to apply**

Email
**connect@nascens.com**
with:

1. **Your CV**
   , including your design education (institute, course, year)
2. **Your portfolio**
   (Behance, Drive or PDF), including at least:

* 3 social media posts or ad creatives
* 1 edited video or reel
* 1 banner, poster or packaging piece
* **1 project that shows your process:**
  sketches, options you rejected, and the final design

1. **A short task:**
   pick any one post on Happa's Instagram and redesign it. In 3–4 lines, explain what you changed and which design principle you used to decide.

**Before you apply, please confirm:**

✅ You have a degree or diploma in design

✅ ₹18,000–25,000 per month works for you

✅ You can work full-time from our office in Okhla Phase-1, New Delhi, [5/6] days a week

✅ You can join within [30] days

**Our process**

Portfolio review → 48-hour design task → 30-minute call with our founder → paid trial day at our office

**One last thing**

At Happa, we keep things short and honest. No fluff. No funny business.
**Bas.**

So start your email subject with the word
**"Bas"**
. For example:
*Bas – Graphic Designer – Your Name*

* No "Bas", no read. 😊

Search is changing. People now get answers from AI assistants and AI Overviews, not only from ten blue links. We’re looking for an **AI SEO Specialist** who understands both classic SEO and the new world of AI search (AEO – Answer Engine Optimization, GEO – Generative Engine Optimization), and who uses AI tools smartly to move faster without losing quality.

title: Agentic Business Process Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an
**Agentic Business Process Analyst**
to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.
  
  
The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.
  
  
This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.
* Experience identifying AI use cases, automation candidates, decision support opportunities, or agentic process patterns.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.

What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe: Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. title: Academic Operations Lead - Noida
description:
**Academic Operations Lead: Pre-Foundation (Grades 6-8)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an academic operations lead to own the end-to-end academic vision, quality, and outcomes of our pre-foundation program for grades 6-8. This program builds the conceptual base in mathematics, science (physics, chemistry, and biology), and mental ability/logical reasoning that prepares students for school excellence, Olympiads, and scholarship exams, and later for JEE/NEET-oriented foundation courses in grades 9-10.

You will lead curriculum design, faculty excellence, assessment strategy, and student learning outcomes across live, hybrid, and recorded formats, and work closely with product, marketing, operations, and tech to build a program that is academically rigorous, engaging for young learners, and scalable across cities and languages.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Academic Vision and Strategy**

* Define the academic roadmap for Grades 6-8 aligned to NCERT/NEP 2020 and major state boards, extended with conceptual depth, application, and competitive-exam readiness.
* Design a clear progression from Pre-Foundation to Foundation (Grades 9-10) and onward to JEE/NEET, so students and parents see a long-term learning path.
* Set annual and quarterly academic OKRs covering learning outcomes, engagement, retention, and results.

**2. Curriculum and Content Excellence**

* Own the curriculum framework, session plans, study material, DPPs (daily practice problems), worksheets, question banks, and revision modules for all subjects.
* Ensure content is age-appropriate, concept-first, and storytelling-led, with visual and activity-based learning suited to 11-14-year-olds.
* Build integrated modules for Olympiads and scholarship exams (e.g., IMO, NSO, IOQM pathway, NTSE-style reasoning, institute-level scholarship tests).
* Maintain a rigorous content review cycle covering accuracy, difficulty calibration, language quality, and error-free delivery.
* Lead localization of content across English, Hindi, and regional languages where relevant.

**3. Faculty Hiring, Training, and Performance**

* Build and lead a high-caliber team of subject matter experts, teachers, content creators, and academic coordinators.
* Define the faculty hiring bar: demo classes, subject tests, communication, and child-engagement parameters.
* Run structured onboarding, classroom observation, peer reviews, and continuous upskilling programs focused on pedagogy for middle-school learners.
* Track faculty performance through student feedback, class quality scores, doubt-resolution turnaround, and learning outcomes. Drive recognition and corrective action.

**4. Assessment and Learning Outcomes**

* Design the assessment architecture: chapter tests, cumulative tests, unit assessments, mock Olympiads, and periodic diagnostic tests.
* Use analytics to identify concept gaps, track cohort performance, and personalize remediation.
* Own academic result metrics such as test performance, Olympiad/scholarship ranks, concept mastery scores, attendance, and completion rates.
* Work with the Data and Product teams to build dashboards and performance reports for students, parents, and leadership.

**5. Student Experience and Engagement**

* Create academic engagement mechanisms: doubt-clearing sessions, mentoring, parent-teacher meetings, quizzes, challenges, and gamified learning.
* Ensure timely, high-quality doubt resolution through live support, chat, and recorded explainers.
* Oversee parent communication on academic progress, with clear and meaningful progress reports.
* Monitor NPS, CSAT, and academic feedback and close the loop with product and operations.

**6. Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Product and Tech to shape learning features such as adaptive practice, AI-assisted doubt solving, interactive content, and analytics.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales on academic positioning, demo sessions, scholarship tests, and parent counseling content.
* Work with Operations to maintain scheduling, batch quality, and delivery across online, offline, and hybrid centers.
* Present academic performance and strategy to senior leadership regularly.

**7. Governance and Quality**

* Establish SOPs, quality checklists, and academic audit processes across content and delivery.
* Ensure child safety, data privacy, and ethical teaching practices in all academic operations.
* Manage academic budgets, vendor partners, and content costs effectively.

**Must have**

* **8-12+ years**
  of experience in K-12, foundation, or competitive-exam education, with at least
  **3-5 years in academic leadership**
  (academic head, program head, center head, senior faculty lead, or equivalent).
* Proven experience building or scaling pre-foundation/foundation/Olympiad programs for grades 6-10 at an edtech company or leading a coaching institute.
* Strong command of NCERT, CBSE/ICSE/state-board curricula and competitive-exam patterns for the middle-school level.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor large academic teams (faculty, content, and assessment).

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Student learning outcomes: test scores, concept mastery, and Olympiad/scholarship results
* Student attendance, engagement, and course completion rates
* Retention and renewal rates for the pre-foundation cohort
* Faculty quality scores, class ratings, and doubt-resolution turnaround
* Content quality: error rate, review turnaround, and on-time delivery
* Parent and student satisfaction (NPS / CSAT)
* Team attrition and capability-building metrics

title: Senior Analyst - FP&A
description:
**About the Role**

Qualicentric embeds senior finance capability inside US mid-market companies and deal teams, delivering the analytical depth of a Big-4 or specialist advisory practice at the economics of an outsourced model. The Senior Analyst sits at the core of this delivery – translating raw client data into the financial models, reports, and diligence workpapers that drive CFO decisions and deal outcomes.

Unlike a traditional in-house analyst role, you will work across two complementary mandates. On the ongoing advisory side, you support FP&A and management reporting for clients where Qualicentric acts as an embedded finance function. On the transaction side, you build the analytical workpapers underpinning Quality of Earnings and working capital analyses for live US deal mandates. The skillset is the same; the context shifts by engagement.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in the quality of their own work product – who notices when a number does not reconcile, who formats a model so it can be audited, and who asks the right question before building in the wrong direction.

**What You Will Do**

**1. FP&A & Management Reporting**

* Build and maintain driver-based financial models: monthly actuals vs. budget variance analysis, rolling forecasts, and scenario analyses under the direction of the Manager
* Prepare management reporting deliverables – monthly P&L packs, KPI dashboards, and variance commentary decks – ensuring numbers tie end-to-end across all schedules
* Populate and maintain integrated three-statement models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with operating KPI bridges; flag model integrity issues proactively
* Maintain 13-week cash flow trackers and covenant compliance schedules with weekly updates coordinated against client accounting data
* Support CFO presentation preparation: build charts, tables, and bridge analyses in Excel and PowerPoint to a client-ready standard
* Perform ad hoc financial analyses – pricing and margin analyses, department-level cost deep-dives, customer profitability reviews – as directed by the engagement lead

**2. Financial Due Diligence & Transaction Support**

* Build and maintain the QoE workbook – populating normalising adjustment schedules, sourcing supporting documents from the data room, and maintaining a clean audit trail for each adjustment
* Construct revenue disaggregation analyses: customer-level waterfall schedules, cohort trends, channel mix, and concentration summaries across the trailing analysis period
* Build working capital analyses: monthly NWC calculation schedules, seasonality overlays, and peg determination support under the direction of the engagement Manager
* Populate net debt schedules – debt instruments, capital lease obligations, deferred revenue, unfunded liabilities – with values sourced directly from client balance sheets and supporting documents
* Prepare management information schedules and document request trackers; maintain version control across data room iterations
* Draft supporting sections of the FDD report – revenue analysis, working capital commentary, net debt schedule – with clear sourcing, defined adjustment logic, and consistent formatting

**3. Quality, Process & Practice Support**

**Job Description**

Job Purpose :

Data Platform Services is building a governed, metadata-driven data integration and staging platform centered on SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and enterprise databases/data lakes — spanning source ingestion (SAP ERP/S/4HANA, non-SAP systems), a source-faithful central staging repository, long-term archival, and controlled distribution to multiple downstream systems.

We're looking for a DataOps Engineer who treats ETL pipeline design, data flows, and access-control logic as configuration, not one-off code — someone who builds and maintains systems where metadata tables and control frameworks drive what gets executed (jobs, interfaces, delta loads, transformations, and security masking), rather than hand-crafting individual one-off BODS jobs for every new dataset or consumer.

You'll work across ingestion (landing central staging archive), retention/partitioning strategy, and the routing/distribution rules engine that determines how data is extracted, transformed, filtered, or masked across multiple major downstream systems.

What You'll Do

* Build and operate robust batch and incremental change data capture (CDC) ingestion pipelines using SAP Data Services (BODS) from SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, SLT, ODP/Extractors) and non-SAP sources into central staging repositories/databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, SAP HANA, or Cloud Storage).
* Design and maintain metadata-driven ETL generation & execution frameworks — where dataset onboarding (new source table, delta logic, schema mapping, validation rules) is driven by configuration tables and reusable BODS templates/scripts rather than creating bespoke data flows from scratch.
* Implement and maintain partition-based retention, database archiving, and extraction routines for historical data and rolling window retention policies (e.g., current + N prior years).
* Build and maintain a dataset routing-rules engine: a governed metadata table (splittable, target\_systems[], row\_filter\_expr, column\_mask\_expr) that programmatically directs and transforms BODS distribution jobs and target views per downstream system.
* Own BODS repository architecture & governance: manage local/central repositories, Data Services Management Console (DSMC), user access security, environment promotion (Dev/Test/Prod), and execution auditing/lineage.
* Drive DataOps & CI/CD automation: streamline BODS export/import/transport automation, repository synchronization, and job scheduling via Enterprise Scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys, Control-M, Airflow, or Azure Data Factory).
* Monitor pipeline health, job execution logs, CDC checkpoint integrity, schema drift, and data SLAs; establish automated alerting and self-healing for job failures and data-freshness breaches.
* Collaborate with upstream SAP functional/basis teams to define data contracts (e.g., Delta queue/ODP parameters, timestamps, extraction load impact) and downstream teams to translate their access/filter requirements into routing rules.
* Document pipeline architecture, data dictionaries, retention policies, and routing logic for auditability and seamless developer onboarding.

**️** Required Skills & Experience

Core Platform & SAP BODS

* Hands-on experience with SAP Data Services (BODS 4.x) designing complex Batch Jobs, Real-time Services, Workflows, Data Flows, and custom Scripts/Functions.
* Strong expertise in extracting data from SAP environments (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, ODP extractors, SLT, IDocs, RFC/BAPIs) as well as non-SAP flat files, REST APIs, and relational databases.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and relational database internals (e.g., SAP HANA, SQL Server, Oracle): query optimization, indexing, table partitioning, push-down SQL execution, and incremental CDC logic.
* Solid experience with BODS Central Repository management, object check-in/out workflows, version control, and multi-user development standards.

Metadata-Driven Engineering (Critical)

* Demonstrable background designing or maintaining metadata/config-driven ETL frameworks — e.g., control/registry tables driving dynamic SQL generation, parameterized BODS global variables, or generic reusable data flow templates.
* Strong understanding of keeping generated ETL processes and target tables in sync with a source-of-truth ruleset, including schema versioning and change auditability.
* Experience implementing automated audit logging, error handling, row-count reconciliations, and execution metrics captured directly via BODS scripts and database tables.

Platform Engineering / DataOps

* ETL Orchestration & Scheduling: Experience managing automated job schedules and dependency management via BODS Management Console, Azure Data Factory, Control-M, Airflow, or Autosys.
* CI/CD & Version Control: Experience applying software engineering discipline to BODS (e.g., Git integration/documentation, automated repository migrations, deployment scripts).
* Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to automate file transfers, API interactions, and operational tasks around the BODS platform.
* Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience setting up alerting, performance bottleneck troubleshooting (memory/buffer tuning in BODS), and data validation frameworks.

Governance & Collaboration

* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance: access control models, data lineage, retention/compliance-driven deletion, and data masking/obfuscation techniques for sensitive data (PII).
* Experience serving multiple downstream consumers with varying analytical and operational requirements by delivering filtered and governed interfaces.
* Clear written communication habits; ability to articulate complex ETL architectures and governance rules to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience with SAP Information Steward (data quality profiling, rule building, metadata management).
* Hands-on experience integrating SAP BODS with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS S3).
* Exposure to SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT) or SAP Data Intelligence / Datasphere.
* Experience in large-scale multi-tenant enterprise environments supporting cross-functional business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial).

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

Config-Driven Onboarding: Standard source table onboarding (source

* landing/staging) is reduced to a configuration-driven process using reusable BODS templates, drastically reducing manual job creation.
* Automated Retention & Purging: Automated partition/date-based archiving and retention mechanisms are operational across staging repositories.
* Operational Routing Rules: A central metadata-driven routing table governs downstream extraction/distribution, dynamically applying required column masking and row filters.
* Resilient DataOps: Automated alerting, execution telemetry, and standard environment promotion workflows are established and fully documented.

description:

**Description**
**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
Most sales roles focus on selling products. This role focuses on transforming businesses.
  
  
As a Practice Development Manager (PDM), you will help doctors and practices adopt new technologies, embrace digital workflows, expand treatment capabilities, and unlock growth opportunities that improve both practice performance and patient outcomes.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of: Healthcare | Medical Technology | Digital Transformation | Business Consulting | Practice Growth | Customer Success | Commercial Leadership
  
  
This is not simply a territory sales role. It is an opportunity to influence how healthcare innovation is adopted and delivered every day.
  
  
**Why Align?**
**Build a Career Beyond Traditional Sales -**
At Align, you are not just responsible for driving revenue. You are responsible for helping customers transform how they work. You will become a trusted advisor to doctors and practice teams, helping them improve clinical confidence, streamline workflows, elevate patient experiences, and grow sustainable businesses.
  
  
**Join a Company Shaping the Future of Healthcare -**
Align's digital ecosystem integrates advanced software, AI and machine learning, digital imaging, visualization, biomechanics, and material science to deliver industry-leading solutions worldwide.
  
  
**Be Part of India's Growth Story -**
India represents one of the most exciting opportunities within Align's global growth journey. As Align continues to expand its commercial presence, digital capability, and operational footprint in India, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a business that is shaping the future of healthcare technology in one of the world's most dynamic markets.

**Drive Territory Growth**

* Develop and execute strategic territory plans using customer insight, commercial data, and opportunity analysis.
* Grow existing customer partnerships while acquiring and activating new customers.
* Convert new and existing practices into advocates of digital orthodontics and clear aligner treatment.
* Identify high-potential opportunities and prioritize activities that drive sustainable business growth.

**Become a Strategic Business Partner**

* Build trusted, long-term partnerships with doctors and practice teams.
* Understand each customer's clinical, commercial, and patient-focused objectives.
* Act as a strategic advisor rather than a transactional seller.
* Help practices identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, adoption, profitability, and patient experience.

**Lead Value-Based Commercial Conversations**

* Conduct structured, consultative conversations that uncover explicit and unspoken customer needs.
* Demonstrate the commercial and clinical value of Align solutions.
* Differentiate Align through insight-led selling rather than price-based selling.
* Confidently navigate competitive environments and complex objections.

**Drive Digital Transformation**

* Champion the Align Digital Workflow (ADW) and associated digital technologies.
* Help practices integrate digital workflows into daily operations.
* Demonstrate how technology can improve predictability, efficiency, patient engagement, and treatment outcomes.
* Become a trusted advocate for innovation and digital adoption.

**Deliver Meaningful Customer Impact**

* Support clinicians in developing confidence and capability in clear aligner treatment.
* Share evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
* Help practices improve patient outcomes and treatment experiences.
* Enable long-term practice transformation through technology and partnership.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**

**Growth Builders |**
They see opportunities where others see obstacles.
  
  
**Strategic Thinkers |**
They manage territories like businesses.
  
  
**Trusted Advisors |**
They earn credibility with customers through insight and partnership.
  
  
**Digital Advocates |**
They help customers embrace new technologies and ways of working.
  
  
**Category Creators |**

Many candidates initially view digital dentistry as a niche category. We see it differently.
  
  
While the category is specialized, the capabilities you build are broad and highly transferable. As a Practice Development Manager, you will develop expertise in strategic selling, customer transformation, digital adoption, territory leadership, commercial strategy, and market development.
  
  
**Digital dentistry is the category you enter. Healthcare transformation is the capability you build.**

title: Lead – FPC Accelerator & Market Linkage
description:
* **Designation:**
  Lead – FPC Accelerator & Market Linkage
* **Organization:**
  SwitchON Foundation
* **Location:**
  Kolkata (Open to travel across India)
* **Work Experience:**
  8+ years of relevant experience
* **Compensation:**
  12- 18LPA per annum
* **Language Proficiency:**
  English; Hindi or regional languages preferred

**About SwitchON**

SwitchON Foundation
(est 2008) is a mission-driven organization working to strengthen
**sustainable agriculture, rural livelihoods, and climate resilience**
. We partner with Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), Climate startups, investors, and institutions to build scalable solutions that create both economic and social impact.

Our growing enterprise platform combines
**acceleration, advisory, market access, capacity building, and investment facilitation**
to help FPCs and agri-enterprises and other climates become sustainable, growth-oriented businesses. Through strategic partnerships and ecosystem support, we enable enterprises to scale their impact and reach.

The SwitchON Foundation is part of the ON Universe, which operates an accelerator, impact fund and advisory that is dedicated to supporting proximate climate startups / social entrepreneurs and FPCs. Through the Greenovation and ONganic Accelerator—which runs challenges, bootcamps, and cohort-based programs—and the
EarthON Fund,
which leverages blended capital approaches, we address complex climate challenges across the Global South.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic leader to drive the growth of
**our FPC and Agri Enterprise Accelerator**
. The role involves working closely with farmer-owned businesses, startups, investors, corporates, and ecosystem partners to strengthen market access, enterprise growth, fundraising, and investment readiness.

This is an opportunity to build and scale a high-impact platform that supports the next generation of agricultural and rural enterprises while creating meaningful impact for farming communities.

This role requires a combination of experience across
**agri marketing, FPO business development, startup ecosystems, fundraising, and leadership**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Agri Marketing & Market Access - IPM / NPM and Organic Produce**

* Lead market linkage and commercialization strategies for FPOs and agri-enterprises.
* Develop B2B, B2G, institutional, retail, export, and value-chain partnerships.
* Support FPOs in product positioning, branding, aggregation, processing, and market expansion.
* Identify new market opportunities for agricultural produce, value-added products, and climate-smart enterprises.
* Build relationships with buyers, corporates, processors, retailers, exporters, and agri-market platforms.

**Market Development & Buyer Relationships**

* Identify and build relationships with
  **anchor buyers, institutional buyers, retailers, processors, exporters and other market actors**
  .
* Plan and execute Buyer–Seller Meets, trade fairs, and exhibitions in collaboration with government agencies, CSR partners, and private sector players.
* Organize and lead FPOs and SHGs to participate in trade fairs/expos, ensuring their visibility and access to new markets.
* Develop market opportunities based on specific FPO commodities, production volumes and quality.
* Explore contract farming, buy-back arrangements, forward contracts and other structured market models where appropriate, 1 contract buyer per FPO.
* Facilitate Buyer–FPO engagement, negotiations, sampling, pricing and commercial agreements.
* Build long-term buyer relationships rather than one-time market linkages.
* Track market performance, buyer satisfaction and repeat business for all FPOs.

**Value Chain & Contract Farming Development**

* Identify promising value chains where FPOs can participate in higher-value markets.
* Map demand, pricing, quality specifications, production requirements and supply gaps.
* Work with buyers to develop suitable production and procurement models for FPOs.
* Facilitate contract farming or structured procurement arrangements where commercially viable and beneficial to farmers.
* Ensure that market arrangements are transparent, fair and commercially sustainable for FPOs and farmers.

**Commercialisation & Business Development**

* Help assess unit economics, pricing, margins, working capital requirements
* Identify opportunities for collective processing, value addition, branding and packaging.

**Accelerator design**

* Contribute to the design of accelerator programs for FPOs and rural agri business.
* Develop frameworks for FPO governance, enterprise growth, market readiness, and investment readiness, team capacity
* Build a strong mentor, investor, and partner network.

**Enterprise Development**

* Mentor founders and FPO leaders on business strategy, growth planning, and scaling.
* Support enterprises in developing sustainable business models and revenue streams.
* Facilitate access to grants, debt, equity, and blended finance.

**Partnerships & Ecosystem Building**

* Establish strategic partnerships with investors, incubators, corporates, government agencies, and development institutions.
* Position SwitchON as a leading organization in the FPO and agri-enterprise ecosystem.

**Team & Program Management**

* Build and lead a high-performing team.
* Ensure achievement of program outcomes, budgets, and impact metrics.
* Drive operational excellence and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 8 - 15 years of professional experience.
* Minimum 3 years of entrepreneurship experience as:
* Founder / Co-Founder, OR
* Founding Team Member, OR
* Business Unit Leader with significant P&L responsibility.
* Proven experience working with FPOs, farmer collectives, producer companies, or agri-enterprises.
* Strong experience in
  **agri marketing, market linkages, buyer engagement, value-chain development, or agri-business expansion**
  .
* Experience leading teams of 4+ professionals.

**Highly Preferred**

* Existing networks with agri-buyers, processors, retailers, exporters, and market platforms, along with willingness
* Readiness for regular travel across India to support FPOs, field partners, and market engagements. Experience in agritech startups, agribusinesses, accelerators, incubators, or impact enterprises.
* MBA, PGDM, Agriculture, Rural Management, Agribusiness, or related qualification.

**Who Should Apply?**

You may be:

* A senior manager from an agritech / agri marketing company.
* A Senior Leader from an FPO-focused organization.
* An Agri Accelerator or Incubator Lead.
* A Founder or Co-Founder looking to lead a larger platform.
* A Growth, Partnerships, or Market Development leader in agriculture.

title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

* Familiarity with Google Cloud, Google Workspace, AppSheet or Looker Studio
* Experience building AI evaluation frameworks, test sets or quality monitoring processes
* Knowledge of insurance operations, platforms and workflows, particularly carrier and broker portals
* Experience implementing enterprise RPA solutions or automations that work across multiple systems, including those without APIs

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and assess opportunities to apply AI and automation across insurance workflows, translating business processes and operational challenges into practical use cases
* Design and build AI-powered solutions using LLMs, AI agents, workflow automation platforms and document processing tools
* Develop integrations between AI solutions, business applications, email, document repositories and insurance platforms, working with the Technology team where needed
* Evaluate the feasibility, expected impact and implementation effort of proposed solutions, defining success criteria and measurable outcomes
* Lead the implementation of solutions from initial proof of concept through pilot testing, rollout and adoption within live operations
* Work with Operations teams and insurance subject matter experts to test solutions, measure accuracy, address exceptions and continuously improve performance

* Train users, prepare practical documentation and update work instructions to support adoption and consistent use of new workflows
* Track the business value of implemented solutions, including time savings, cost reduction, accuracy and operational efficiency, and share results with leadership

title: Lead Data / ML Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Lead Data / ML Engineer to take end-to-end technical ownership of a large-scale data and ML platform on AWS. You will design and build PySpark pipelines, bring ML models and LLM and agent-based capabilities into production, and own what you build from first design through to running it reliably in production.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. Architecture and leadership experience is welcome, but you will still write code every day, and you will be the person others turn to when a pipeline breaks, a job slows down, or a design needs a second opinion.
  
  
‍
  
  
**About The Work**
You will work with high-volume consumer transaction data, turning it into insights and predictive models that help understand and anticipate consumer behaviour. The work spans large-scale data processing, feature engineering, machine learning, and applying LLMs and agents to enrich and make sense of the data.
  
  
‍
  
  
‍
**Experience:**
7+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Kolkata (Rajarhat–Newtown)
  
  
**Mode of Working:**
WFO / Hybrid / Remote
  
  
**Timing:**
Ability to work in the US Eastern time zone. This may be relaxed to half day IST and half day US EST based on project needs.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* End-to-end ownership: you take a problem from design to production and stay accountable for it once it is live
* Hands-on depth: you write, review and debug production code yourself, not only design it
* Troubleshooting leadership: you help teammates diagnose failing jobs, performance problems and data issues, and leave them better at solving the next one
* Practical judgement on LLMs and agents: you know where they add real value in a data pipeline and how to measure whether they are working

‍
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and optimize large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines in PySpark on AWS (EMR, Glue), with strong attention to partitioning, skew, shuffle and cost.
* Productionize ML models and feature pipelines, including training data pipelines, batch and real-time inference, and model serving on SageMaker.
* Build LLM and agent-powered capabilities into data workflows, such as document and entity extraction, classification and enrichment at scale, RAG pipelines, and tool-calling agents, along with evaluation and monitoring of their output quality.
* Orchestrate complex workflows with Apache Airflow (MWAA or self-managed), ensuring reliability, observability and SLA adherence.
* Architect storage across S3 (data lake), Redshift (warehouse) and RDS, applying best practices for data modeling, partitioning, compression and cost optimization.
* Build containerized data services with Docker and ECS/Fargate, with CI/CD through GitHub Actions.
* Develop event-driven and serverless processing with Lambda, SQS, SNS and EventBridge.
* Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro) to speed up delivery, and set the team's standards for reviewing and validating AI-generated code.
* Be the go-to person for production issues: lead root-cause analysis on failing or slow jobs, data quality incidents and model problems, and help teammates debug their own work.
* Review code, guide design decisions and help engineers on the team grow technically.
* Implement data quality, monitoring and alerting frameworks, and enforce data governance, security and access-control policies.
* Contribute to infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK.

‍
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.
* 7+ years in data engineering or ML engineering, with at least 4 years of hands-on PySpark on production workloads at scale.
* Strong AWS production experience across EMR, S3, Redshift, RDS, Lambda, SageMaker and ECS.
* Practical, hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt design, embeddings and vector search, RAG, agent or tool-calling frameworks, and evaluating LLM output quality.
* Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training and validation, model deployment and monitoring.
* Experience working with large transactional or behavioural datasets is a strong plus.
* Strong Python and SQL. TypeScript is a plus.
* Experience with Apache Airflow and Docker in production.
* A track record of owning systems end to end in production, including on-call or production support, and of helping other engineers troubleshoot.
* Strong grasp of data modeling, governance and security best practices.

‍
  
  
**Good To Have**

* AWS certifications (Data Engineer Associate, Machine Learning Specialty, Solutions Architect)
* Experience with feature stores, MLOps tooling or model serving at scale
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)
* Experience optimizing costs for large AWS data workloads

‍
  
  
**Tech Stack At a Glance**

* Compute & Processing: PySpark on EMR, Glue, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SageMaker
* LLM & Agents: LLM APIs, embeddings and vector stores, RAG, agent frameworks
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow (MWAA), Step Functions
* Storage & Warehousing: S3, Redshift, RDS (PostgreSQL / MySQL)
* Containers & DevOps: Docker, ECS, GitHub Actions, Terraform
* AI-Assisted Dev: Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro
* Languages: Python, SQL, Bash

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer – New Product Developmen
description:
**Company:**
iNSPIRE Design

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment:**
Full-time, On-site

**Experience:**
Preferably 7–12 years

About iNSPIRE Design

iNSPIRE Design is an engineering, research and product development company working with domestic and international clients across medical devices, electromechanical systems, precision instruments and innovative consumer and industrial products.

Our work involves transforming early-stage ideas into functional, manufacturable and commercially viable products.

About the role

We are looking for a highly creative, technically strong and hands-on mechanical engineer with extensive experience in developing new products from scratch.

The ideal candidate should be capable of taking an initial product idea or functional requirement and rapidly translating it into practical engineering concepts, functional prototypes and manufacturing-ready solutions.

This is not a conventional CAD modelling or drafting role. We are looking for an engineer who understands the complete product development lifecycle and can independently solve complex engineering challenges across different industries and product categories.

Key responsibilities

* Rapidly conceptualize new products and develop innovative engineering solutions.
* Translate functional requirements into practical mechanical and electromechanical architectures.
* Develop mechanisms, plastic housings, structural components and functional assemblies.
* Explore and evaluate multiple design approaches before committing to detailed engineering.
* Select appropriate materials, components, manufacturing processes and assembly methods.
* Develop products incorporating electronic components, PCBs, sensors and actuators.
* Build, evaluate and refine functional prototypes through iterative development.
* Identify and resolve engineering, manufacturing, assembly and reliability challenges.
* Guide products through concept development, prototyping, validation and production readiness.
* Provide technical direction to engineers involved in detailed design and product development.
* Collaborate with industrial designers, research engineers, electronics engineers and manufacturing partners.

Required skills and experience

* Demonstrated experience in developing physical products from concept to production.
* Exceptional mechanical reasoning, creativity and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals and mechanism design.
* Experience designing plastic components, housings and complex mechanical assemblies.
* Practical knowledge of injection moulding, machining, sheet metal fabrication and rapid prototyping.
* Strong understanding of material selection, tolerances, assembly methods and design for manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with functional prototyping, testing and troubleshooting.
* Ability to rapidly generate, evaluate and communicate engineering concepts.
* Proficiency in SolidWorks or equivalent 3D CAD software.
* Ability to independently take ownership of challenging product development assignments.

Preferred background

* Medical device research and development
* Consumer product development
* Electromechanical product development
* Robotics and precision engineering
* Hardware startups and product innovation companies
* Engineering design and product development consultancies

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline.

Candidates with exceptional demonstrated product development capabilities will be considered irrespective of years of experience.

Who should apply?

Engineers who are passionate about creating new products, solving unfamiliar problems, building prototypes and translating ideas into commercially viable solutions.

We particularly value candidates who have personally contributed to bringing physical products to market and who can demonstrate strong technical ownership throughout the development process.

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a practical product conceptualization and engineering problem-solving assessment.

title: Wellness Chef
description:
