title: Senior Power BI Developer (On Contract)
description:
Join us as a **PowerBI Consultant** to design, build and support enterprise reporting solutions across a mixed SAP and non-SAP landscape. The role will turn data migrated from Google BigQuery and integrated through Microsoft Fabric into governed, secure and performant Power BI products for companies still operating SAP ECC and for companies transitioning to SAP S/4HANA

### **How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Lead discovery workshops with business owners, SAP functional teams and data engineers; document KPI definitions, grain, filters, drill paths, reconciliation rules and acceptance criteria.
* Design and develop Power BI reports, executive dashboards, paginated reports and reusable certified semantic models using star-schema principles and clear business-friendly measures.
* Create advanced DAX calculations for time intelligence, currency conversion, variance, profitability, inventory, order fulfilment, production and financial reporting; use calculation groups where appropriate.
* Build and maintain Power Query transformations and data connections to Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, SQL endpoints, Direct Lake, Import and DirectQuery sources, selecting the right mode for latency and scale.
* Integrate reporting from SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA data structures, including business context for FI/CO, SD, MM, PP and inventory. Partner with SAP specialists to validate source semantics and transformation logic.
* Support historical reporting continuity after migration from Google BigQuery to Microsoft Fabric by validating row counts, totals, history, slowly changing dimensions and reconciliation to source reports.
* Implement data security end to end, including Microsoft Entra ID groups, workspace roles, app audiences, row-level security, object-level security, sensitivity labels and controlled Build permissions.
* Create deployment pipelines and promote content through development, test and production workspaces. Apply parameterisation, source binding, release notes and rollback practices.
* Optimise models and reports using Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, VertiPaq Analyzer and capacity metrics. Resolve slow visuals, inefficient DAX, excessive cardinality and capacity bottlenecks.
* Define report standards for navigation, accessibility, responsive layouts, naming, descriptions, endorsement, lineage and usage monitoring.
* Plan and execute unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing and user acceptance testing. Maintain traceability from requirement to test evidence.
* Provide production support, incident diagnosis, refresh monitoring and root-cause analysis; coach business users and junior developers and contribute reusable patterns and documentation.

### **Your Expertise:**

* 5+ years of hands-on Power BI development across at least three enterprise implementations; strong portfolio of production dashboards and semantic models.
* Expertise in dimensional modelling, relationships, filter context, DAX optimisation, calculation groups, incremental refresh and composite models.
* Practical implementation of RLS, OLS, Entra ID group-based access, workspace/app security, sensitivity labels, endorsement and tenant-aware governance.
* Working knowledge of OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, SQL analytics endpoint, Direct Lake, Dataflows Gen2, pipelines and Fabric capacity behaviour.
* Experience reporting from SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA; ability to understand SAP document flows, organisational structures and reconciliation expectations.
* Experience consuming Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL, SQL Server, BigQuery, files and REST/custom sources; good SQL and Power Query M skills.
* Experience with Git/source control concepts, deployment pipelines, testing, release management, monitoring and support in controlled enterprise environments.
* Strong English communication, workshop facilitation, estimation, documentation and stakeholder management across distributed teams

**Certifications -**

* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
* Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) or equivalent current Fabric credential.
* Exposure to SAP CDS views, OData, extractors, SAP BW or SAP Datasphere is advantageous.
* Experience in manufacturing, consumer goods, distribution or multi-company ERP transformation programmes.
* Understanding of financial reconciliation, master-data harmonisation and historical-data migration.

### **Why Join Westernacher?**

* Inspiring and exciting, innovative working environment.
* Competitive remuneration package (salary, bonus, benefits).
* International company culture and minimal hierarchical structure.
* Chance to work on complex projects from different industries.
* Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model.

* Performance, Optimization & Quality

* Use profiling tools and metrics to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks on both client and server.

* Apply solid software engineering principles, including clean code, design patterns, unit/integration/end-to-end testing, and code reviews to ensure high code quality.

* Agile Delivery & Collaboration

* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives).

* Estimate work items, manage technical debt, and deliver features on time.

* Work closely with architects, product owners, QA engineers, UX/UI designers, and other developers to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues, and deliver robust solutions.

* Software Update and Device Lifecycle Management

* Lead the design, development, and technical delivery of software update capabilities for connected devices and distributed device fleets.

* Develop and maintain workflows for software package creation, validation, assignment, distribution, installation, and update-status monitoring.

* Support staged rollouts, pilot deployments, update scheduling, version management, compatibility checks, rollback, recovery, and failure-handling mechanisms.

* Design reliable update processes that maintain device consistency and minimize service disruption during software deployment.

* Collaborate with device, platform, verification, service, cybersecurity, and DevOps teams to enable end-to-end software update integration.

* Troubleshoot complex update and deployment issues across cloud services, gateways, deployment components, and device-side software.

* Ensure update activities are traceable, auditable, secure, and aligned with applicable quality and regulatory processes.
* Documentation

* Produce clear, concise technical documentation for modules, APIs, front-end components, patterns, and development processes to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.

* Contribute to design systems, style guides, and coding standards for full stack development.

* Mentoring, Guidance & Knowledge Sharing

* Provide technical guidance to junior developers, perform code reviews, and share best practices within the team.

* Conduct technical sessions and help elevate overall full stack and cloud-native competency of the team.

* Generative & Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering (Desirable)

* Use Generative AI tools for code scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, and documentation to improve productivity and quality.

* Apply basic prompt engineering techniques to obtain reliable and secure outputs from AI tools.

Experiment with Agentic AI concepts where applicable (e.g., automating repetitive coding/testing tasks) under guidance from architects or technical leads where needed.

title: Data and AI Governance Architect
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

At Siemens, we have bold ambitions for driving digitalization and building a truly data- and AI-driven enterprise. By scaling the Siemens Data Mesh, establishing robust data foundations, and implementing cutting-edge governance frameworks, we are empowering the next generation of AI and digital excellence. We are looking for a visionary, tech-savvy Data & AI Governance Architect (Platform Architect) to serve as the critical technical bridge between governance policies and our modern platform ecosystem.

Move the world with your passion for data and impactful, responsible AI technologies. Rethink how we utilize data and manage AI models, steering the organization toward a future where trusted data, automated compliance, and ethical AI drive every technical decision. Be bold when others would have given up. In short, play a key role in unlocking the full potential of data and AI at Siemens!

As the Data & AI Governance Architect, your core mission is to 'enable the platforms' by turning governance policies and compliance mandates into working technology. Working in close partnership with the Data Governance Policy Lead, Enterprise Architects, and Platform Engineering squads, you will define the target architecture and technical blueprints for data cataloging, metadata management, automated lineage, data contracts, and AI model observability. You will champion frictionless, self-service developer experiences, ensuring governance is baked into platform architectures from the ground up.

**We are looking for: Data & AI Governance Architect**

**You’ll break new ground by:**

* Architect the Governance Platform Ecosystem: Design, evolve, and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint for Data & AI governance capabilities, including metadata discovery, automated lineage, data quality monitoring, access governance, and AI model tracking.
* Act as Technical Translator & Product Owner: Convert enterprise governance policies, data classification rules, and regulatory directives (e.g., GDPR, EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001) into actionable technical requirements, architectural decision records (ADRs), user stories, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Embed Policy-as-Code & Automated Guardrails: Champion the technical automation of governance controls across the entire data and AI lifecycle—implementing shift-left governance, automated schema validation, data contracts, and automated policy enforcement within CI/CD and MLOps pipelines.
* Architect AI & Machine Learning Governance Capabilities: Design technical solutions for model inventory registration, AI risk tiering, training data lineage, model cards, bias/drift detection, explainability metrics, and compliance logging for both predictive models and Generative AI / LLM solutions.
* Integrate with the Siemens Data Mesh: Partner directly with federated Data Product teams to ensure governance tools (e.g., data product registries, contract verification, access request automation) integrate seamlessly into their daily development workflows with minimal cognitive load.
* Platform Evaluation & Vendor Integration: Lead technical evaluations, proofs-of-concept, and architectural integration for modern governance tools and open-source standards (e.g., enterprise data catalogs, OpenLineage, Great Expectations, feature stores, model observability platforms).
* Backlog Management & Prioritization: Collaborate with platform engineering leads to manage and prioritize the technical backlog, balancing regulatory urgency, architectural scalability, and developer experience.
* Champion Developer Experience (DevEx): Maintain a relentless focus on customer obsession, gathering direct feedback from data engineers, product owners, and data scientists to build intuitive, frictionless self-service governance tools.

**You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including:**

* Education: University degree (Master's or Bachelor's) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Professional Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role such as Solution Architect, Technical Product Owner, Data Platform Architect, or Senior Data/ML Engineer, with a demonstrated record of designing and delivering enterprise data platforms.
* Modern Data & AI Architecture Mastery: Deep technical understanding of modern, distributed data architectures (Data Mesh, Data Fabric, event-driven architectures) and cloud data ecosystems (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks).
* AI & MLOps Lifecycle Knowledge: Solid understanding of machine learning development lifecycles, MLOps/LLMOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex), model registries, and the technical implications of AI governance (model drift, data poisoning, hallucinations, explainability).
* Technical Requirements & Agile Delivery: Proven expertise in translating complex business, security, and regulatory requirements into structured engineering specifications, API contracts, user stories, and verifiable acceptance criteria within an Agile/Scrum framework.
* Governance Tooling & Automation Familiarity: Practical experience with metadata management platforms (e.g., Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Atlan, OpenMetadata), data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Monte Carlo), data contracts, and policy-as-code paradigms.
* Regulatory & Standards Awareness: Good understanding of the technical requirements imposed by data and AI regulations, including the EU AI Act, GDPR, ISO/IEC 42001, and NIST AI RMF.
* Communication & Collaborative Mindset: Outstanding communication skills in English (written and verbal), with an innate ability to articulate complex architectural trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and dive deep into technical design reviews with platform engineers.

**Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!**

This role is based out in Bangalore or Pune and gives you the chance to work with international teams that shape the future of Siemens.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**Find out more about Siemens careers at:** **www.siemens.com/careers**

title: Senior Engineering Manager - AdTech

Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win  
  
**About team:**  
  
Roundel is Target’s entry into the media business with an impact of $1.5B+; an advertising sell-side business built on the principles of first party (people based) data, brand safe content environments and proof that our marketing programs drive business results for our clients. We are here to drive business growth for our clients and redefine “value” in the industry by solving core industry challenges vs. copy current industry methods of operation. Roundel is a key growth initiative for Target and lead the industry to a better way of operating within the media marketplace. Target Tech is on a mission to offer the systems, tools and support that our clients, guests and team members need and deserve. We drive industry-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business, and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely and reliably from the inside out  
  
**As a Sr. Engineering Manager, Ads AI & Intelligence**, you will lead the team building the **AI and intelligence foundation for Roundel Ad Tech**.  
  
You will lead the development of reusable GenAI and agentic capabilities that work across the Ad Tech organization, taking ideas from experimentation to reliable, production-scale platforms.  
  
Your team will work across strategic areas including **Synapse / Virtual SRE**, using AI and agents to improve platform health, incident diagnosis and operations; **Ad Explainability**, helping teams understand why an ad was or was not served; reusable **GenAI and Agent platforms**; **AI-enabled engineering**; and the foundations for **Agentic Ads**, where intelligent agents can simplify and automate complex advertiser workflows.  
  
The key to success in this role is combining strong technical and people leadership with practical AI thinking. You will build a high-performing engineering team, set technical direction and partner closely with Engineering, Product and Data Science to turn emerging AI technologies into durable capabilities with measurable impact.  
  
Use your skills, experience and talents to be part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals. **As a Sr. Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead as you…**  
  
**Software Development Organization:**

* Lead the engineering strategy and execution for **GenAI, AI agents and intelligent automation** across Roundel Ad Tech.
* Build reusable AI foundations, platforms and tools that can be adopted across multiple engineering teams.
* Lead capabilities such as **Synapse / Virtual SRE, Ad Explainability, AI-enabled engineering and Agentic Ads** from concept to production.
* Architect scalable, reliable and secure AI-powered systems and distributed platforms.
* Establish engineering standards for AI evaluation, security, reliability, observability, scalability and maintainability.
* Build and lead a high-caliber team of software engineers and technical leaders.
* Drive the adoption of AI and automation to improve engineering velocity, software quality and operational reliability.
* Partner with Product, Engineering and Data Science to identify opportunities where shared AI capabilities can create meaningful leverage.
* Drive resolution of complex technology roadblocks across architecture, infrastructure, development and production.
* Create a culture of experimentation and innovation while maintaining strong production engineering discipline.
* Understand AdTech business fundamentals and translate emerging technologies into capabilities that create measurable engineering, advertiser and business value.
* Ensure solutions adhere to Target’s engineering, security, privacy and development standards.

**Requirements for Software Development:**

* **8+ years of software engineering experience**, including designing, building and operating large-scale production systems.
* Experience taking complex technical capabilities through the full lifecycle, from architecture and development to production and operations.
* **3+ years of engineering leadership experience**, including building and developing strong engineering teams.
* Strong experience in **architecture, distributed systems and scalable platform design**.
* Experience operating highly available, medium-to-large-scale production systems.
* Strong understanding of APIs, data platforms, security, automated testing, observability and modern software development practices.
* Experience making pragmatic technical decisions across scalability, reliability, performance and cost.
* Strong sense of ownership and ability to lead through technical and organizational ambiguity.

title: Software Engineer I - Backend (Kirana Club)
description:
### **About the Team**

We're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and every  
week after that.  
Every engineering role here is back-end-leaning fullstack. Most of your time goes into services, data models and APIs, but you  
own your work all the way to the screen — and the screen should look like someone cared. If frontend hasn't been your main  
thing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be. What we can't teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, and  
the instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you.  
Everyone here writes code with LLMs — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don't count  
tokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: you  
own every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. "The model wrote it" is not an explanation in code review, in a  
postmortem, or in a design discussion.

### **About the role**

This is a backend-leaning fullstack role, and a high-volume learning one. You'll build and ship features end to end — from the  
data model through the API to the screen someone actually uses — writing a lot of code and getting a lot of reviews. You'll be  
trusted with production early and work on real problems from your first week. The goal for your first year is simple: to become  
someone the team can hand an ambiguous problem to.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build and ship well-scoped features end to end, including the data model, the API, and the interface that consumes it.
* Deploy to production several times a week, starting with small changes and growing into larger ones.
* Debug production issues by reading logs, traces and stack traces, and get to the root cause rather than to a workaround.
* Build the frontend for the features you own — clean, usable, with the loading, empty and error states actually handled

rather than left for later.  

* Write tests that would genuinely catch the bug you're worried about.
* Participate in code review on both sides: have your work critiqued, and learn to critique others'.
* Ask questions early and often. Being stuck quietly for a day is the only real mistake here.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 1 year of full-time experience.
* Strong fundamentals in at least one programming language. We don't mind which.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data modelling.
* Comfort building a working, decent-looking interface for what you build. You don't need to have been a frontend engineer,

but you should be able to tell good UI from bad and care about the difference.  

* Evidence that you've built something real and finished it — a project with actual users, a substantial internship

contribution, or an open-source PR that survived review.  

* Debugging instinct: when something breaks, you form a hypothesis instead of changing things at random.
* Comfort using AI coding tools, and equal comfort being asked to explain any line of the output.

**Our Stack**  
Go, Python and Node/TypeScript on the backend. React, Next.js and React Native on the client.  
We pick the language that fits the problem rather than standardising for its own sake, so expect to work in more than one of  
these and to learn at least one of them here. Framework experience is not a filter — we hire for the ability to pick things up,  
and most people are productive in an unfamiliar part of this stack within a few weeks.

title: Product Engineer, Voice AI
description:
**About us**
------------

Bolna is a voice AI platform: businesses build agents that hold real phone and web conversations in English and Indian languages, at scale. Every call runs a live pipeline of speech-to-text, an LLM and text-to-speech over telephony, and the backend around it handles dispatch, billing, analytics and evaluation.

**Experience:** 2-3 years

We're looking for a hands-on backend engineer who wants to work where APIs meet real-time voice. You'll build and own features across our backend and the voice agent pipeline: the APIs customers call, the systems that place and track calls, and the speech and LLM integrations that make a conversation sound natural. You'll turn loosely defined problems, often a single bad call, into reliable fixes in production, and follow through on how they perform. You use AI coding tools every day and can explain, test and debug the code you ship.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Backend**

* Build and maintain the APIs, databases and background workers behind live calls.
* Own features end to end: clarify requirements, make trade-offs, deploy, monitor, and fix in production.

### **Voice AI**

* Integrate and tune speech-to-text, text-to-speech and LLM providers (for example Deepgram, Sarvam, Azure, ElevenLabs, OpenAI) inside the real-time call pipeline.
* Work on telephony and web calling: provider callbacks (Twilio, Plivo, SIP), WebSocket audio streaming, call status, recordings and transfers.
* Improve conversation quality: latency, interruptions, multilingual agents and language switching, voicemail and hangup handling.
* Debug individual calls from transcripts, traces and logs, find the root cause, and turn it into a fix with a test.
* Help build evaluation tooling (LLM-as-judge metrics, call replays, golden sets) that tells us whether a change made calls better or worse.

### **How you work**

* Use AI coding tools to explore the codebase, draft implementations, write tests and debug. Review and validate what they produce before it ships.
* Work with a small team to scope releases, raise blockers early, and adapt as priorities change.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2-3 years of backend engineering, building and running APIs in production.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases and automated testing.
* Some hands-on exposure to voice or conversational AI: you have built or worked on a voice bot, a speech-to-text or text-to-speech integration, an LLM agent, or a real-time audio or WebSocket service.
* A basic grasp of how a voice agent works: the speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech loop, and why latency and turn-taking matter.
* Experience using Git and debugging backend issues through logs, metrics or traces.
* Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Codex, with examples of how you verify their output.
* A track record of ownership: you can describe a feature or production issue you drove to resolution, the decisions you made, and what happened after release.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with telephony (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, SIP) or WebRTC.
* Familiarity with audio basics: sample rates, codecs such as mu-law and PCM, streaming and buffering.
* Experience with multilingual or Indian-language speech (Hindi, Tamil and others), language detection, or code-switched conversations.
* Experience evaluating LLM output: prompt iteration, LLM-as-judge metrics, or regression sets.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or deploying services on AWS.
* Experience with Redis, message queues, background jobs, third-party webhooks, or API performance tuning.
* Experience with observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog) or analytics stores such as ClickHouse.
* Experience working on a small team at a fast-paced startup.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Prime Video is reimagining the live streaming experience, combining high-quality video delivery with interactive features across some of the world's most popular sports properties. We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our web engineering team and help build the next generation of live events and sports experiences on Prime Video.  
  
In this role, you will design and deliver customer-facing web features using Java, Scala, GraphQL, TypeScript, and React, all running on AWS infrastructure. You will tackle complex problems at massive scale, write clean and maintainable code, and contribute to the full software development lifecycle from design through deployment and operations. Beyond your own deliverables, you will serve as a multiplier for the team by mentoring and coaching junior engineers, participating actively in code reviews, and collaborating closely with Senior Software Development Engineers and Principal Engineers to ensure architectural alignment and engineering quality.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and build web features for live sports, live events, and detail page experiences using Java, Scala, GraphQL, TypeScript, and React, delivering reliable software through the full development lifecycle.
* Identify and resolve operational issues at their root cause, contribute to on-call support, and continuously improve system reliability, scalability, and performance for services that must be available during high-profile live events.
* Mentor and coach junior engineers through hands-on guidance and meaningful code reviews, raising the overall quality bar and helping teammates grow their technical skills.
* Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and approaches where they can improve productivity, code quality, or operational efficiency, and recommend adoption strategies to the team.
* Collaborate with Senior Software Development Engineers and Principal Engineers to align your designs with the team's long-term architectural strategy, and work with cross-functional partners to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  
A day in the life  
Your day starts with a team standup where you align on priorities for the sprint. From there, you move into focused engineering time — writing and reviewing code, designing solutions for upcoming features, or debugging issues in the presentation and client layers. You proactively drive your work from the roadmap rather than reacting to incoming requests. Throughout the week you pair with junior engineers on tricky problems, participate in design reviews, and coordinate with Senior and Principal Engineers on architectural decisions. You also contribute to deployment and monitoring of your features, ensuring they perform reliably when millions of viewers tune in for a live event.  
  
About the team  
Our Prime Video web engineering team is a group of 12 engineers dedicated to delivering the features customers rely on for live sports, events, and on-demand content. We build and maintain the web experiences that bring these moments to viewers worldwide, and we take pride in the fact that live events leave no room for second chances — every feature we ship must work the first time.  
  
We are focused on evolving our architecture to keep pace with Prime Video's rapid growth, investing in automation, testing, and infrastructure improvements that help us ship faster and more reliably. If you want to work on products that reach a global audience and grow your skills alongside a collaborative, technically strong team, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

They are then placed into roles across BREIT portfolio companies, with ongoing learning, mentorship, and career milestones over their first two years.**

Catalyst Engineering Analysts are Computer Science and IT graduates who join BXRE India in a structured first-year program. They build, maintain, and support the applications, data platforms, and integrations behind BREIT portfolio companies, including loan and debt data, property and portfolio analytics, investor and client data, and corporate systems. title: Customer Threat Advisor - Intern (Offensive)
description:
**WHO ARE WE?**

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

**CloudSEK****,** one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

**CloudSEK’s Product Suite:**

* CloudSEK **XVigil** constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's **BeVigil** uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* CloudSEK’s Contextual AI **SVigil** identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.
* CloudSEK’s **AIVigil** is an AI-native Attack Surface Monitoring platform that continuously discovers, monitors, and secures exposed AI infrastructure, MCP servers, leaked AI credentials, vector databases, agentic workflows, and shadow AI across the internet.

**Key Milestones:**

* **2016**: Launched our first product.
* **2018**: Secured Pre-series A funding.
* **2019**: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020**: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021**: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards & Recognition**: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025**: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

**About the Role**
------------------

CloudSEK is looking for an **Offensive Security Intern – Customer Threat Advisor** to help customers convert cyber intelligence into clear action.

This is a customer-facing security role for someone with a strong understanding of cyber threats who can communicate technical findings clearly to CISOs, security teams, and business stakeholders.

The role sits at the intersection of customer success, threat intelligence, AI security, infrastructure vulnerability management, and security consulting.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Own Customer Threat Outcomes**

You will help ensure that customers clearly understand the threats affecting them and the value CloudSEK is delivering.

You will:

* Review threat intelligence findings for assigned accounts.
* Identify high-priority incidents that need customer attention.
* Understand and explain the business impact of threats.
* Assist in sharing critical incident updates with CISOs and security teams.
* Follow up on important incidents until there is action or closure.

**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking a **technically strong and motivated Security Engineering Intern** to join our team, focusing on **offensive security, exploitation, and automation**.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of **Red Teaming methodologies**, hands-on knowledge of **web application and API penetration testing**, and proficiency in **scripting, security automation, and vulnerability exploitation techniques**.

You will work on validating real-world security risks and providing technical insights and advisory to clients.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Advanced Penetration Testing:** Assist in planning and executing comprehensive offensive security engagements, including **Red Team operations, web application, API, mobile application, and cloud environment penetration tests.**
* **Exploitation and Validation:** Identify, exploit, and validate critical vulnerabilities (including 0-days) across diverse client environments to demonstrate real-world impact and risk.
* **Automation & Tool Development:** Design, develop, and implement custom scripts and security tools (e.g., in Python, Go) to automate offensive processes, continuous security assessments, and improve the team's efficiency and capabilities.
* **Vulnerability Mitigation Advisory:** Translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports and provide technical guidance to engineering teams on effective mitigation strategies and security best practices.
* **Advanced Threat Research:** Conduct deep technical research on emerging exploit techniques, zero-day vulnerabilities, and attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) to enhance internal capabilities and methodologies.
* **Client-Facing Proof of Concept (POC):** Participate in professional and technical POC calls with clients, articulating complex exploitation scenarios, demonstrating technical risk, and discussing the corresponding business impact.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with internal R&D and Product Management teams, utilizing penetration testing insights to contribute to security feature enhancements and improvements in our product offerings.

title: Principal Full Stack Engineer - R&D Technology
description:
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. R&D at GSK is highly data-driven, and we are applying AI/ML, modern software engineering, and data platforms to generate new insights, enable analytics, drive automation, and accelerate the pace of discovery and development.

This role is in R&D Technology where you will architect and build production-grade applications and data platforms used by scientists, clinicians, and business stakeholders worldwide. You will work across diverse domains and partner with architects, data engineers, AI/ML modellers, and product owners to deliver high-quality, scalable systems in alignment with agile and DevOps principles.

We are seeking a ‘Principal Full Stack Engineer’ with deep expertise across software development, data engineering, cloud architecture, and AI/ML integration. This is a hands-on technical role where you will spend the majority of your time writing production code, architecting cloud-native solutions, integrating AI capabilities, and driving engineering excellence across the team.

At this level, you are expected to own technical direction, make sound architectural decisions, and actively elevate the engineers around you — not just deliver your own work. You bring strong opinions, hold yourself and others to a high engineering bar, and are excited by the challenge of building systems that work reliably at scale.

You will work across a range of the following areas:

**DevOps & Infrastructure**

* Implement Infrastructure as Code and mature CI/CD pipelines
* Containerise applications and manage orchestrated deployments with Docker and Kubernetes
* Implement monitoring, distributed tracing, logging, and alerting as first-class concerns
* Automate deployment and operational processes and champion GitOps practices

**Software Engineering & Application Development**

* Write clean, well-tested, production-grade code for full-stack applications using Python and modern frontend frameworks
* Build and maintain scalable REST APIs, microservices, and async processing pipelines
* Design application architectures and own technical solutions end-to-end
* Lead and participate in code reviews, enforce quality standards, and drive testing culture
Debug and optimise application performance across the full stack  

  

**AI & GenAI Integration**

* Integrate large language models into production applications via secure, governed API infrastructure
* Design and build RAG pipelines — document ingestion, chunking, vectorisation, retrieval, and reranking
* Implement semantic search using vector databases and cloud search services
* Apply prompt engineering and structured output techniques for reliable, deterministic LLM outputs
* Build and evaluate agentic workflows including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns
* Implement LLM observability — latency tracking, cost monitoring, output quality evaluation, and regression testing for prompts
* Apply AI security practices: prompt injection defence, PII handling, data residency, and output validation
* Collaborate with data scientists to productionise ML models and evaluate emerging AI frameworks

**Cloud Architecture & Services**

* Design and architect cloud-native applications and data solutions on Azure
* Implement scalable, resilient, and cost-effective cloud architecture with a focus on high availability and security
* Apply cloud security best practices: identity management, RBAC, secrets management, network isolation
* Implement observability across services — distributed tracing, APM, logging, and alerting • Optimise cloud resource utilisation and apply FinOps principles

**Data Engineering**

* Build and maintain data pipelines for large-scale structured and unstructured data processing
* Implement ETL/ELT processes across diverse data sources with reliability and observability
* Design data models and schemas for both analytical and operational workloads
* Work with cloud data warehouses and distributed processing platforms for analytics and AI/ML data flows
* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and governance practices

**Database & Data Management**

* Write complex SQL queries for data analysis and application needs
* Design and optimise schemas for relational and NoSQL databases
* Tune query performance and implement indexing strategies at scale
* Implement data access patterns, ORM frameworks, and caching strategies

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Drive architectural decisions and set engineering standards across the team
* Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing
* Represent engineering in cross-functional discussions with product owners, architects, and business stakeholders
* Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and systemic risks and drive remediation

description:

Join a team focused on delivering enterprise-scale Oracle EPM solutions that enable Finance organizations to improve planning, forecasting, consolidation, reporting, and performance management.

The team partners closely with Finance, IT, enterprise architecture, and implementation stakeholders to design scalable and maintainable Oracle EPM Cloud landscapes. The focus is on applying Oracle-recommended practices, strong architectural governance, automation, integration, and performance optimization to solve complex business challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate Finance and Tax requirements into scalable solutions for consolidation, close, tax provision, and reporting.
* Define application architecture, dimensions, calculations, security, reporting, integrations, and automation.
* Architect integrations with Oracle Fusion ERP and other enterprise systems using appropriate EPM tools and APIs.
* Optimize application performance across consolidations, calculations, data loads, scheduling, and reporting.
* Serve as the design authority, evaluating solution options and communicating trade-offs, risks, and recommendations.
* Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, PoCs, and troubleshooting; mentor delivery teams and oversee implementation through production transition.

  

**Mandatory Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **10+ years of EPM experience** , including substantial hands-on Oracle EPM Cloud implementation experience.
* Proven experience as a **Solution Architect, Application Architect, or equivalent design authority** , with at least **three end-to-end EPM implementations** .
* Architect-level expertise in at least one application:
  + **FCCS:** Consolidation, ownership structures, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, and financial reporting.
  + **TRCS:** Tax provision, current and deferred tax, effective tax rate reconciliation, and tax disclosures.
* Strong knowledge of financial statements, dimensional design, calculation logic, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience with **Data Integration, Integration Agent, Pipelines, REST APIs, EPM Automate** , and scripting where applicable.
* Strong technical leadership, problem-solving, consulting, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong consulting and executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architecture topics and guide stakeholders toward appropriate solution decisions.
* **CA, CPA, MBA in Finance, B.E., B.Tech., MCA** , or equivalent relevant education and experience.

### **Good-to-Have**

* Experience architecting **multi-application Oracle EPM Cloud landscapes** and enterprise integrations with Oracle Fusion ERP/HCM.
* Knowledge of **EDMCS**
* Experience designing large-scale EPM solutions involving **high data volumes, complex organizational structures, multiple currencies, and complex business processes** .
* Experience conducting **architecture assessments, application health checks, performance reviews, and solution modernization initiatives** .
* Experience leading architecture workshops, design reviews, and **Proofs of Concept (PoCs)** .
* Experience mentoring EPM consultants, developers, and technical teams.
* Understanding of EPM Cloud operational processes, including **migrations, quarterly updates, production support, Service Requests (SRs), RFCs, and My Oracle Support** .
* Relevant **Oracle EPM Cloud certifications** .

**Self-Assessment Questions**
-----------------------------

Before applying, consider the following:

* Have I led architecture for complex FCCS and/or TRCS implementations?

* Can I independently architect an enterprise **FCCS and/or TRCS solution** , covering application design, dimensions, calculations, security, integrations, reporting, automation, and performance?

* Have I delivered **end-to-end EPM implementations** , from architecture and design through deployment and production transition?

* Can I translate complex **financial consolidation and close and/or tax provision and reporting requirements** into scalable, maintainable EPM solutions?

* Can I **independently work** on user issues or user requirement in FCCS or TRCS?

title: Oracle Fusion HCM COnsultant (Absence & OTL)
description:
As Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Workforce Management Workstream Lead within Consulting Services, you will own integrated solution architecture across Absence Management and Time and Labor, with demonstrated depth in Workforce Scheduling. You will guide complex engagements from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization. Your work will connect planned schedules, recorded time, absence transactions, and downstream Payroll processing to support consistent business outcomes and production readiness. Working with geographically distributed clients and functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams, you will resolve cross-service dependencies and explain design options and trade-offs. You will govern rules, formulas, approvals, testing, performance, and solution quality while addressing relevant security, Redwood, AI, and Workforce Health and Safety implications. The role suits an experienced architect or domain lead who can demonstrate personal implementation ownership, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.

The role supports clients across all geographies. Hiring location, official grade, final experience range, employment model, hybrid attendance, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own integrated Workforce Management architecture from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization to support successful delivery.
* Lead requirements and architecture workshops; evaluate design options against business fit, maintainability, performance, security, user experience, and delivery complexity.
* Resolve dependencies across Workforce Scheduling, time capture and calculation, absence processing, and Payroll, including processing sequence, retrospective corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership.
* Govern business rules, Fast Formulas, validations, approvals, and exception handling to deliver consistent outcomes across services.
* Lead cross-stream design reviews with functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams; address relevant Workforce Health and Safety, security, Redwood, and AI implications.
* Define and govern integration, regression, exception, performance, and user acceptance testing across services to validate end-to-end business outcomes.
* Establish solution quality criteria, review delivery evidence, and drive resolution of functional issues and design defects to meet agreed quality expectations.
* Review migration and integration designs, data ownership, error handling, recovery, reconciliation, and cutover dependencies to establish production readiness.
* Maintain design decisions, dependency maps, documentation, and configuration or development standards; demonstrate the integrated solution and explain business and operational implications.
* Guide delivery teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks, dependencies, and decisions to project leadership to support coordinated delivery.

**Skills - Mandatory**
----------------------

**Experience**

* 8–20 years of relevant experience.
* 2–3 completed end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations in Workforce Management, delivered as architect or domain lead.
* Demonstrated personal ownership from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, and go-live, supported by specific implementation examples.

**Oracle Products**

* Absence Management and Time and Labor: Ability to architect complex solutions spanning both services, with demonstrated depth in Workforce Scheduling.
* Absence Management: Expertise governing eligibility, entitlement, accrual and qualification rules, balances, approvals, and exceptions.
* Time and Labor: Expertise governing time capture, calculation, validation, approval, transfer, and correction processes.
* Workforce Scheduling: Ability to translate requirements and constraints into integrated designs covering worker availability, planned schedules, recorded time, absence, and downstream processing; validate normal, change, and exception scenarios.

**Functional Skills**

* Ability to assess worker and assignment changes, effective dates, work schedules, and retrospective corrections across the integrated solution.
* Understanding of downstream Payroll impacts, processing sequence, corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership, together with relevant Workforce Health and Safety dependencies.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of Fast Formula design, review, troubleshooting, and validation; ability to govern rules, approvals, validations, and exceptions across services.
* Ability to govern integration boundaries, data ownership, error handling, recovery requirements, testing, performance, and solution quality across integrated business processes.
* Ability to review Oracle Fusion HCM security, including roles, data access, and access across integrated processes.
* Ability to review Redwood implications for configuration, user journeys, extensibility, and testing, and assess AI use cases, data access, human review, and validation of generated outputs.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to present design options, explain trade-offs, lead architecture discussions and cross-stream design reviews, and demonstrate business outcomes and operational implications.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Leadership**

* Demonstrated delivery leadership, with the ability to guide teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience delivering multi-country or complex enterprise Workforce Management implementations.
* Architecture ownership involving integrations, migration, and reconciliation across scheduling, time, absence, and Payroll.
* Experience governing quarterly update assessments and cross-service regression testing.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience mentoring domain leads and supporting solution assessments, demonstrations, proposals, and estimates.

**Self Assessment Questions**
-----------------------------

Before applying, please consider the following questions:

* Do I have 8–20 years of relevant experience and 2–3 completed end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations in Workforce Management as architect or domain lead?
* Can I demonstrate personal ownership from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, and go-live using specific implementation examples?
* Can I architect integrated Absence Management and Time and Labor solutions with Workforce Scheduling depth, including rules, Fast Formulas, approvals, validations, and exceptions?
* Can I resolve scheduling, time, absence, and Payroll dependencies, assess relevant Workforce Health and Safety impacts, and govern integration, testing, performance, and solution quality?
* Can I lead cross-stream architecture discussions, explain design trade-offs, guide consultants, and assess Oracle Fusion HCM security, Redwood, and AI implications?

Lead development teams, collaborate with functional and business stakeholders, manage technical risks, and ensure successful delivery across data, BI, and planning workstreams

title: Software Developer - Android Camera Applications (Automotive)
description:
Required Experience, minimum: 4 years

  

Required Experience, maximum: 9 years

  

* Skills: Java, Kotlin Android, Encoding

  

* Minimum Qualification: B.Tech/B.E

  

Unit and team Overview

The Infotainment Platform unit develops, maintains, and deploys software for BMW infotainment systems. The platform provides common functionalityacross multiple in-vehicle ECUs, with a focus on architecture, security, stability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

The Camera Test Application team develops Android applications used to exercise and diagnose camera functions on Android Automotive platform.Applications use Android Camera2 and Android Media APIs for workflows such as

live preview,

image capture,

video recording,

multi-camera operation,

background streaming

camera performance measurements

camera test automation and more.

The team collaborates with platform, camera, system integration and vehicle-function teams to ensure reliable behavior on target devices.

Job Description

Develop and maintain Android camera applications using Java and Kotlin.

Implement preview, capture, recording, and multi-camera workflows using the Android Camera2 API.

Build and maintain media pipelines using Android media APIs, including encoding, muxing, timestamps, and file handling.

Manage camera and media resources safely across application and service lifecycle events.

Diagnose camera startup failures, dropped frames, recording issues, concurrency problems, and device-specific behavior.

Integrate with Android Automotive OS platform services and permissions where required.

Add and maintain automated tests, and validate hardware-dependent behavior on target devices or approved benches.

Collaborate with camera, platform, integration, and test teams at different suppliers to refine requirements and deliver maintainable solutions.

Participate in design discussions and code reviews, following project security and quality requirements.

Qualifications

Basic requirements and Education

Business fluent English

University degree in computer science, electrical engineering, communications engineering, or a comparable field

Required Experience and Skills

Professional experience developing Android applications in Java and Kotlin.

Practical knowledge of Android application fundamentals, including activities, services, intents, permissions, threading, and lifecycle management.

Hands-on experience with Android Camera2 and CameraX with Jetpack Compose APIs including camera characteristics, capture sessions, requests,output surfaces, callbacks, and stream configuration.

Experience with Android media APIs such as MediaCodec and MediaMuxer; understanding of video encoding, timestamps, and recording pipelinebehavior.

Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and resource management, including callback ordering, cancellation, synchronization, andcleanup.

Experience diagnosing Android application issues using logs, debugging tools, and reproducible test cases.

Memory and Latency profiling with Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, tracking memory allocation and pipeline latency

Understanding of video formats H.265 and YUV

Ability to write and maintain unit tests and distinguish automated test coverage from validation that requires camera hardware.

Proven capability in code reviews, requirement-driven implementation, and software quality assurance.

Desirable Experience and Skills

Experience with Android Automotive OS or embedded Android platforms.

Familiarity with Soong and Gradle builds, platform-provided libraries, privileged permissions, and system-image integration.

Experience with multi-camera operation, camera stress testing, background camera services, or performance measurement.

Familiarity with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.

Familiarity with zero copy rendering.

Knowledge of SomeIP and CommonAPI.

Knowledge of camera sensors, image processing, or video transport interfaces is beneficial.

Keywords

Android Camera Applications

Camera2 API

CameraX API

Java and Kotlin

Jetpack Compose

Android Media APIs

Video Recording and Encoding

Android Automotive OS

Camera Lifecycle and Concurrency

Camera Diagnostics and Testing

**Job Summary**
---------------

App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.

Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Solution Design & Application Development**  
• Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services using Node.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PostgreSQL that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
  
• Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
  
• Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
  
• Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, React, Angular, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.
  
• Good to have experience with Agentic AI frameworks like Google ADK, Langgraph, Langchain etc.

**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**  
• Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
  
• Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
  
• Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
  
• Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.
  
**Secure Development & Technology Risk**  
• Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
  
• Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
  
• Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
  
• Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**  
**• Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.**  
**• Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.**  
**• Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, PostgreSQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.**  
**• Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.**  
**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**  
**• Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.**  
**• Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.**  
**• Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.**  
**• Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.**  
**Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability**  
**• Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.**  
**• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.**  
**• Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.**  
**• Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.**

**Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**  
**• Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.**  
**• Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.**  
**• Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.**  
**• Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.**  
**Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment**  
**• Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.**  
**• Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.**  
**• Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.**  
**• Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
**• Software Engineering**  
**• Programming Principles**  
**• Application Programming Interface**  
**• Database Development**  
**• Distributed Systems**  
**• DevOps**  
**• Software Testing**  
**• Secure Coding**  
**• Web Application Security**  
**• Mobile Security**

**Other Skills**  
**• Platform Management**  
**• Operating Systems**  
**• Computer Network**  
**• Database Administration**  
**• Functional Writing**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity.**

**• Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.**  
**• Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **8+ years of Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.**

**• Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions.**  
**• Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.**  
**• Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.**

Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

**1. Job Summary**
------------------

You will be working in an Agile team within the Thales DIS Business Line, supporting Digital Engineering Services (DES) products.

As an Integration Engineer/Expert, you will apply your software engineering and infrastructure skills to deploy, integrate, operate, maintain, and improve Thales software applications and systems.

The role involves solution deployment across on-premises, virtualization, private cloud, and AWS environments, integration with customer and vendor backend systems, automation, troubleshooting, and technical support. You will work closely with development, validation, project management, and customer teams to ensure successful solution delivery and system availability.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

### **Solution Deployment & Integration**

* Install and configure solutions on physical hardware, virtualization environments, and AWS infrastructure.
* Integrate Thales solutions at customer sites, connecting them with customer backend systems and core network elements.
* Integrate Thales solutions with various customer and vendor backend applications.
* Participate in solution planning, design, and implementation activities.
* Engage with customers and vendors to address technical queries and provide clarifications.

### **Technical Support & Maintenance**

* Provide professional support for developed automation solutions and respond to incidents to prevent system outages or restore service availability in line with SLAs.
* Assist development and validation teams throughout project execution.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot complex, distributed, and highly available systems.
* Execute customer acceptance test plans and support successful customer sign-off.
* Provide 24/7 on-call support as required.

### **Automation, DevOps & Infrastructure**

* Design and develop infrastructure interfaces and automation solutions.
* Contribute to improving DevOps practices through automation and standardization.
* Enable standardized, deployable infrastructure units across multiple environments through production.
* Research emerging technologies and industry best practices and recommend improvements.
* Support infrastructure deployment and administration across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments.

### **Documentation & Project Coordination**

* Prepare and maintain technical documentation.
* Create customer acceptance plan documents and update them whenever required.
* Follow established Thales processes, procedures, and best practices.
* Provide regular progress updates to the Project Manager, including actual time spent and estimated time required to complete tasks.
* Identify, manage, and communicate technical risks to the Project Manager.
* Conduct internal training sessions and workshops whenever required.
* Promote knowledge sharing among integration engineers by sharing tools, best practices, and technical tips.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

### **Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

### **Linux & Scripting**

* Minimum **3 years of hands-on experience with Linux systems**.
* Advanced knowledge of Unix/Linux system administration.
* Ability to read, understand, and troubleshoot basic shell scripts.
* Autonomous scripting skills in at least one of the following languages:BashPythonPerl

### **Cloud & Infrastructure – AWS**

* Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including:EC2Route 53CloudFrontRDSEKSECSCodePipelineService CatalogAuto Scaling Groups (ASG)Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Experience administering on-premises infrastructure, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
* Strong practical experience with AWS is mandatory.

### **DevOps, Containers & Deployment Tools**

* Experience with Ansible, including playbooks and roles.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker containers.
* Understanding of infrastructure automation and deployment processes.

### **Networking & Protocols**

* Strong understanding of networking concepts, including:IPv4 addressing and subnetting.Network size, broadcast address, and default gateway.TCP/IP protocols and packet routing.HTTP/HTTPS protocols.SOAP and REST APIs.

### **Web Servers & Security**

* Strong hands-on experience with Apache Web Server.
* Good understanding and practical experience with SSL/TLS and mTLS.

### **Database Administration**

* Experience managing and administering databases such as:OracleCassandraMySQL
* Knowledge of database administration, migration, and replication.
* Ability to write SQL queries, perform table joins, and filter and retrieve required data.

### **Telecom Domain Knowledge**

* Experience in the Telecom domain will be highly preferred.
* Familiarity with the following technologies and concepts:Short Message Service Centre (SMSC).SIM cards.eSIM technology.

### **Troubleshooting & Problem Solving**

* Ability to debug and diagnose complex, distributed, and highly available systems.
* Proactively collaborate with other engineers to ensure product quality, reliability, and system availability.

**4. Preferred Skills & Behavioral Competencies**
-------------------------------------------------

We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates the following qualities:

* Customer-oriented mindset with strong communication skills.
* Quick learner with a proactive and self-driven approach.
* Strong team-player with the ability to work collaboratively.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Well-organized, analytical, and solution-oriented.
* Strong problem-solving and conflict-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within defined timelines.
* Flexible approach towards working hours based on project and customer requirements.

**5. Experience Requirements**
------------------------------

* **3–4+ years** of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:Systems Administration.Solution Deployment and Delivery.Integration Engineering.Software Support and Maintenance.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on Linux experience.
* Strong practical experience in AWS cloud infrastructure and administration.

**6. Work Requirements**
------------------------

* Willingness to work flexible hours depending on project and customer requirements.
* Availability for **24/7 on-call support** as per the support roster.
* Ability to collaborate with global teams, customers, and vendors.
* Willingness to participate in customer-site integration and deployment activities when required.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
