title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Designs AI systems with reliability, determinism, and clear failure handling as first-class engineering concerns.
* Has experience building or working with LLM applications, AI agents, multi-agent workflows, RAG, vector search, inference services, and orchestration frameworks.
* Can design bounded agent execution, structured handoffs, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop workflows rather than relying on unguided model behavior.
* Understands how to work with proprietary codebases, internal engineering standards, and domain-specific knowledge, and can build retrieval and adaptation strategies around them.
* Has a strong understanding of evaluation and testing, particularly in environments where ground truth may be incomplete or ambiguous, and can distinguish meaningful evaluation from model-generated self-assessment.
* Can make pragmatic technology choices between frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom orchestration, based on reliability, maintainability, cost, latency, and production requirements.
* Treats token consumption, model selection, latency, inference cost, and context management as engineering parameters with measurable operational impact.
* Is comfortable reading, understanding, and enhancing large, mature codebases rather than defaulting to rewriting existing systems.
* Brings strong software engineering fundamentals across areas such as architecture, APIs, distributed systems, testing, observability, version control, and CI/CD.
* Is comfortable working in ambiguous and rapidly evolving problem spaces, with the curiosity and grit to investigate unfamiliar domains and iterate toward effective solutions.
* Can translate complex agent behavior, decision paths, evaluation results, and system outputs into clear insights that software engineers and other stakeholders can understand and act upon.
* Collaborates effectively across Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and other teams, bringing strong technical opinions while remaining open to feedback.
* Is excited to experiment with emerging AI capabilities while maintaining the discipline required to turn promising prototypes into secure, maintainable, observable, and production-ready systems. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to do more than integrate AI APIs—we are looking for an engineer who wants to shape how AI is engineered, evaluated, and operationalized within a real production environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain the infrastructure running unattended multi-agent pipelines against work queues to deliver actionable handoff reports for software teams.
* Construct automated evaluation suites using historical run data, LLM-as-a-Judge, metamorphic testing, and consistency checks to catch regressions across prompt, instruction, and retrieval changes.
* Evolve retrieval architecture beyond standard vector search into a hybrid dense/sparse setup with cross-encoder re-ranking, domain-tuned embeddings, knowledge graph integration, and document drift detection.
* Instrument every agent step, retrieval call, and validation task with latency, cost, and token metrics, surfacing financial and operational insights on leadership dashboards.
* Index production runs by quality and failure modes to power few-shot retrieval, improve automated rollback rules, and generate knowledge base updates gated by human review.
* Formalizes agent-tool interfaces via Model Context Protocol (MCP), establishing versioned schema contracts for deterministic invocation test suites, code analyzers, and third-party APIs.
* Replace basic keyword diagnostics with a learned failure classifier trained on production traces to categorize emerging failure patterns automatically.
* Set data-backed operational thresholds across pass rates, cost variance, and cycle stability to guide when workflows transition from assisted to full autonomy.
* Containerize execution environments to ensure reproducible batch runs, integrating AI-specific validation steps directly into CI/CD pipelines alongside traditional test suites.
* Write clean, production-grade Python and configuration contracts, actively participating in system architecture reviews across orchestration and core platform components.
* Evaluate and adapt emerging industry techniques—such as RLHF/DPO, synthetic data generation, agent simulation, structured output parsing, and prompt compression to fit domain constraints.

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* 4–6 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3 years operating AI/ML systems in production environments.
* Deep Python fluency across the entire AI engineering stack, encompassing API integrations, orchestration logic, file system operations, and shell scripting.
* Practical expertise in production RAG systems, including embedding model tuning, vector database management (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma), hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Hands-on fluency with frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, LangChain, or CrewAI, combined with practical judgment to build custom orchestration when frameworks fall short.
* Direct experience building evaluation pipelines using RAGAS, LLM-as-a-Judge patterns, golden datasets, and automated regression testing in low-ground-truth domains.
* Experience instrumenting LLM traces using tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases, or OpenTelemetry for granular cost and performance tracking.
* Solid background in cloud deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, batch job schedulers, and CI/CD pipelines configured with AI validation gates.
* Proven skill in dynamic model routing across major providers and open-weights, designing model fallback mechanisms, cost-quality tradeoff analyses, and production A/B testing.
* Applied understanding of LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, and alignment techniques (RLHF/DPO), with the ability to discern whether fine-tuning or RAG optimization solves accuracy gaps.
* Mastery of structured output techniques, including function calling, strict JSON schema validation, and output parsing strategies for mission-critical automation pipelines.
* Proficiency in context management architectures, including episodic memory, long-horizon distillation, active context pruning, and strategies to prevent context degradation in multi-step workflows.
* Track record in agent safety design, including execution boundaries, write-confinement sandboxes, audit logging, human approval flows, and clear technical reporting.
* Capability to leverage production traces for synthetic dataset generation, active learning feedback loops, and automated eval dataset bootstrapping.
* Exceptional written communication skills for authoring architecture decision records, executive cost-performance reports, and comprehensive developer documentation.

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits

○ Flexible Leave Policy
  
  
○ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose
  
  
○ We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
  
  
○ Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
  
  
○ Flexible Benefit Plan ○ Awards and Bonus
  
  
○ Annual performance cycle
  
  
○ Quarterly engagement activities
  
  

* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

****Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.****
Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. title: Lead - Fullstack
description:
**Lead Software Engineer – Full Stack**
=======================================

  

**Department:** Engineering
  
**Role type:** Full-time

**About Rocketlane**
--------------------

Rocketlane is building world-class software for customer onboarding, professional services, and modern service delivery teams.

We care deeply about product craft. Our engineers work closely with Product and Design to solve complex problems, build delightful user experiences, and create systems that remain fast and reliable as we scale.

If you enjoy owning a problem end-to-end — from the database and APIs all the way to the interactions a customer sees in the browser — this role is for you.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

As a **Lead Full Stack Engineer**, you will own meaningful parts of the Rocketlane product from design through production.

You will:

* Design and build features end-to-end across our **React frontend and Java backend**.
* Work closely with Product and Design to turn customer problems into simple, thoughtful product experiences.
* Build polished, performant user experiences for complex SaaS workflows.
* Design clean APIs, data models, and backend services that can scale as our customers and usage grow.
* Solve challenging product problems involving real-time collaboration, rich interactive experiences, workflow automation, large datasets, and highly configurable enterprise use cases.
* Make thoughtful architectural decisions across frontend, backend, database, caching, and asynchronous processing.
* Own the performance and reliability of what you build — from browser performance through API latency and database queries.
* Debug complex issues across the entire stack rather than stopping at service boundaries.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code and raise the quality bar through thoughtful code reviews.
* Identify technical debt and proactively improve architecture, developer experience, observability, and engineering productivity.
* Mentor engineers and help the team make better technical decisions.
* Take ownership of features in production and work with the team to diagnose and resolve issues quickly.
* Participate actively in engineering design discussions and influence how Rocketlane's technology evolves.

**You should apply if**
-----------------------

### **Frontend**

You are comfortable with:

* React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
* SPA architecture and component design
* HTML and CSS
* State management and complex client-side application flows
* Browser fundamentals such as caching, storage, networking, and rendering
* Building reusable components and maintainable frontend architecture
* Frontend performance profiling and optimization
* Building responsive and high-quality product experiences

Experience with real-time applications, WebSockets, large data-heavy interfaces, rich editors, or spreadsheet-like experiences is a plus.

### **Backend**

You have strong fundamentals in:

* Java and Spring or similar backend frameworks
* HTTP and REST API design
* PostgreSQL or other relational databases
* Data modelling and query performance
* Redis and caching
* Asynchronous processing and message brokers
* Designing scalable and resilient backend services
* Performance optimization
* Debugging and root-cause analysis
* Logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting

### **Engineering fundamentals**

Beyond knowing frameworks, we expect you to understand **why systems behave the way they do**.

You should be comfortable discussing topics such as:

* API and system design
* Database transactions and concurrency
* Caching strategies
* Distributed systems fundamentals
* Failure handling and resiliency
* Performance and scalability
* Security and authorization
* Testing strategy
* Production observability
* Clean code and maintainable architecture

**What we're really looking for**
---------------------------------

We're **not looking for someone who is 50% frontend and 50% backend but shallow in both**.

We're looking for an engineer who has strong depth in at least one part of the stack, solid engineering fundamentals across the other, and the ability to independently take a customer problem from:

**Problem Design Architecture Backend Frontend Production**

You should be someone who asks:

“What is the right solution for the customer and the product?”

rather than:

“Is this a frontend problem or a backend problem?”

**You'll thrive here if**
-------------------------

* You enjoy owning problems rather than just completing tickets.
* You care about both **how a product works and how it feels to use**.
* You can move quickly without compromising engineering fundamentals.
* You are comfortable working through ambiguity and breaking large problems into smaller ones.
* You enjoy collaborating directly with Product and Design.
* You are willing to dive into unfamiliar parts of the stack when the problem requires it.
* You care about performance, reliability, and maintainability — not just getting something to work.
* You enjoy mentoring other engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.
* You like learning, experimenting, and continuously improving the way software is built.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience building B2B SaaS products
* Experience in a startup or high-growth product company
* AWS experience
* Docker/containerization experience
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience building real-time collaborative applications
* Experience with WebSockets
* Experience working with high-volume APIs or large datasets
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks
* Experience designing enterprise-grade integrations
* Exposure to AI-assisted product development or AI-powered product experiences

**Why Rocketlane?**
-------------------

### **Build challenging product experiences**

You'll work on problems that go well beyond basic CRUD applications — collaborative workflows, highly interactive interfaces, automation, data-heavy experiences, enterprise integrations, and increasingly AI-powered experiences.

### **Own meaningful parts of the product**

Engineers at Rocketlane are expected to understand the problem, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from how customers use it.

### **Work across boundaries**

You won't be constrained by artificial frontend/backend boundaries. If solving the problem requires changing the UI, API, data model, cache, or infrastructure, you'll have the opportunity to work across all of them.

### **Raise your engineering bar**

You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product leaders who care deeply about building a world-class SaaS product.

And most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to look at something customers use every day and say:

**“I built that.”**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

**THE ROLE:**

* Collaborate with architects, hardware engineers, and firmware engineers to understand the new features to be verified

* Estimate the time required to write the new feature tests and any required changes to the test environment
* Build the directed and random verification tests
* Debug test failures to determine the root cause; work with RTL and firmware engineers to resolve design defects and correct any test issues
* Work with DFT architecture, implementation and design teams to drive verification of all test features like Scan, MBIST, LBIST and JTAG
* Review functional and code coverage metrics – modify or add tests or constrain random tests to meet the coverage requirements
* Responsible for Scan, MBIST and JTAG verification

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Proficient in IP level ASIC verification
* Experience in specifying and developing verification infrastructure to verify DFT features
* Proficient in debugging RTL code/Gate-level netlist using simulation tools

* Proficient in using UVM testbenches and working in Linux and Windows environments
* Experienced with Verilog, System Verilog, C, and C++
* Graphics pipeline knowledge
* Developing UVM based verification frameworks and testbenches, processes and flows
* Automating workflows in a distributed compute environment.
* Scripting language experience: Perl, Ruby, Makefile, shell preferred.

* Bachelors degree with 8+ years or Masters degree with 6+ years in Electronics engineering/Electrical Engineering

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

Zimmer Biomet is moving from AI that reads enterprise data to AI that acts inside the systems that run the business. The Agentic AI Engineer owns that last mile: designing, building and operating the secure, governed integrations that let AI agents read from and write back to SAP and other core IT systems – so that agent recommendations become executed transactions, not spreadsheets or dashboards.

This role sits at the boundary between the AI delivery teams and Core IT. It is equal parts software/integration engineering and agent development, and it succeeds only if Core IT and SAP platform owners trust the engineer’s judgment on security, change control and data integrity. The first priority is to establish that trust and use it to stand up a standard, reusable pattern (including MCP-based tool access) for agent integration into enterprise systems.

Value This Role Creates  

* Closes the gap between AI insight and action – enables agent pipelines to write approved outputs (e.g., planning parameters, master data corrections, orders, exceptions) back to SAP and other source systems.
* Unlocks end-to-end supply chain automation by providing the integration layer that agentic use cases (supply planning, inventory optimization/MEIO, transportation optimization) depend on.
* Gives Core IT a governed, auditable, reusable integration pattern instead of one-off point solutions – reducing risk and accelerating every subsequent agent deployment.
* Builds the enterprise MCP/tool layer so agents across functions can safely discover and use system capabilities.

Work Location: Bangalore  
Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)  
Shift Timing - 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

* Closes the gap between AI insight and action – enables agent pipelines to write approved outputs (e.g., planning parameters, master data corrections, orders, exceptions) back to SAP and other source systems.
* Unlocks end-to-end supply chain automation by providing the integration layer that agentic use cases (supply planning, inventory optimization/MEIO, transportation optimization) depend on.
* Gives Core IT a governed, auditable, reusable integration pattern instead of one-off point solutions – reducing risk and accelerating every subsequent agent deployment.
* Builds the enterprise MCP/tool layer so agents across functions can safely discover and use system capabilities.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

**Agent-to-System Integration (Primary Lane)**  

* Design and build read/write integrations between AI agents and SAP (including SAP IBP) and other core systems (e.g., JDE, Snowflake, Salesforce, ServiceMax, Veeva, EtQ, Windchill) using approved interfaces and integration patterns.
* Implement safe write-back: validation rules, idempotency, transaction rollback/compensation, approval checkpoints and human-in-the-loop gates before any system-of-record update.
* Build and operate MCP servers and tool interfaces that expose enterprise system capabilities to agents with least-privilege access, authentication and full audit trails.
* Productionize data and agent pipelines (event-driven and scheduled) that move from shadow mode to supervised to autonomous execution as confidence and controls mature.

**Agent Engineering**  

* Build stateful, multi-step agents and orchestration workflows that call enterprise tools reliably and recover gracefully from failure.
* Apply LLM engineering practices – tool/function calling, structured outputs, grounding/RAG on governed data, prompt and context management – to integration-heavy use cases.
* Instrument agents for observability and evaluation (tracing, token cost, latency, accuracy, action success/failure) and register agents in the enterprise agent registry.

**Core IT Partnership & Governance**  

* Act as the trusted technical counterpart to Core IT, SAP Basis, SAP functional and integration teams: follow their standards, change control, transport and release processes, and co-design solutions rather than working around them.
* Produce clear technical designs, security reviews, interface specifications and runbooks that Core IT can review, approve and support.
* Ensure solutions meet ZB requirements for security, data privacy, RBAC, audit trails and, where applicable, computer system validation in regulated (GxP) environments.
* Contribute reusable components and patterns to the enterprise AI platform (AI gateway, MCP/A2A, agent registry, observability).

**Delivery with Supply Chain**  

* Partner with supply chain process owners, planners and AI product managers to understand the transactions, master data and exceptions behind each use case, and translate them into integration requirements.
* Support hypercare and continuous improvement of deployed integrations; own production defects within the integration layer.

* In scope - Integration and write-back of AI/agent outputs into SAP, SAP IBP, JDE and other core systems; MCP/tool layer for enterprise systems; integration security, controls and observability; production pipelines.
* Out of scope - Business-facing use-case discovery and applied agent/prompt design (owned by AI delivery / applied agent teams); reporting and dashboard development (e.g., Power BI); SAP configuration owned by SAP functional teams.
* Ways of working - Builds within Core IT standards and change control; human-in-the-loop by default for system-of-record updates.

**Your Background**
-------------------

**Required**  

* Strong software engineering in Python (plus one of Java, TypeScript/Node or C#); clean, tested, production-grade code; Git and CI/CD.
* Hands-on enterprise integration experience: REST/OData APIs, event/message-based integration, (kafka ) and integration platforms or middleware.
* Hands-on experience building LLM/agent applications that use tools/function calling, with an agent framework (LangGraph/LangChain or equivalent) and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool-integration patterns, or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly.
* Cloud engineering on Azure (Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, Functions/Container Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Entra ID) or equivalent.
* Solid SQL and data engineering fundamentals; experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Security-first mindset: OAuth/service principals, secrets management, least privilege, audit logging.

**Preferred**  

* SAP integration experience – e.g., S/4HANA or ECC via OData/BAPI/RFC/IDoc, SAP BTP / Integration Suite – and familiarity with SAP IBP data models and planning processes.
* Exposure to JD Edwards or other ERP/MES/PLM systems.
* Supply chain domain knowledge: supply/demand planning, inventory optimization, master data, transportation.
* LLM observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Azure Monitor/App Insights, eval frameworks).
* Experience in regulated industries (MedTech, pharma) and computer system validation / GxP.
* Agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns, Snowflake Cortex, vector stores.

**Must Have skills (Tech/ other Skills)**

* Python
* Langchain/LangGraph
* Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* GIT & CI/CD
* Rest API
* Apache Kafka

**Preferred Skills**

* Azure Cloud (AWS/GCP also acceptable)
* SAP Integration exposure
* MuleSoft / ESB platforms
* Snowflake
* Supply Chain domain exposure

**Qualifications & Experience**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years software / integration engineering, including 1–2+ years building LLM-based or agentic applications in production. [Adjust to final grade.]
* Proven delivery of integrations into enterprise systems of record within a corporate IT governance framework.

title: RTL Design Engineer, Staff Level - SoC Design
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India **Date posted** 11/26/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19671****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/26/2026**

### **Job Title:** * RTL Design Engineer, Staff Level - SoC Design

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years in RTL design knowing that clean code at the front end s weeks of pain downstream. You have learned the hard way that a missed clock domain crossing or an unchecked reset scheme does not just slow synthesis, it breaks trust with the implementation team counting on your work. You think in terms of signoff quality before tape-out pressure hits, not after.

You are the engineer who opens Spyglass before the design review, not during integration panic. When you see a CDC violation, you do not just waive it, you trace it back to the architecture decision that caused it and you ask whether that decision still makes sense. You have written SDC constraints that actually reflect design intent, not just pass a tool check.

Working across subsystems and full SOCs does not intimidate you. You have integrated third-party IP, debugged synthesis mismatches at 2 a.m., and run formality enough times to know when the issue is in the script versus the RTL. You care about the quality of what you hand off because you have been on the receiving end of messy handoffs before.

At Synopsys, you will work on real customer SOC projects that ship into production, alongside a team that takes signoff seriously.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run RTL quality signoff using Spyglass for LINT, CDC, and RDC checks across IP blocks, subsystems, and full SOC designs
* Develop and validate timing constraints in SDC format for synthesis and static timing analysis, ensuring design intent is captured correctly
* Execute preliminary synthesis runs using Design Compiler to verify RTL synthesizability, identify timing bottlenecks, and catch issues before implementation
* Perform formal equivalence checking with Formality between RTL and gate-level netlists to ensure functional correctness through the flow
* Integrate customer and third-party IP into subsystem and SOC-level RTL designs, managing hierarchy, interfaces, and design-for-test requirements
* Debug and resolve design issues related to clock domain crossings, reset schemes, and RTL coding violations in collaboration with architecture and verification teams
* Deliver signoff-quality RTL and constraint packages to implementation teams on customer projects ranging from startups to industry leaders

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable faster, cleaner SOC tape-outs by catching design issues at the RTL stage instead of during physical implementation
* Reduce downstream respins and schedule risk by delivering synthesis-ready, formally verified RTL with accurate timing constraints
* Improve design quality and customer confidence across Synopsys System Solutions Group engagements spanning commercial and government projects
* Build reusable signoff methodologies and constraint templates that scale across multiple customer programs and technology nodes
* Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by providing implementation teams with RTL they can trust and constraints that reflect real design intent
* Contribute to the successful delivery of complex, high-stakes SOC projects where your signoff rigor directly affects product success
* Help define best practices for RTL quality and static verification within a team working on some of the industry's most challenging semiconductor designs

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
* 4+ years of hands-on experience in RTL design, verification, or SOC integration
* Proven experience using Spyglass or equivalent tools for LINT, CDC, and RDC static verification
* Strong working knowledge of SDC timing constraint development and synthesis flows using Design Compiler or similar tools
* Solid understanding of clock domain crossing, reset domain crossing, and common RTL design pitfalls that affect timing and functionality
* Experience running formal equivalence checking with Formality or equivalent tools, experience with SystemVerilog and Verilog RTL coding is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a CDC violation report and trace the root cause back to a clocking architecture decision without getting lost in the noise
* You write timing constraints that capture what the design actually needs, not just what makes the tool happy, and you can explain the difference
* You have debugged enough synthesis mismatches to know when the issue is a coding style problem versus a tool limitation versus a real functional bug
* You are comfortable working across time zones and directly with customer engineering teams who depend on your deliverables to keep their schedules on track
* You do not wait for perfect specs, you ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions, document them, and move forward
* You take ownership of your signoff results and you push back when a waiver does not make technical sense, even if it is easier to let it slide

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the System Solutions Group, a team of design, verification, and implementation experts who deliver full SOC solutions to customers using Synopsys technologies. The work spans from IP-level blocks to complete turnkey SOC projects for customers that include startups, established semiconductor companies, and government agencies. The team operates globally and collaborates across architecture, RTL design, verification, physical implementation, tools, and methodology. You will work on real production designs where quality and schedule both matter.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Senior Subsystem Design Verification Engineer
description:
**Job ID** 2026-21097 **Date posted** Nov. 27, 2026 **Location** Bengaluru, India **Category** Hardware Engineering, Design Engineering, Verification

  

**About Solutions SoC Engineering**
-----------------------------------

Join the Solutions SoC Engineering organization and help shape the future of silicon. We are building a world-class engineering organization focused on delivering innovative, high-performance, and energy-efficient silicon solutions. As a rapidly growing global team, we bring together expertise across architecture, design, verification, emulation, FPGA, software, and post-silicon validation to deliver first-time-right silicon using advanced methodologies, automation, and AI-driven tools. Our culture is built on technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As a Subsystem Design Verification Engineer, you will verify complex subsystems that form the foundation of next-generation Arm-based platforms. You will develop reusable verification solutions and drive verification from planning through closure.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and execute verification strategies for subsystem-level designs and IP integration.
* Verify subsystem functionality including interconnects, memory interfaces, peripherals, power management, and software-visible features.
* Validate subsystem functionality under functional, integration, stress, and performance scenarios.
* Own verification deliverables from planning through verification closure while ensuring quality, schedule, and execution commitments are met.
* Architect, develop, and maintain reusable verification environments, verification IPs, methodologies, and automation.
* Develop verification plans, test methodologies, test cases, and coverage closure strategies.
* Drive functional, code, toggle, assertion, and coverage closure.
* Debug RTL, testbench, integration, and system-level issues.
* Collaborate with architecture, design, firmware, emulation, FPGA, validation, and post-silicon teams.
* Leverage automation, scripting, and AI-assisted workflows to improve verification productivity.
* Contribute to methodology improvements, documentation, and engineering best practices.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline.
* 4–9 years of experience in IP or subsystem verification.
* Strong knowledge of Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, and modern verification methodologies.
* Understanding of subsystem architecture, integration, AMBA protocols, memory hierarchy, and verification flows.
* Experience with C/C++, scripting, coverage closure, and RTL/testbench debugging.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Desired Skills and Qualifications**
-------------------------------------

* Experience verifying multimedia, security, PCIe, networking, storage, or memory subsystems.
* Knowledge of Arm architecture and AMBA protocols.
* Experience with UPF, formal verification, emulation, FPGA, or gate-level simulation.
* Experience developing reusable verification IPs and automation frameworks.
* AI-assisted verification experience.

* **Data Plane Optimization:** Design and optimize high-speed packet processing pipelines using **DPDK** (Data Plane Development Kit), bypassing the kernel to maximize throughput and minimize jitter.
* **System-Level Engineering:** Architect multi-threaded, lock-free applications on Linux, optimizing CPU pinning, NUMA awareness, memory management, and hardware acceleration (e.g., SmartNICs, SR-IOV).
* **Cloud-Native Transformation:** Lead the containerization and orchestration of 5G workloads on Kubernetes, ensuring seamless lifecycle management, high availability, and observability.
* **Technical Leadership:** Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct rigorous architecture and code reviews, and establish best practices for performance profiling and benchmarking.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5 to 8 years of proven experience in telecom software engineering, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or architectural capacity.
* **5G & RAN Expertise:** Deep understanding of 3GPP 5G NR specifications, specifically around **gNB architecture (CU/DU split)**, **Layer 2** (MAC scheduling, RLC, PDCP, SDAP), and **Layer 3** signaling protocols.
* **Programming Mastery:** Expert-level proficiency in **modern C++** and Linux system programming (IPC, shared memory, POSIX threads, socket programming, profiling tools like perf and gdb).
* **Packet Processing & Networking:** Strong hands-on experience with **DPDK**, SR-IOV, and core computer networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, SCTP, GTP-U, VLAN, QoS).
* **Cloud-Native Stack:** Practical experience deploying and debugging **CNFs** on Kubernetes/OpenShift, utilizing Helm, Docker, and cloud-native networking plugins (Multus, Calico, Cilium).

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with O-RAN (Open RAN) architectures, interfaces (Open Fronthaul, E2, A1, O1), and RIC integration.
* Familiarity with hardware offloading technologies (e.g., Intel FlexRAN, NVIDIA Aerial, or FPGA/ASIC-based lookaside/inline acceleration).

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Aplyd works with governments, development partners and institutions to make rural India more prosperous and resilient. Our Sustainable Livelihoods and Prosperity practice combines grounded field research and deep engagement with public institutions with practical technology. Our technology solutions include data, digital public infrastructure, and AI to improve how rural citizens, farmers, SHG members and frontline workers access credit, entitlements, markets and advisory.
  
  
We are working on strengthening a national digital platform in the rural ecosystem that helps in the governance, bookkeeping and financial management of community-based organizations (CBO). We would be working closely with the Government and other stakeholders to develop system designs and manage implementation.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
You will build, test and deploy models for the prioritised AI use cases, set up evaluation and monitoring, and handover working models over to the Government’s technical team. The work focuses on rapid proofs of concept that are validated in in pilots before national adoption, with rigorous evaluation including bias and failure-mode testing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Model development*

* Build proofs of concept for prioritised use cases such as credit-risk assessment, vernacular data entry, business-plan advisory for CBOs and natural-language query for officials.
* Prepare, clean and engineer features from programme and financial records, working with the data and analytics lead on data quality.
* Select appropriate approaches, from classical machine learning to NLP, speech and language models, with a preference for practical, cost-effective and explainable solutions.
* Build for Indian languages and for low-bandwidth, low-end and shared-device contexts.

*Evaluation and responsible AI*

* Implement pre-registered evaluation approaches and run independent evaluations in the test beds.
* Conduct bias, fairness and failure-mode testing, with particular attention to women, low-literacy users and other vulnerable groups.
* Document models, data, limitations and risks clearly for government review.

*Deployment and handover*

* Deploy models with monitoring for performance, drift and usage.
* Iterate on findings from the first evaluation round and validate at subsequent pilots.
* Prepare handover documentation and train the government’s technical team to operate and maintain the models.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* Degree in computer science, statistics, data science or a related field, a master's degree is an advantage.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production.
* Strong Python skills and experience with standard ML and deep-learning libraries (for example scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow).
* Experience with NLP and with applying or fine-tuning language models, including retrieval-augmented approaches.
* Experience setting up model evaluation, monitoring and MLOps pipelines.
* Ability to explain model behaviour and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Indian-language NLP or speech technologies (for example Bhashini or AI4Bharat models).
* Experience with credit scoring, financial data or risk models.
* Experience deploying AI in government, development or low-resource settings.
* Familiarity with responsible-AI frameworks and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act.

Professional development and thought leadership are key elements of our business model: we support our team members’ professional growth through on-the-job training, and we encourage the cultivation of our colleagues’ personal brands through participation in panels, events, publications, and other thought-leadership opportunities. title: Senior Software Architect
description:
**Position:**
Senior Software Architect
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi
**(**
Work from a Government Office from Monday to Friday)
  
  
**Employment type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Associate Director - AI, Digital Transformation and Research
  
  
**About Us**
Aplyd works with governments, development partners and institutions to make rural India more prosperous and resilient. Our Sustainable Livelihoods and Prosperity practice combines grounded field research and deep engagement with public institutions with practical technology. Our technology solutions include data, digital public infrastructure, and AI to improve how rural citizens, farmers, SHG members and frontline workers access credit, entitlements, markets and advisory.
  
  
We are working on strengthening a national digital platform in the rural ecosystem that helps in the governance, bookkeeping and financial management of community-based organizations (CBO). We would be working closely with the Government and other stakeholders to develop system designs and manage implementation.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
You will own the technical architecture and AI-readiness design of a national digital platform used by millions of members of community-based organizations. You will lead the technical audit, set integration, security and scalability standards that the government technology partner builds to, and review all major build decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Architecture and technical audit*

* Lead the technical audit of the platform's architecture, codebase, infrastructure and data model, and produce a prioritised set of fixes.
* Define the target architecture, including a single source of truth and a member-centric profile design.
* Assess offline operation, synchronisation and vernacular performance on low-bandwidth networks and low-end devices.
* Define the AI-readiness design so that data, APIs and infrastructure can support the prioritised AI use cases.

*Standards and interoperability*

* Write the interoperability and data-sharing standards specification for adoption by the technology partner and the ministry.
* Set standards for APIs, integration, security, privacy, performance and scalability.
* Assess integration readiness of external systems, including API availability, throughput and load limits, and incremental versus full data loads.
* Draw on established digital public goods and open standards so that solutions can scale nationally.

*Technical assurance*

* Review design and build decisions made by the technology partner and monitor implementation against agreed recommendations.
* Lead the fortnightly and monthly engineering sessions with the technology partner.
* Advise government leadership on technical risks, trade-offs and options in plain language.
* Mentor the AI/ML engineer and other technical members of the unit.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* Degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.
* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years as an architect for large-scale, distributed systems.
* Deep expertise in cloud and on-premise architecture, relational and NoSQL databases, API design, microservices and event-driven systems.
* Strong grounding in application and data security, identity and access management, and privacy by design.
* Experience with mobile-first and offline-first applications and data synchronisation.
* Experience conducting architecture or code audits and communicating findings to non-technical decision makers.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Indian digital public infrastructure or digital public goods (for example Aadhaar-based services, Account Aggregator, DigiLocker, registries or verifiable credentials).
* Experience on government or public-sector platforms, including working with system integrators or public technology agencies.
* Exposure to MLOps and data platforms that support AI workloads.
* Experience with financial or ledger-based systems.

**APLYD’s Work Culture**
At APLYD, we function in an outcomes-based work environment with flexible hours and a high level of autonomy. Professional development and thought leadership are key elements of our business model: we support our team members’ professional growth through on-the-job training, and we encourage the cultivation of our colleagues’ personal brands through participation in panels, events, publications, and other thought-leadership opportunities. We embrace a transparent, open work environment with meaningful leadership pathways for those with inventive ideas and initiatives.
  
  
**APLYD is an Equal Opportunities Employer**
APLYD, part of the Athena Infonomics group, is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**AI Proficiency and Responsible Use**
Proficiency in the responsible and sophisticated use of AI is a mandatory requirement for all roles, across all levels and functions at APLYD and Athena Infonomics.

title: Senior Technical Architect (Salesforce Revenue/Media/Communication Clouds)
description:
**Description**
Salesforce India Professional Services partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest-priority growth market.
  
  
We are seeking a visionary Senior Technical Architect with deep specialization in Revenue, Media, or Communications Cloud, alongside mastery of the Salesforce ecosystem and AI-first engineering practices.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.
* 14+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform.
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud.
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect
* Other AI/ML or Cloud Architect certifications

title: Java & Snowflake Engineer, Aladdin Data, Associate
description:
Locations: **Gurgaon, India**

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

Java & Snowflake Engineer, Software Engineering – Aladdin Data

  

Your team

The Product Master team within Aladdin Data, BlackRock Data Office, is building a strategic enterprise platform to centrally manage BlackRock’s investment products across their lifecycle. The team is focused on establishing a trusted, governed, and scalable Product Book of Records that provides consistent investment product information across BlackRock. We partner closely with product management, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.

  

Your role and impact

As an Associate Software Engineer, you will help build, enhance, and support Java applications and Snowflake-based data capabilities that underpin the enterprise Product Master platform. You will work across application and data engineering, contributing to product data ingestion, transformation, integration, quality, and distribution while helping modernize the platform and its engineering practices.

  

Your responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Product Master backend applications using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and integration components.
* Develop SQL and data-processing solutions supporting Snowflake-based ingestion, transformation, querying, distribution, and ETL/ELT workflows.
* Support product data modeling, validation, reconciliation, and data quality while integrating Java services with relational databases, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms.
* Optimize application and database performance and support monitoring, deployments, and production troubleshooting.
* Participate in design discussions and code reviews, and develop unit, integration, and automated validation tests following engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, product managers, and data engineers to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.
* Own assigned features through production-ready delivery and explore AI and Generative AI tools that improve development, testing, and operational productivity.
  

Your experience

* 3+ years of software engineering experience with strong Java programming and object-oriented design skills.
* Experience developing enterprise applications using Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization, with an understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
* Practical experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, including schemas, tables, warehouses, stages, and data-loading concepts.
* Experience with data ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT processing.
* Experience with Git, Maven or Gradle, automated build practices, unit testing, debugging, and application troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical and collaboration skills, with exposure to Python, data governance, data-quality frameworks, distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, cloud-native applications, AI/ML, or financial-services technology considered beneficial.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Overview of Role:
  
  
The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
KPIs:
  
  

* Business Impact: Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.
* Time to Production: Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.
* Solution Quality and Reliability: Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.
* Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction: Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.
* Security and Governance: Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.
* Reusability and Enablement: Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

Key Year One Deliverables:
  
  

* Opportunity and Current-State Assessment: Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.
* Stakeholder Needs Analysis: Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders.
* Prioritized Delivery Roadmap: Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.
* Prototypes and Proofs of Concept: Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.
* Production AI Solutions: Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows.
* Evaluation and Observability: Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms.
* Documentation and Enablement: Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams.

Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience and Skills:
  
  

* Software Engineering: Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review.
* Generative AI and Context Engineering: Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation.
* Machine Learning: ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Production Engineering: Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred.
* Data and Integration: Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems.
* AI Quality and Governance: Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring.
* Forward Deployed Delivery: Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Good to Have: Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways.

Key Behaviors:
  
  

* Customer and Business Focus: Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Problem Solving: Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers.
* Agility and Adaptability: Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies.
* Collaboration and Communication: Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams.
* Continuous Learning: Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness.

Reporting Structure:
  
  
This role reports to the Innovation department lead.
  
  
Visteon Culture
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description: Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Manager, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL), VBS (Visual Basic Studio) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a Manager with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience in HCM technical consulting, enterprise application development, or implementation delivery.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations.

**Technical Skills**

* HCM Extracts: Strong expertise in extract definitions, changes-only processing, formula usage, scheduling, and delivery.
* HCM Data Loader (HDL): Strong hands-on experience in file preparation, business object relationships, effective dating, and troubleshooting failed loads.

* Relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM certifications.

Before applying, please consider the following questions:
  
  

* Do I have at least 10 years of relevant professional experience in HCM technical consulting, enterprise application development, or implementation delivery, and hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementation experience?

title: C++ Engineer
description:
AI Full Stack Engineer (C++ Engineer)

* **Company:**
  MYCPE ONE
* **Location:**
  Ahmedabad (Work From Office)
* **Working Hours:**
  12 PM to 9 PM (5 days a week)
* **Experience:**
  2 to 4 years

**About the Role**

We're looking for engineers who want to own software that runs on real people's machines, not just a service behind an API. You'll build and ship a cross-platform desktop agent that installs on thousands of Windows and Mac endpoints, runs quietly in the background, and has to just work — through firewalls, permission prompts, OS upgrades, and every weird home setup a remote workforce can throw at it. You'll make the calls on how it's built, push the updates, and live with what reaches users' machines. AI is part of what we build and how we build, but we want a builder first: someone who thinks in systems, moves fast, and takes real ownership. If you get restless being handed only pieces of a problem and you want to own the whole thing — from the installer to the cloud function that receives its data — you'll fit here.

**What We're Building**

MYCPE ONE builds a workforce productivity and attendance platform for CPA and accounting firms running distributed teams. A lightweight desktop agent runs on each employee's machine — capturing activity and screenshots, tracking time against licenses, and reporting to a Firebase/GCP backend that gives firms real-time visibility across their workforce. It's deployed across thousands of licensed seats today, with a managed install-and-auto-update pipeline on both Windows and Mac. Deeper AI-driven analytics, tighter identity and licensing, and closer integration with the wider AssureOne platform are on the way.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the agent's behavior on the operating system: how it captures the screen, runs in the background, survives logout, sleep/wake and reboots, and keeps reporting on machines you'll never log into.
* Chase down OS-level failures in the field — blank or missing screenshots, denied permissions, antivirus quarantines, blocked updates, processes that die silently — and ship fixes that hold across Windows and macOS versions.
* Own installation, startup and auto-update: the installer, the background service, code signing and notarization, and signed updates that land cleanly through Gatekeeper, SmartScreen and corporate IT.
* Build the diagnostics you need when you can't touch the machine: local logs, health signals, and remote reporting that tell you why an endpoint went quiet.
* Take features from the desktop client through to the Firebase/GCP backend that receives the data, and keep the whole path reliable.

**Operating-System Problems You'll Own**

This is the heart of the role. The agent lives on thousands of machines you don't control, so most of the hard problems are OS problems:

* Screen capture and permissions: macOS Screen Recording / TCC grants (a denied or reset grant silently produces blank screenshots), Windows capture (GDI/DXGI/desktop duplication), multi-monitor and DPI, locked screens and fast user switching.
* Background execution and lifecycle: launchd agents/daemons and login items on macOS; Windows Services and Scheduled Tasks; auto-start on boot, surviving logout, and Windows session 0 isolation that quietly breaks capture.
* Privileges and the user session: admin/root vs standard user, UAC, which desktop a process can actually see, and crash recovery / watchdog so the agent comes back on its own.
* File system and storage: per-user vs system paths, ACLs and permissions, safe local storage of tokens and license data, and surviving disk/profile quirks.
* Networking from the real world: HTTPS through home routers, proxies, VPNs and corporate firewalls; retries, backoff and offline queueing so nothing is lost when the network drops; clock skew and time-zone handling.
* OS upgrades and environment drift: a macOS or Windows major update that changes an API or resets a permission, antivirus/EDR flagging the agent, and installs that drift from the version you shipped.
* Machine identity: a stable machine ID that maps correctly to a license and a user, and why a captured ping sometimes ends up unassigned.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2 to 4 years building real software. We care more about what you've owned than the exact number.
* You've shipped something that runs on real machines and felt the weight of owning it once you couldn't just SSH in to fix it.
* Real comfort below the application layer: OS permissions, processes and services, the file system, and networking — on at least one of Windows or macOS, with the appetite to own both.
* Experience building desktop applications (Electron, or native Windows/.NET or macOS/Swift) and reaching into OS APIs when you need to.
* You debug problems you can't reproduce on your own machine: you reason from logs and symptoms, form a theory about what the OS is doing, and prove it.
* Working backend experience in a modern stack (Node/TypeScript, Python) and comfort on a cloud (Firebase/GCP a plus) — enough to own the whole path, even if the center of gravity is the desktop.
* A problem-solver, not a ticket-closer. You push back on the wrong requirement and find the fix that actually holds in the field.

**How We Build With AI**

* Coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor are part of your daily toolkit, and you know where to trust them and where not to — especially in code that ships to users' machines.
* Where it makes the product better, you build AI in: classifying activity, surfacing productivity and anomaly signals, and parsing documents and images as real features, not research projects.

**Good to Have**

* Depth in one platform's internals: Windows Win32/DXGI capture, services and Authenticode; or macOS ScreenCaptureKit/AVFoundation, launchd, codesigning and notarization.
* Experience with employee-monitoring, endpoint, antivirus or other agent-style software, and the privacy and consent considerations that come with it.
* Experience with crash reporting and observability across the client/server boundary — correlating agent logs with backend logs to chase a bug end to end.
* Experience with installers and auto-update frameworks (Squirrel, MSI/NSIS, Sparkle) and running a fleet of installs as it grew.
* Open source, or a product you built and shipped.

**Why Join Us**

* Real ownership from day one: real machines, real fleet, real users.
* A small, fast team where your decisions actually ship — all the way to someone's desktop.
* An AI-native environment, at the frontier of how software gets built.

description:
**Working with Us**
 Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Read more: careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking an AI Engineer to support the AI Enablement Team in developing and deploying enterprise\-grade generative AI solutions. This role leverages large language model (LLM) platforms, cloud\-based AI services, and modern API integration frameworks to expand the organization's AI capabilities and drive adoption across business functions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have expertise in generative AI application development, prompt engineering, and AI tool integration within regulated enterprise environments. The position is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and compliant GenAI\-powered solutions that enhance employee productivity, streamline information access, and support intelligent automation — in close partnership with senior engineers, data scientists, and cross\-functional business stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and deploy autonomous multi\-agent workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar, including complex state machines with conditional routing, parallel execution, and error recovery patterns.

* Develop and maintain reusable agent node libraries, extensible platform patterns, versioning strategies, and testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end) for agent workflows.
* Build production\-grade FastAPI applications with async I/O patterns, integrating PostgreSQL, Redis, and external enterprise services.
* Implement real\-time agent streaming using Server\-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket protocols, alongside RESTful and event\-driven API architectures for agent orchestration.
* Integrate cloud\-based LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT\-4\) and design prompt management systems with versioning, templating, and dynamic compilation.
* Implement conversation state persistence using Redis checkpointing and build tool\-calling protocols (Model Context Protocol, function calling) for external data sources and APIs.
* Develop hybrid intelligence patterns combining LLM reasoning with rule\-based logic and statistical analysis, and build response transformation pipelines for structured analytical outputs.
* Integrate observability platforms (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar) to enable end\-to\-end agent tracing, telemetry, performance monitoring, and cost optimization across production workflows.
* Implement evaluation frameworks measuring agent success rates, reasoning quality, and output accuracy, while continuously optimizing token usage and LLM costs.
* Ensure enterprise security integration (LDAP, SSO, access control), robust error handling, and compliance with data governance and Responsible AI standards.
* Partner with data engineers, business analysts, and UX teams to translate requirements into scalable agent workflows and streaming interfaces.
* Mentor junior engineers on async Python patterns, agent design, and LLMOps best practices; participate in architecture reviews and contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 9\+ years of software engineering experience, with 2\+ years building and deploying production LLM\-powered applications.
* Proven experience with:
+ Agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph (preferred), LangChain, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar.
+ Cloud LLM providers: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI GPT\-4\.
+ Production async web frameworks, particularly FastAPI.
+ Docker containerization, Git version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

* Expert\-level async Python programming (asyncio, async/await patterns).
* Demonstrated experience building autonomous agent systems performing multi\-step tasks beyond simple chatbots, including conditional logic, state management, and tool\-calling patterns.
* Strong understanding of agentic design patterns including ReAct, Plan\-and\-Execute, and tool\-use agents.
* Experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent\-to\-agent (A2A) communication frameworks.
* Familiarity with LLMOps practices, observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith), and prompt engineering at scale (templating, versioning, optimization).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.
* Prior experience in global life sciences, especially in the GPS functional area, is a plus.
* Experience managing or collaborating with offshore technical development teams and diverse international stakeholders is a plus.

description:
