title: Data Analyst
description:
**About Darkroom**
------------------

Darkroom (Darkroom Digital, Inc.) is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**
------------------

You'll also own the company metrics our CEO reviews every week: retention, cohorts, media mix and creator spend.

You'll report to the SVP of Finance, with a dotted line to our Shadow data team, who build the data pipelines you'll work from. You'll work closely with our FP&A Analyst, our department Managing Directors and sales leadership.

This role is built for someone who sees AI as a core part of how finance gets done. You'll use tools like Claude to build models, automate reporting and create systems that department leaders can use on their own.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* In your first 30 days, audit utilization across every department, role and person.
* Build and own the utilization model on both a recurring (MRR) and non-recurring (NRR) revenue basis, including Shadow FTEs, the capacity our AI platform adds.
* Publish weekly utilization reporting by department, and track capacity for each Managing Director.
* Project utilization from the sales pipeline, working with the sales team.
* Build a hiring case for every hiring request: current utilization, pipeline, margin impact and a clear recommendation.
* Own the staffing sheets, open-role placeholders and the staffing ledgers for custom deals.
* Build cohort reporting (retention maps, layer cakes, curves and scorecards) by company, department, leader and client, including a monthly cohort spotlight for department heads.
* Track net revenue retention, logo retention, churn and lifetime value.
* Report on media mix: spend by channel and concentration, spend growth by client, take rate and ROI by channel, platform revenue share, and client-specific spend reporting.
* Analyze creator spend: who we pay and the average price per creator.
* Prepare a weekly metrics report for the CEO covering retention, cohorts, media mix and utilization.
* Define the metrics and data our reports need with the Shadow data team, and keep them consistent with our financial reporting.
* Provide utilization and performance inputs to the FP&A team for the forecast, the annual budget and our incentive plans.
* Build reports, automations and simple systems that department leaders can use themselves.

**You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You**
--------------------------------------------

* You have 2-4 years of experience in data analytics, FP&A, consulting or operations analytics, ideally in a professional services, agency or e-commerce business.
* You have hands-on experience with utilization, capacity or resource planning, and you understand how it drives margin in a services business.
* You're advanced in Google Sheets or Excel and you build models others can follow.
* SQL or Python is a strong plus.
* You understand billable rates, margin and retention metrics, or you can learn them fast.
* You turn data into a clear recommendation, and you can hold your ground with senior leaders using data instead of opinion.
* You enjoy building systems and automations, not just running reports.
* You already use Claude or similar AI tools in your work and can point to real examples.
* You're fluent in written and spoken English.

**What It’s Like to Work at Darkroom**
--------------------------------------

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape, just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* Unlimited PTO + local holidays (relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil, Portugal and Spain.
* Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
OSINT & Corporate Due Diligence Analyst

**Company:** Infinity Secure LLP  
**Department:** Corporate Investigations & Intelligence  
**Designation:** OSINT & Corporate Due Diligence Analyst  
**Experience:** 2–5 years preferred (exceptional freshers with strong practical OSINT skills may be considered)  
**Location:** Kerala, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Infinity Secure LLP

Infinity Secure LLP is an investigation, security and corporate intelligence services company focused on delivering professional investigation, verification, due diligence and risk intelligence solutions to businesses, institutions and individuals.

We are building a specialised Corporate Investigations & Intelligence division and are looking for a resourceful, analytical and investigative professional who can conduct comprehensive background research, verify information, identify potential risks and prepare structured intelligence reports.

Role Overview

The OSINT & Corporate Due Diligence Analyst will be responsible for conducting digital intelligence research, background verification, corporate due diligence, online investigations and information verification.

The candidate must be capable of researching individuals, companies, business entities, vendors, employees and other subjects using publicly available information, authorised databases and lawful investigative resources.

The role will work closely with our investigation team, including experienced former police investigation professionals, to combine digital intelligence with field-level investigation and verification.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Individual Background Verification**

* Conduct comprehensive background research on individuals.
* Research employment history and professional credentials.
* Verify educational claims through appropriate institutional channels.
* Research publicly available identity and profile information.
* Conduct social media and digital footprint assessments.
* Identify adverse media, reputational concerns and inconsistencies.
* Research publicly accessible litigation and relevant case records.

**2. Corporate Due Diligence**

* Research companies, directors, promoters and business entities.
* Examine company registration and corporate information through MCA and other authorised public sources.
* Identify ownership structures and business associations.
* Research related entities and potential conflicts of interest.
* Conduct adverse media and reputation checks.
* Identify potential fraud indicators and corporate risk factors.
* Prepare corporate due diligence reports.

**3. Vendor & Supplier Verification**

* Conduct background research on vendors, suppliers and business partners.
* Research business registration and operational claims.
* Examine publicly available business information.
* Identify potential associations with suspicious entities.
* Coordinate with field investigators for physical verification.
* Prepare vendor risk assessment reports.

**4. OSINT & Digital Intelligence**

* Conduct Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) investigations.
* Perform advanced internet research and information gathering.
* Conduct social media intelligence research using lawful public sources.
* Research domains, websites, digital footprints and online identities.
* Identify relationships and connections between individuals and entities.
* Conduct adverse media and reputation intelligence research.
* Use appropriate OSINT tools and methodologies.

**5. Investigation Support**

* Support internal corporate investigations.
* Research suspected fraud, misrepresentation and misconduct.
* Assist investigators with intelligence gathering.
* Correlate information from multiple sources.
* Identify inconsistencies and potential red flags.
* Prepare research summaries and investigation dossiers.

**6. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare structured background verification reports.
* Prepare corporate due diligence reports.
* Document research methodology and sources.
* Distinguish verified facts, allegations and unverified leads.
* Maintain confidentiality and secure investigation records.
* Ensure accuracy, objectivity and professional presentation.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong internet research and investigative abilities.
* Knowledge of OSINT methodologies and techniques.
* Understanding of background verification processes.
* Understanding of corporate due diligence.
* Familiarity with Indian corporate and public-record research.
* Knowledge of social media intelligence.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
* Ability to identify discrepancies and suspicious patterns.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to prepare detailed and professional investigation reports.
* High degree of integrity, discretion and confidentiality.

Preferred Tools & Platforms

Candidates with knowledge or practical exposure to the following will have an advantage:

* Maltego
* SpiderFoot
* Google Advanced Search / Google Dorks
* OpenCorporates
* WHOIS and domain intelligence tools
* Public MCA databases and company records
* Indian court and litigation research platforms
* Adverse media research tools
* Social media intelligence tools
* Excel and data analysis tools

Knowledge of digital forensics and cybersecurity investigation methodologies will be an added advantage.

Educational Qualifications

Graduates or postgraduates from any of the following backgrounds may apply:

* Criminology
* Cybersecurity
* Intelligence & Security Studies
* Computer Science / Information Technology
* Law
* Journalism / Mass Communication
* Finance / Commerce
* Data Analytics
* Any other relevant discipline with demonstrable investigation or research capabilities.

Experience

Preferred candidates include professionals with experience in:

* OSINT investigations
* Background verification companies
* Corporate due diligence
* Intelligence research
* Risk advisory
* Fraud investigation support
* Cybersecurity intelligence
* Corporate investigations
* Research and verification services

Candidates from investigative, compliance, risk research and intelligence backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Important Professional Requirements

* All investigations must be conducted through lawful and authorised means.
* Respect for privacy, confidentiality and applicable data protection laws is mandatory.
* No unauthorised access to personal accounts, devices, databases or confidential records.
* Findings must be evidence-based, objective and properly documented.
* The candidate must exercise professional judgement when handling sensitive information.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to build a specialised Corporate Intelligence & Investigation division.
* Exposure to diverse corporate investigation and due diligence assignments.
* Opportunity to work alongside experienced investigation professionals.
* Professional development in OSINT, corporate intelligence and investigative research.
* An opportunity to contribute to the development of a growing specialist investigation business.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with details of relevant investigation, OSINT, due diligence or background verification experience.

**Subject Line:** Application – OSINT & Corporate Due Diligence Analyst – Infinity Secure LLP

* Manage build artifacts, package/version management, artifact retention, and promotion across environments.
* Implement infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
* Automate operational activities using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or equivalent scripting languages.
* Containerize applications using Docker and manage image build, tagging, scanning, storage, and deployment processes.
* Deploy and manage containerized workloads on Kubernetes/AKS, including deployments, services, config maps, secrets, ingress, scaling, and troubleshooting.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using Azure service connections, managed identities, Key Vault, secrets, and least-privilege access.
* Integrate Azure Key Vault and other secret-management mechanisms into CI/CD pipelines without exposing credentials in logs or source control.
* Monitor pipeline execution, application deployments, infrastructure health, and production issues; perform root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Support production releases, change management, deployment approvals, release coordination, rollback, and recovery activities.
* Design reliable rollback and recovery mechanisms for failed or partially completed deployments.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, architects, security teams, and operations teams to improve deployment reliability and developer experience.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual steps and continuously improve automation, deployment frequency, reliability, and lead time.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment standards, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
* Mentor junior DevOps engineers and contribute to DevOps standards, reusable templates, and best practices.

Technical Skills – Azure DevOps & CI/CD
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Services: Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Test Plans, Artifacts, Environments, and Service Connections.
* Advanced understanding of YAML pipeline concepts: stages, jobs, steps, templates, parameters, variables, variable groups, conditions, expressions, dependencies, and outputs.
* Experience designing reusable pipeline templates and centralized CI/CD frameworks for multiple applications/projects.
* Experience with CI triggers, PR validation, path filters, scheduled/manual triggers, branch policies, and gated deployments.
* Hands-on experience with environment approvals, checks, deployment gates, and production release controls.
* Strong understanding of pipeline agents, agent pools, self-hosted agents, Microsoft-hosted agents, caching, workspaces, and artifacts.
* Ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures involving authentication, permissions, agents, dependencies, scripts, artifacts, and deployment tasks.

DevSecOps & Security
  
  

* Implement security controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle rather than treating security as a final release step.
* Integrate SAST, dependency scanning, container image scanning, secret scanning, and policy/compliance checks into CI/CD.
* Apply least-privilege access, secure service connections, managed identities, and controlled production permissions.
* Protect secrets using Azure Key Vault or equivalent secret-management platforms.
* Understand secure handling of credentials, tokens, certificates, private keys, and pipeline variables.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security findings triage, and release blocking based on defined severity thresholds.

Git, GitHub & Release Management
  
  

* Strong understanding of Git commands, branching, merging, rebasing, cherry-picking, tagging, and conflict resolution.
* Experience with GitHub/Azure Repos pull requests, code reviews, branch protection, reviewers, and merge strategies.
* Experience with GitFlow, trunk-based development, or equivalent enterprise branching strategies.
* Ability to define versioning and release strategies suitable for multiple environments.
* Experience supporting hotfixes, emergency releases, rollback, and release recovery.

Docker & Kubernetes / AKS
  
  

* Build optimized Docker images using Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds.
* Understand image tagging, registries, image lifecycle, vulnerabilities, and immutable release practices.
* Deploy and troubleshoot workloads in Kubernetes/AKS environments.
* Hands-on understanding of Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Namespaces, Ingress, probes, requests/limits, and autoscaling.
* Troubleshoot common Kubernetes issues such as CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, pending pods, service connectivity, failed probes, and configuration issues.
* Understand Kubernetes rollout, rollback, scaling, and deployment health validation.

Infrastructure as Code & Azure
  
  

* Hands-on experience with Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates for repeatable Azure infrastructure provisioning.
* Understand Terraform state, remote state, modules, variables, outputs, workspaces, plan/apply, and state locking.
* Experience provisioning and managing Azure resources such as Resource Groups, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, VNets, NSGs, Azure Kubernetes Service, App Services, and monitoring components.
* Understand Azure RBAC, subscriptions, resource groups, managed identities, service principals, and network/security fundamentals.
* Implement infrastructure changes through CI/CD with validation, plan/review, approval, and controlled deployment.

**Preferred / Added Advantage – DataOps & Data Platforms**

* Knowledge of DataOps processes and CI/CD patterns for data engineering and analytics workloads.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake deployment and CI/CD, including SQL versioning, deployment ordering, validation, dry runs, approvals, and controlled execution.
* Experience with Snowflake objects such as databases, schemas, tables, views, procedures, roles, and warehouse-related deployment considerations.
* Knowledge of Azure Data Factory (ADF), pipelines, linked services, datasets, triggers, integration runtimes, and CI/CD promotion.
* Exposure to Databricks CI/CD, Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), notebooks/jobs/pipelines, and environment promotion is an advantage.

Scripting & Automation
  
  

* Strong scripting ability in at least one of PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Ability to write maintainable automation scripts for deployment, validation, environment checks, housekeeping, and operational tasks.
* Ability to parse files, process JSON/YAML, consume REST APIs, handle exit codes, and implement robust error handling.

Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Reliability
  
  

* Strong troubleshooting mindset across CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, networking, authentication, and application deployment issues.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, or equivalent monitoring and logging platforms.
* Perform root-cause analysis and document corrective/preventive actions.
* Understand deployment health checks, operational metrics, alerting, incident response, and service reliability.

Senior-Level Expectations
  
  

* Own DevOps deliverables independently from requirement gathering through implementation, testing, production rollout, and support.
* Make sound technical decisions around pipeline architecture, security, deployment strategy, and automation.
* Build reusable frameworks and templates instead of creating one-off pipelines.
* Proactively identify risks and bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle.
* Lead troubleshooting of complex CI/CD and production deployment incidents.
* Review pipeline code and infrastructure changes and provide technical guidance to team members.
* Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering standards and automation best practices.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, especially during production releases and incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4–7 years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related role.
* Azure certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, or relevant Microsoft certifications are an advantage.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience working with enterprise change-management and production release processes.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: OpenShift Platform Engineer – Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins & GitOps
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking a
**OpenShift Platform Engineer / OpenShift Administrator**
with strong expertise in OpenShift administration, cloud migration, automation, and infrastructure management.
  
  
The role will involve installing, configuring, automating, securing, and managing large-scale OpenShift clusters and containerized workloads. The successful candidate will implement Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and GitOps practices while supporting enterprise cloud migration and platform operations.
  
  
This position will contribute to business objectives by improving platform stability, deployment efficiency, scalability, availability, security, disaster recovery readiness, and operational consistency across enterprise environments.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Red Hat OpenShift: Strong hands-on experience administering, configuring, troubleshooting, securing, and optimizing large-scale OpenShift clusters.
* Kubernetes/OpenShift: Strong understanding of container platform operations, cluster architecture, workloads, networking, storage, and platform lifecycle management.
* Terraform: Experience designing and implementing Infrastructure as Code for infrastructure provisioning and platform configuration.
* Ansible: Experience automating infrastructure management, configuration, deployment, and operational tasks.
* Jenkins: Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* GitOps tools and practices: Experience implementing Git-based configuration management and deployment processes.
* KubeVirt: Understanding and experience managing OpenShift Virtualization workloads.
* Cloud migration technologies: Experience supporting application and infrastructure migration to cloud platforms.
* DNS technologies: Strong knowledge of authoritative and non-authoritative DNS, Dynamic DNS, BIND DNS, and DNS forwarders.
* SSL/TLS technologies: Understanding of SSL handshakes, cipher suites, encryption algorithms, certificates, and secure communications.
* Active Directory: Experience with Active Directory administration, Security OUs, and Group Policies.
* Certificate management: Experience with SAN certificates, client authentication, keystores, and mutual SSL (mTLS).
* Vault solutions: Hands-on experience with CyberArk and HashiCorp Vault solutions.
* API technologies: Good understanding of REST and SOAP APIs, including developing API consumers and publishers.
* Infrastructure components: Experience managing load balancers, firewalls, and site selectors.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Enterprise-scale Kubernetes and OpenShift environments.
* Cloud-native infrastructure and application migration tools.
* Platform observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions.
* Disaster recovery, backup, and resilience tooling.
* Additional automation and configuration-management tools relevant to enterprise platform operations.

****Version And Experience Guidance****

* Specific product versions are not prescribed in the requirements.
* Candidates should have experience with current, production-supported versions of OpenShift, Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, and related tools.
* Candidates should be able to assess compatibility, plan upgrades, apply version controls, and support platform lifecycle management.
* Experience should include hands-on administration and operational support in enterprise environments.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Install, configure, automate, administer, and maintain large-scale Red Hat OpenShift clusters.
* Design and implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Jenkins.
* Lead and support application migrations to cloud platforms.
* Implement and maintain GitOps-driven configuration management and deployment processes.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize OpenShift platform performance, availability, capacity, and security.
* Manage containerized workloads and OpenShift Virtualization using KubeVirt.
* Work with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to maintain platform stability and scalability.
* Design and implement high-availability and disaster-recovery strategies for critical services.
* Support enterprise platform architecture, infrastructure integration, and operational readiness.
* Manage and troubleshoot DNS services, SSL/TLS communications, certificates, Active Directory integrations, load balancers, firewalls, and site selectors.
* Implement and maintain secure secrets and credentials management using Vault solutions such as CyberArk and HashiCorp Vault.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automation playbooks, infrastructure modules, and GitOps workflows.
* Define and maintain platform standards, operating procedures, technical documentation, and recovery processes.
* Identify and resolve platform risks related to performance, availability, security, scalability, and operational continuity.
* Improve resource utilization and platform sustainability through automation, capacity planning, workload optimization, and efficient infrastructure practices.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Scripting and automation experience using languages supported by Ansible, Jenkins, Terraform, and enterprise platform tooling.
* Ability to develop automation scripts, configuration logic, API integrations, and operational utilities.
* Ability to work with structured configuration formats used in infrastructure and deployment automation.

****Preferred****

* Experience with Python or other scripting languages used for infrastructure automation.
* Experience developing reusable automation modules, scripts, and platform integrations.
* Familiarity with scripting for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reporting.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of data persistence and storage requirements for containerized workloads.
* Understanding of configuration, secrets, certificates, logs, and platform metadata management.
* Ability to apply appropriate access, retention, backup, and recovery controls to infrastructure-related data.

****Preferred****

* Experience supporting persistent workloads on OpenShift or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with storage classes, persistent volumes, backup strategies, and disaster recovery requirements.
* Exposure to platform monitoring data, centralized logging, and operational metrics.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Experience with cloud migration and container platform operations.
* Strong understanding of OpenShift and Kubernetes platform architecture.
* Experience managing large-scale containerized workloads.
* Understanding of high availability, resilient infrastructure design, scalability, and disaster recovery.
* Experience supporting cloud-based platform deployment, configuration, and operations.

****Preferred****

* Experience with enterprise-scale Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
* Familiarity with cloud-native networking, storage, identity, security, and resource management.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, and infrastructure sustainability.
* Experience supporting hybrid or multi-environment platform operations.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
* Ansible for configuration management and automation.
* Jenkins for CI/CD pipeline implementation.
* GitOps practices for configuration management and deployment.
* OpenShift and Kubernetes administration frameworks and platform tools.
* KubeVirt for OpenShift Virtualization workloads.
* REST and SOAP API integration technologies.
* DNS technologies, including BIND DNS, Dynamic DNS, DNS forwarders, authoritative DNS, and non-authoritative DNS.
* SSL/TLS technologies, including SSL handshakes, cipher suites, encryption algorithms, certificates, keystores, and mTLS.
* Active Directory administration, Security OUs, and Group Policies.
* Vault solutions, including CyberArk and HashiCorp Vault.
* Load balancers, firewalls, and site selectors.

****Preferred****

* Additional OpenShift and Kubernetes ecosystem tools.
* Platform monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting frameworks.
* Automation frameworks that support infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Tools for backup, disaster recovery, configuration compliance, and platform security assessment.

**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****

* Experience across platform engineering and infrastructure operations lifecycles, including planning, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and support.
* Experience designing reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks.
* Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience implementing GitOps-driven deployment and configuration management.
* Familiarity with version control and collaborative engineering practices.
* Ability to create technical designs, operating procedures, implementation plans, troubleshooting guides, and recovery documentation.
* Experience supporting change management, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

****Preferred****

* Experience with infrastructure testing and automated validation.
* Familiarity with policy-as-code and configuration compliance.
* Experience with agile delivery methods and iterative platform improvement.
* Experience implementing platform observability, service-level monitoring, and operational dashboards.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Strong understanding of SSL/TLS communications, including SSL handshakes, cipher suites, and encryption algorithms.
* Experience managing SAN certificates, client authentication, keystores, and mutual SSL (mTLS).
* Experience with Active Directory administration, Security OUs, and Group Policies.
* Hands-on experience with CyberArk and HashiCorp Vault solutions.
* Understanding of identity, access control, secrets management, certificate lifecycle management, and secure platform administration.
* Experience managing firewalls, load balancers, site selectors, and secure network communications.
* Ability to apply security controls to OpenShift clusters, containerized workloads, automation pipelines, and infrastructure components.

****Preferred****

* Experience implementing security baselines and compliance controls for OpenShift or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management, security monitoring, audit evidence, and configuration reviews.
* Experience integrating security checks into CI/CD and GitOps workflows.
* Experience designing security controls for highly available and disaster-recovery environments.

****Experience Requirements****

* Overall experience: 8+ years of professional experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, systems administration, cloud engineering, or a related technical field.
* OpenShift experience: Strong hands-on experience administering, configuring, automating, monitoring, and troubleshooting OpenShift clusters.
* Automation experience: Demonstrated experience with Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Cloud experience: Experience supporting cloud migration and container platform operations.
* Infrastructure experience: Strong understanding of infrastructure concepts, enterprise platform architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, and resilient infrastructure design.
* Security and networking experience: Experience with DNS, SSL/TLS, Active Directory, certificates, Vault solutions, load balancers, firewalls, and site selectors.
* Virtualization experience: Understanding of OpenShift Virtualization using KubeVirt.
* Industry preference: Experience supporting enterprise-scale, regulated, operationally critical, or highly available technology environments is preferred.
* Alternative experience pathways: Equivalent combinations of relevant professional experience, technical training, substantial platform implementations, open-source contributions, or demonstrated production operations may be considered.
* Outcome evidence: Candidates should demonstrate measurable contributions to platform availability, deployment automation, migration success, operational efficiency, security improvement, incident reduction, or infrastructure scalability.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Administer, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize OpenShift clusters, containerized workloads, KubeVirt environments, networking, storage, and platform services.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, security, cloud, and operations teams through planning sessions, technical reviews, incident discussions, and delivery meetings.
* Develop and maintain Terraform modules, Ansible playbooks, Jenkins pipelines, GitOps configurations, migration plans, technical documentation, and operational procedures.
* Make platform decisions within the assigned scope and escalate risks related to availability, security, performance, capacity, disaster recovery, and service continuity.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience or demonstrated technical capability may be considered.
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in platform engineering, DevOps, infrastructure management, systems administration, or a related technical role.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with OpenShift Administration, Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, GitOps, cloud migration, Kubernetes/OpenShift, DNS, SSL/TLS, Active Directory, Vault, and high availability.
* Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes certifications are highly desirable; equivalent demonstrated production expertise may also be considered.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, technical certifications, knowledge sharing, and ongoing learning in OpenShift, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, automation, security, and platform engineering.

**Professional Competencies**

* Applies structured problem-solving to diagnose complex platform, infrastructure, networking, security, automation, and availability issues.
* Provides technical leadership through sound platform decisions, knowledge sharing, design reviews, and collaborative delivery.
* Communicates clearly with development, infrastructure, security, operations, and business stakeholders regarding risks, dependencies, incidents, and technical solutions.
* Adapts to evolving cloud platforms, OpenShift capabilities, automation tools, security requirements, migration priorities, and operational conditions.
* Identifies practical improvements in platform automation, reliability, security, scalability, observability, resource utilization, and sustainability.
* Manages priorities effectively across platform operations, project delivery, incident response, maintenance, upgrades, and continuous improvement activities.

title: Python Developer | Remote
description:

We are seeking experienced Python Developers, Software Engineers, Backend Engineers, and Open-Source Contributors to contribute to a remote AI project focused on real-world software engineering, bug fixing, repository analysis, and large language model (LLM) evaluation.

* Investigate software bugs, feature requests, regressions, and implementation challenges.
* Set up and configure existing repositories for reproducible local execution.
* Create and maintain Dockerized development and testing environments.
* Evaluate unit test coverage, test quality, and the reliability of existing test suites.

**We also welcome Backend Engineers, Backend Developers, Python Backend Developers, API Developers, and Full-Stack Engineers with strong Python experience.**

**Testing backgrounds may include Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs), Test Automation Engineers, Software QA Engineers, and Python Automation Engineers with strong software engineering skills.**

**Requirements**

* Substantial professional experience in software engineering or software development.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python.
* Proficiency with Git and GitHub-based development workflows.
* Strong experience with Docker and containerized development environments.
* Familiarity with basic software pipeline and CI/CD configuration.
* Ability to read, understand, modify, and debug complex software codebases.
* Experience setting up unfamiliar repositories and resolving dependency issues.
* Strong understanding of unit testing, test coverage, and software validation.
* Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Background**

title: Technical Product Manager & Scrum Master
description:
**Company Description**
Mirador Technologies is an information technology company focused on delivering end-to-end IT solutions and services that meet high standards of quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction. The organization is committed to keeping clients at the cutting edge of technology while optimizing cost and resource investments. Sentinel emphasizes strong customer partnerships and tailored solutions that align with evolving business and technology needs. With a vision to become a leading name in the IT industry, the company fosters a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth for its team members.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai for a Technical Product Manager & Scrum Master. The role involves leading product discovery and delivery, defining product requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and collaborating with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to build and enhance technology solutions. The Technical Product Manager & Scrum Master will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments for the team, and ensure alignment with product strategy and roadmap. Daily responsibilities include monitoring product performance, analyzing customer feedback and data, coordinating cross-functional programs, and ensuring timely and quality releases. The role also requires clear communication of progress, risks, and dependencies, while promoting best practices in Agile and product management.

Key roles and responsibilities

**A. Product management**

* Define and maintain product vision, strategy and development roadmaps.
* Translate business and customer requirements into functional and technical requirements.
* Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRD), Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and functional specifications.
* Define epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain and prioritize product backlogs.
* Establish product development milestones and release schedules.
* Evaluate competing products and identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Coordinate with management, sales, engineering and customer stakeholders.
* Ensure product development aligns with business objectives and customer commitments.

**B. Scrum and Agile management**

* Implement and manage Agile and Scrum methodologies across engineering teams.
* Conduct daily stand-up meetings, sprint planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
* Manage two-week development sprints or other agreed sprint cycles.
* Ensure all development activities are properly documented and tracked.
* Identify and facilitate the resolution of technical and operational impediments.
* Monitor sprint velocity, backlog health and delivery predictability.
* Facilitate effective collaboration between engineering teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Ensure sprint commitments are realistic, measurable and aligned with delivery priorities.

**C. Engineering delivery management**

* Coordinate AI/ML, computer vision, frontend, backend, QA, DevOps and integration teams.
* Establish clear ownership, priorities and delivery timelines for development tasks.
* Track planned versus actual development progress.
* Monitor technical dependencies and resource allocation.
* Coordinate resolution of critical bugs and technical issues.
* Ensure appropriate code reviews, testing and documentation processes are followed.
* Coordinate product releases and production deployments.
* Manage development, testing, staging and production release readiness.
* Escalate delivery risks to management with appropriate corrective action plans.

**D. AI product development management**

* Coordinate AI model development, training, testing and deployment activities.
* Track dataset collection, annotation and validation requirements.
* Monitor AI model performance against agreed accuracy and latency targets.
* Coordinate model optimization and GPU performance benchmarking.
* Establish application-specific AI acceptance criteria.
* Track false positives, false negatives and inference performance.
* Coordinate field testing and customer-specific AI calibration.
* Maintain AI model versioning and release documentation.
* Ensure AI products are validated under representative real-world operating conditions.

**E. Customer project and implementation management**

* Understand customer requirements and translate them into development deliverables.
* Coordinate proof-of-concept demonstrations and pilot implementations.
* Prepare project implementation plans and delivery schedules.
* Track customer-specific software customizations.
* Coordinate API integration with customer applications.
* Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Monitor customer issues, technical support requirements and SLA commitments.
* Ensure proper project handover and technical documentation.
* Manage scope changes and assess their impact on cost, resources and timelines.

**F. Quality assurance and release management**

* Establish clear product acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate functional, integration, regression and performance testing.
* Ensure critical defects are addressed before production releases.
* Monitor software stability, reliability and scalability.
* Maintain release notes, version history and known issue registers.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major production incidents.
* Track corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure product releases follow approved quality and security standards.

**G. Management reporting and team performance**

* Prepare daily development status reports.
* Submit weekly engineering and product development reports.
* Maintain sprint progress and project delivery dashboards.
* Track individual and team commitments while promoting collaborative accountability.
* Identify resource constraints and skill development requirements.
* Monitor product development expenditure against approved budgets.
* Present delivery risks, dependencies and corrective actions to management.
* Conduct monthly product roadmap and performance reviews.

Required technical knowledge

Candidates should possess a strong understanding of software development technologies and engineering processes.

**Software development**

* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Python, JavaScript or other modern programming languages.
* REST APIs, Webhooks and system integration.
* Microservices and enterprise software architecture.
* SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Git and source code version management.
* CI/CD pipelines.
* Docker and containerized applications.
* Cloud and on-premises software deployment.

**Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision**

* AI/ML development lifecycle.
* Computer vision fundamentals.
* Deep learning and AI inference.
* Model training and validation.
* Dataset management and annotation.
* GPU-based processing.
* AI accuracy and performance measurement.
* MLOps fundamentals.

**Preferred domain knowledge**

* CCTV and Video Management Systems.
* RTSP, ONVIF and video streaming technologies.
* IoT and industrial automation.
* Building Management Systems.
* BACnet, Modbus and MQTT protocols.
* Digital Twin and 3D visualization technologies.
* Enterprise dashboards and reporting platforms.
* Industrial AI and Industry 4.0 solutions.

Project management tools

Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:

* Jira.
* Azure DevOps.
* ClickUp.
* GitHub Projects.
* Confluence.
* Microsoft Project.
* Notion.
* Figma.

The candidate should be capable of establishing and maintaining a centralized product development and project tracking environment.

Educational qualifications

* B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Artificial Intelligence or related engineering disciplines.
* M.E. / M.Tech. / MCA / MBA in Technology Management will be an added advantage.

**Preferred professional certifications**

* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM I / PSM II).
* Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO).
* Project Management Professional (PMP).
* PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP).

Relevant practical experience will be given greater importance than certifications alone.

Candidate requirements

* 5–8 years of experience in software development, technical product management or technical project management.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience managing software development teams.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise software products.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development.
* Ability to manage multiple products and projects simultaneously.
* Excellent leadership and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced product development environment.
* High levels of ownership, accountability and execution discipline.

Key performance indicators

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Product roadmap achievement.
* Sprint delivery predictability.
* On-time project delivery.
* Product release quality.
* Engineering productivity and process improvement.
* Backlog readiness and prioritization.
* Critical defect resolution.
* Customer implementation success.
* AI product performance against agreed targets.
* SLA compliance.
* Technical documentation quality.
* Customer and stakeholder satisfaction.

What we offer

* Opportunity to lead next-generation AI and enterprise software products.
* Exposure to industrial AI, computer vision, intelligent buildings and digital twin technologies.
* Opportunity to work with leading enterprise and industrial customers.
* Direct collaboration with technology leadership and management.
* Opportunity to contribute to the development of globally scalable technology products.
* Performance-driven professional growth.

**We are looking for a technology-driven leader who can convert ideas into products, requirements into deliverables and development plans into successful customer implementations.**

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Job Description: DevSecOps Engineer**
**Job Summary**
The DevSecOps Senior Engineer is an intermediate-level position responsible for designing, implementing, and securing application delivery pipelines in coordination with development and technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to champion and embed security principles and automated practices throughout the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Promote a DevSecOps culture of collaboration, open communication, and shared responsibility across development, security, and operations teams.
* Design, architect, and optimize resilient and secure automated build, test, and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure fast, reliable feedback loops.
* Integrate automated security testing (e.g., SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning) directly into CI/CD pipelines to identify vulnerabilities early.
* Lead and execute the migration of legacy CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, UrbanCode uDeploy) to modern, containerized, and cloud-native platforms.
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision, configure, and scale secure and consistent application environments.
* Manage day-to-day Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations, including troubleshooting pipeline failures, resolving environment issues, and providing expert support to development teams.
* Participate in scheduled weekend release windows and provide deployment support to ensure smooth and secure production rollouts.
* Establish and manage comprehensive observability platforms with monitoring, logging, and alerting to provide real-time visibility into application health, performance, and security posture.
* Build platforms, templates, and documentation that empower developers with self-service capabilities to provision resources and deploy code safely within established guardrails.

**Skills Required:**

* Strong engineering mindset and a deep understanding of DevSecOps fundamentals: automation, security, reliability, continuous feedback, and ownership.
* Hands-on experience with modern CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton) and strategic pipeline design.
* Proficiency in scripting and programming for building custom automation and integrations, with strong knowledge of Python and Bash.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong conceptual and practical knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Hands-on experience with Helm for packaging and managing Kubernetes applications.
* Familiarity with integrating various security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into automated pipelines.
* Strong analytical, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, empathy, and collaboration skills, with an ability to mentor and work with diverse technical stakeholders.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with cloud-native architecture patterns (e.g., microservices, serverless, immutable infrastructure).
* Knowledge of major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Experience with modern observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack).
* Additional programming experience in languages such as Java.
* Solid understanding of networking, operating systems, and security fundamentals (e.g., OWASP Top 10, IAM, encryption).

**Knowledge/Experience:**

* 8+ years of overall IT experience in a DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering role, with a demonstrable focus on security.
* Proven experience migrating complex, legacy CI/CD systems to modern, scalable platforms.
* Strong experience in automating routine operational tasks and infrastructure management.
* Experience managing and monitoring the health, capacity, and cost-efficiency of infrastructure.
* Comprehensive knowledge of software engineering principles and secure coding practices.
* Knowledge of agile (Scrum, Kanban) development methodologies is a plus.
* A can-do attitude toward solving complex engineering problems and strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
* Experience in the Finance Industry is a plus.
* Experience with all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: HCM Cloud Functional Solution Architect
description:
**Job Description**
About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)
  
  
Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.
  
  
Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.
  
  
Why join CSS?
  
  

* Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
* Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
* Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
* Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Fusion Apps Studios
  
  
Fusion Apps Studios help customers realize greater value from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications by improving business processes, adopting new capabilities, and making better use of embedded AI. The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.
  
  
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architect, you will own end-to-end solution design across two designated HCM services, translating complex business requirements into integrated, secure and effective solutions. You will combine deep hands-on expertise in your primary service with sufficient functional depth in the secondary service to evaluate, challenge and approve solution designs.
  
  
You will lead customer engagements across discovery, design, configuration reviews, testing, cutover and post-go-live resolution. Working with functional consultants, technical specialists and senior customer stakeholders, you will govern cross-service design decisions, resolve dependencies and evaluate downstream business impacts.
  
  
The role combines functional architecture, delivery leadership, customer advisory and presales responsibilities. You will mentor consultants, maintain solution quality, identify practical AI opportunities and communicate design alternatives, trade-offs and recommendations to support successful implementation outcomes.
  
  
Occasional travel will be required.
  
  
**Experience**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Completed 4 end-to-end implementations with solution design ownership across the two required services.
* Led discovery, design workshops, configuration reviews, testing, cutover and post-go-live resolution.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex cross-service decisions, including alternatives considered, trade-offs and delivery outcomes.
* Led functional and technical teams and presented solution recommendations to senior client stakeholders.

**Product Skills**

* Demonstrate deep hands-on knowledge in a primary service and sufficient depth in the second service to design, challenge and approve solutions.
* Translate business requirements into an integrated HCM solution covering processes, enterprise and workforce structures, data, approvals and security.
* Define subservice scope, dependencies and end-to-end scenarios; resolve conflicting requirements across workstreams.
* Assess requirements for data migration, integrations, reporting, HCM Extract and Fast Formula; review designs with technical specialists.
* Evaluate downstream impacts on Payroll, Workforce Management, Rewards and Talent, as applicable.
* Define the testing, reconciliation and cutover approach across the assigned services.
* Govern design decisions, configuration standards, exceptions and solution documentation.

**Common Skills**

* Security: Assess role access, data access, segregation of duties and sensitive-data handling.
* AI: Identify useful HCM use cases; assess feasibility, data access, human oversight and output validation.
* Presales: Lead discovery, shape solution scope, explain assumptions and exclusions, contribute estimates and deliver business-focused demonstrations.
* Leadership: Mentor consultants, review deliverables, resolve design disagreements and communicate risks with clear recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Cyber Security – Technology Consulting – Infrastructure Security – Zero Trust Security - Manager**
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you shall be responsible for defining, solutioning, integrating, and implementing innovative solutions which will enhance our service delivery quality, as well as help us strategically elevate technology driven transformation for our clients. You’ll also help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in Zero Trust Security, risk and controls concepts, architecture design. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the rollout of next generation market relevant solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* A Security- Design & Architect professional who is responsible for designing, building, testing and implementing security within an organisation’s IT infrastructure- On Prem & Cloud.

* Deep technical understanding of architecture and solutioning of infrastructure security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for infrastructure security including governance and operating models.
* Proven track record in building and maintaining trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel and flex work timings as and when required.
* Ability to change and adapt in a hyper-growth environment.
* Self-starter and strategic thinker.
* Drive C-suite/senior leadership level meetings and discussion.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and executive presence that enable effective engagement with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and communicate the technical and security related issues to client/business stakeholders.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.

* Good presentation, project management, facilitation and delivery skills as well as strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to create domain specific training content and deliver training effectively.
* Develop/Implement automation solutions and capabilities that are clearly aligned to client business, technology and threat posture.
* Demonstrates ability to track developments and changes in the digital business and threat environments to ensure that they're adequately addressed in client’s security strategy plans and architecture artefacts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 8-12 years of experience in Information Technology experience, with specialization in Cyber Security roles that include multiple areas of specialization. Professional-level knowledge in areas from the following:

+ Zero Trust Security Strategy and Implementation
+ Security Engineering & Architecture assessments
+ Possess understanding in firewalls, VPNs, NAC, SDWAN, WAF, Proxy, EDR/XDR etc.
+ Expert level experience with deployment, maintenance and operations of one or more major network security Devices
+ Cloud Security Architecture
+ Entrepreneurial approach to solving security problems with consultative skills
+ Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
+ Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
+ Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
+ Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
+ Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
+ Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, Zscaler)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**

title: Dynamics 365 F&O Technical Architect
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Dynamics 365 F&O Technical ArchitectTransformation to lead the end-to-end delivery of a large-scale Dynamics 365 implementation programme spanning Finance & Operations, Project Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

  

* **Role: Dynamics 365 F&O Technical Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Project Operations, and Supply Chain Management implementation programmes.
* Establish and govern programme delivery frameworks, stage gates, steering committees, governance boards, and executive reporting mechanisms.
* Define programme scope, timelines, milestones, budgets, resource plans, risk registers, and quality assurance strategies.
* Serve as the primary delivery and escalation point of contact for customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
* Lead programme mobilisation, fit-to-standard workshops, solution design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, cutover, and hypercare activities.
* Govern Agile and Scrum delivery models including backlog prioritisation, sprint planning, review sessions, retrospectives, and release management.
* Utilize Azure DevOps for requirements management, backlog governance, user story tracking, defect management, testing traceability, and delivery reporting.
* Coordinate cross-functional workstreams including functional consulting, technical development, integrations, reporting, data migration, testing, infrastructure, and change management.
* Manage programme dependencies and facilitate timely resolution of cross-functional business and technical issues.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements, programme objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and solution design.
* Lead Go-Live readiness assessments, cutover planning, deployment governance, and hypercare support activities.
* Monitor programme performance through KPIs, dashboards, and executive reporting mechanisms.
* Ensure contractual commitments, milestone acceptance criteria, and delivery obligations are achieved.
* Drive business readiness, user adoption, training delivery, knowledge transfer, and organizational change management activities.
* Foster collaboration across onsite, offshore, customer, and partner teams to ensure successful programme execution.
* Promote continuous improvement and delivery excellence across programme execution activities.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 10 to 15 years of experience managing large-scale ERP, Digital Transformation, or Enterprise Application implementation programmes.
* Proven experience delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations projects in complex global environments.
* Strong expertise across Dynamics 365 Finance, Project Operations, and Supply Chain Management modules.
* Extensive experience establishing programme governance structures and managing executive stakeholder relationships.
* Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience leading complex multi-workstream ERP implementations involving integrations, data migration, testing, reporting, and change management.
* Hands-on experience using Azure DevOps for project planning, backlog management, sprint tracking, and programme reporting.
* Strong risk, issue, dependency, and change management expertise.
* Experience managing geographically distributed onsite and offshore delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of ERP implementation lifecycle including discovery, design, build, test, deployment, and support phases.
* Proven success managing programme budgets, resource planning, vendor management, and financial governance.
* Excellent customer-facing communication, stakeholder engagement, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to drive strategic decision-making while maintaining strong operational delivery focus.
* Strong leadership, conflict resolution, and negotiation capabilities.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

  

***“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”***
